tei:div.tei:p: — zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi sgrub pa'i khog phub gser gyi bla bre zab mo bzhugs so:/ gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya: getsastun spyo dbang chen padma he ru ga'i sgrub pa lhur len byed pa' tshe khog phub gser gyi bla bre 'ad shin tu gces pa'i dam tshig zung sa ma mā dang ma hā badzra (ཿ dzñā na tiṣṭha hūṃ sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: hūṃ hrīḥ snang ba ma 'gags thabs kyi rdo rje dang stong nyid ye mnyams chos dbyings dril bu'i sgra: zung das mnyam nyid ston: bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rje mngon du bya ma badzra ganḍi dharmā hūṃ ā: de nas mchod rdzas byan rlabs ni hūṃ zisnen ta kri ta phaṭa: ma mā bha dag chos sku'i rol pa las: lhun grub rol ston kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs bkang te padma drag po'i spro: ma badzra byu dza spra ra ṇa kha: sbos byung ni ram̐ ye shes me dang mnyam par sbyar ba yi lha rdzas bzang shing sna tshogs dud sprin gyis: gzung 'dzin mtshan

ma'i rtog sgrib dri ma sbyangs: dag gsal rnyogs med chos sku'i mchod sprin spel: re sa le sang nge ye swā hā: skyabs yul bskyed pa ni mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo o rgyan padma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon gyi cha lugs can tu gsal gdab: de'i mtha' bskor du skyabs yul tshogs kyi zhing mtha' yas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal btab la de dag gi thugs brtse ba chen pos bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la zhal gyis phyogs spyan gyis gzigs nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la skyabs 'gro ni na mo: ye nas 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi skuḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal brdal khyab longs spyod rdzogs: nogs rje kun la gzigs pa sprul ba'i sku: dbyer med thod 'phreng rtsal la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed na ho: nam mkha'i mthar khyab dmus longs 'gro ba rnams: rang ngo ma shes 'khrul ba'i las rje'i 'brang:med la yod par bzung ba snying rjes yul: sku gsum rgyal sar 'khod phyir sems bskyed do: tshogs bsags pa ni na mo: sku gsum 'dus zhal padma drag po la sgo gsum mos

— gus dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid ro mnyam kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: gzung 'dzin sems kyi dri ma mthol zhing bshags: ye rdzogs sku gsum la rjes yi rang : kun bzang thugs kyi chos 'khor bskor du gsol: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'khor gsum par bsngo: 'gro kun gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur shog: mtshul ni oṃ atuḥrin chen maṇḍal gser g.yus brgyan pa 'di: gu ru padma gangs chen mtsho la 'bul: rang / maṇḍal dbang lngas mdzes pa 'di bde stong zung 'jug lhan skyes bla mar 'bul: rang sems 'od gsal kun bzang marnyal 'di: ye grol bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bul:ga gzhan khams gsum spros pa ka dag ste: gnas lug sku dang ye shes mngon gyur shog: treḥ ratna maṇḍal badzra byu dzi te a hūṃ de nas dzaḥhūṃḥbaṃḥho tshogs zhing rnams 'do du zhu / rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur de nas dkar dmar 'bul ba ni rang nyid skad cig gi gu ru padma thod 'phreng rtsal tu gsal la: o su bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs rin chen

sgod du dkar dmar gtor skyems ni:'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i phung por gyur rgo āḥhūṃḥnam mkha' mdzod sngags a ka ro: sa sbyang bsgyur spel la 'di skad do mgon po pho rgyud lha mo mo rgyud dang : gnyis med ma ning rigs gtog dregs pa can:yul gzhi'i bdag po dkar nag gnyis skyong ba: kun kyang dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs:sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs dga' ston ni: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod 'di khyod la 'bul: dgyes bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : sems can phan bde spel ba'i grogs po mdzod:khyad par sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang mthun snang legs tshogs dpal bskyed sa ma yā: gtor skyems mchod rang nyid padma thod 'greng rtsal gnas su gyur pa las: dpal dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon bsdigs mdzub mdzad pa: dur khrod dpal chas kyis spras shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par gsal ba'i spyi gtsugs nas rta skad drag po stong gsum kheng bar sgrogs pas mi min 'byung po thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon par bsam la:sbyo las rin po

rdo/— che'i snod du oṃ las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po so so'i spyod yul bzhin tu 'char nus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur o āḥstsa se bha ra dang a ka ros: sbyangs bsgyur spel la byin gyis brlabs de nas bgegs 'gugs 'di ltar bya na mo: mchog gsum kun dngos padma drag po rtsal gyi bden pa dang : bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: 'byung po yid kyis gzugs can gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor dang ldan pa thams cad lan chags 'jal ba'i mgron du 'dus shig sa sabo thisnan a ga ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ ho: hoḥ mchod sbyin phyi glud gtor rgya chen po 'di: bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni gang 'dir dkar po dge ba'i lam la mi mos shing: nag po sdig pa'i las la dbang za zhing rtag du bstan 'gro la nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'byung po yid kyi gzugs can bgegs rgyal bi na ya ga'i gtsor byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad: nad rim yams kyi bdag po: tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas lan chags la re ba'i 'byung po thams cad: dbang chen padma he ru ga'i rnal

'byor ba bdag gi bka' la nyan cing dam la gnas par gyis la: mchod skyin gyi glud gtor rgya chen po ting 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba zad pa med pa'i gter chen por bsgyur ba 'dis:ngom shing tshim par gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig: gal te bka' dang dam la mi gnas par gnod cing 'tshe na: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo dang khro mo thun mtshon sna tshogs pa'i rnam pas bgegs khyed rnams gyi lus srog gi dngos po rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za bas rang gi gnas su bde bar dengs shig byer zhig u tsa ta ya phaṭa bsrung dmigasani ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i mtshon cha sna lnga'i gur khang chen po steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun du dkrig pa'i dbus su: bdag cag sgrub pa po yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyi ngang la gnas par gyur:srung ba'i gur khang la dus gsum kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs shing rab du gnas par gyur cig: byin bskul ni rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa

/— thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul:kun kyang sku phyag rgya:gsung yig 'bru:thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byung te bdag gnas yo spyad thams cad la byin phab cing ye shes lnga'i dbang chen bsku bar bsam la:hū hūṃ dza skye med chos sku spros dang bral ba las:dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig:'gags med 'od /la bde stong klong yangs nas: brda brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig:rtsol bral thugs rje phyogs ris bral ba las: snyan brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig rngam da rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas sa rgyan slob dpon padmas byin phob cig bde stong klong yangs kun khyab pho brang nas: yi dam rgyu sde rgya mtshos byin phob cig: lhan skyes / sa yul dur khrod chen po nas: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin phob cig: 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i byin phob /: sgrub pa'i gnas yul dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas la: lha sngags chos nyid rol pa chen po na dag rdzogs smin grol byin chen dbab tu gsol: ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang

bskur cig snyen padma 11 ta sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza a we sha ya a ā: zhes brjod pa'inam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba gras bcasathamasacad 'od du zhu nas bdag gnas yo spyad thams cad la thimapas sku gsung thugagakyi rol pa chen por dag smin rdzogasapar bsam de ltar sgrub pa'i khog phug 'di lam gyi cha lag zab mo ste sgrub mchog yongs kyis gcesapar zungs dngosagrub thob po skal ba can sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu bye brda thim sgo zhesa'adi'ang sprang spyon nus ldan rdo rje la rje o rgyan chen pos khyung tshangs stag mo' rdzong nas zhal mngon sum bstan te man ngag pha phog tu bstsal ba nyid don chen po dang ldan phyir gnas de ru dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zinamadze kairtibasabagyis pa dge leg 'phel sarba ma le

rdo/— zab chos dri med klong yangs las drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi byin 'bebs 'od kyi drwa ba thugs rje'i zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rdo/cha na mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya shākya)loḥsagaca/drag po sgrub pa'i rnal 'byar bas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdam dal sogs yo byad byin dbab phyir byin 'bebs 'od kya lcags kyu ni shalo dud btang rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ sno dzaḥ 'og min spros dang bral ba'i dbyings nyid las: ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mchog snang mtha' yas: rdo rje rin chen lasadang sangs rgyas rigs: kun kyang padma drag po' phyag rgyar bzhengs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: mi mjed 'jin rten bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon: sku lngamatshan brgyad 'phrul mtshan nyi shu lnga: rdo rje padma thod 'phreng rnam rol tu: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon la byin phob cig: chos rgyal tshang pa lha yi me tog dang : snod ldan gzung maye shes mtsho rgyal ma: snying gi bu dgu rje 'bangs brgya rtsa rnams: gnas 'dir byon la ye shes byin phobs cig: sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nas mkhyen rab dbang

phyug 'phagasapa 'jam dpal dbyangs: sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i sprul 'khor bsam mtha' yas gnas 'dir byon la dag nyams byin phobs cig: gsung mchog 'gags pa med pamipho brang nas padma dbang chen rta mchog rol ba'i gar: rjes chags bzhad pa'i glus bskul ma tshogs bcas: gnas 'dir phyon la dag nyams byin phob cig thugasamachog g.yob med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gsang bdag rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug ni: rig 'dzin dra ma lnga sogs 'khor dang bcas gnas 'dir byon la dag nyams byin phob cig: yonatan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal kun bskyed mdzad mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir byon la dag nyams byinaphobs cig 'phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: stobs kyis bdag nyid yakka me dbal ni: rdo rje khro bo 'chom mi tshogs bcas rnams: gnas 'dir byon la dag nyams byin phobs cig srung ba'i rgyal po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dang: phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul ye shes khro bo bcu: rang rang las spros sprul ba bsam mtha' yas: gnasa'adir byon

/sgo la dag nyams byin phobs cigaX 'phrin lasarnam bzhi'i mdzad pa lhun grub cing :mtshan 'dzin bdud bzhi'i kha lo dbyings su bsgyur:ngo bo zhi la rnam 'gyur khro tshulacan :drag rtsal rigs bzhi 'dir byon byin phobs cig:bka' nyan sgo bzhi dbang phyug ma sring dang :rgyal chen sku lnga dge bsnyen spyo kha ba:dregs pa sde bcu yang sprul bsam mtha'ayas:gnas 'dir byon la dag mnyam byin phobs cig sgrub pa'i gnas yul sgrub po sgrub rdzas kun:gzhal yas bkod pa lha sngags chos nyid kyi:rol ba chen po'i ngang du byinaphobs la:mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol:tshe gu ru padma kro dha rā dza sarba sashā ri wā ra badzra sam ya dza dza dzñā na lo.a we sha yam ā de ltar byin pho dbab pa' mthus wa rtogasayar pho zla ltar 'phel bsgrub la byan chags dam rdzasakhol 'ja' 'od 'khyal zhing dri bzang 'thul de rnams sgrub pa' rtagasasu 'byung bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhesapa 'da'ang sngag skye bkrashisarab brtan nasalha reg bcasate bskul ngor/kho bo rgyal mchog ba'ad pa stsal gyis zab mdzod rin po che'i sgrom rgya las zhal bzhu te dag par phab pa'i yige pa ni dge btsun zhing rgyam bya ba bgyi pa dge legasa'aphel sarba marsha le

rdo/— zab chos dri med 1nga yangs las: drag po me yi phreng ba can la brten pa'i byin 'bebs 'od kyi drwa ba bzhugs so:rdo/ na mo kro dha rā dza ya: thago01sgadza) sha za dud bta rol mo sgrog rnal yor lha yi ngar bskyed de hū dzaḥ gling dbus mtsho dkyil pad sdong ze'u 'bru'i khar: skugasum ston mchog padma rgyal por bzhengs: khyed shes dad pas bskul gsol 'debs lags na: rnga yab gling nas gnas 'dir dbang byin phobs: bsam 'grub gtsug lagabasam yas yang thog nas: lha srin dam 'dogs gu ru drag po rtsal: snyigs ma'i rgud pa skyobs phyir 'bod bskul na: o rgyan gling nas gnas 'dir dbang byin phobs mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus bde stong dga' bzhi'i dpal rgya mchog bzhad pa'i sprul gzhi a tsārya: phun tshogs grub rtags sgrub pa'i dpal 'don phyir: thugs rje rgyang thag maring 'dir byin phobs: gdong dmar srin rje raku thod phreng rtsal: phyi nang gsang rkyen bdud bzhi rang grol phyir mthu stobs rdo rje'i dpa' ngar shugs byung la: skal ldan rtogs

grol dus mnyam dbang byin phobs: sku gsum lhun rdzogs rnga yab dpal ri nas: o rgyan rje dang 'phags bod paṇa grub tshogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i glu gar rol mo bcas/gnas 'dir byin phobs dbang bskur rtogs pa spor: 'dor ba'i srog 'phrog rlung sems rang sar grol chos nyid mngon sum yi dam lhag lhar smin: rnam smin lus rgyar gabur rlung 'phrang bzhin: gnyug ma'i he ru ka dpal srid thob mdzod: tshe padma kro dha rā dza e a ra li hring hro pho pho: zhes bskul gsol gdab la rol mos gzi byin dbab hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ namamakha' gang ba'i lha rnams bdag mdun bum gtor ma sras phur rnams la bstims pas mchog thun dngos grub thams cad thob bar bsam mo e ma mdo khamasastag mo' yangs rdzongagi sdig nag sba pa'i mtsho chen las dge bsnyen spyo khar gtad pa'i brda rten 'brel dus su bab pa'i tshe rin chen shog skyar pheb pa 'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim dzi zhes pa'ang drag po skor gsum gyi chos bdagagrags pa'i dpal rgyas bgo skal yan par snang yang rtsa ba snying nor bka' bab me yis bskul ngor rgyal mchog bzhad pa' rdo rjes spel ba ma la byin bskul ni rang gi snying kha'i cesad zer gyis bskul te: nub

rdo/ phyogs bde sang padma brtsegs pa dang : snying rje'i gter mdzod ri bo gru 'dzin dang : gsang chen sngags kyi dpal ldan rnga yab dpal ri nas: sku gsum stonapa 'khor tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa sngon gyi thugs dam las bzhengs te bdag gnas yo byad rnams la byin chen phab cing dbang chen bskur bar bsam la: byina'abebasabya'o 'di'ang gter ston rang gis sbyar ba'o sarba masgo le

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi gsol 'debs dregs pa zil gnon bzhugs / padma kro dha rā dza ya: tshu'i yidza'i ཿ// dad dang mos gusarga med pas e ma ho: 'jigs rung srin po'i grong khyer dpal ri nas: bdud 'dul dbang nga nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na: dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs: dugs gsum rang mtshan 'khrul ba'i gdon gyi gshed:2jigs rngams zhal snying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku yi che brjid gsung gi nga ro ris med khyab brdal klong : snying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs: dpa' ba'i chas brgyan / ngas: rdo rje'i 'od zer kun nas 'bar ba'i gzi: snying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na: dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku

mthong lta ci mtshan tsam thos pas kyang mi min snying 'dar dregs pa'i dpa' skong ba: snying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na: dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyisarlobs srid gsum 'byung po'i la yog mngon g.yo yang : drags po khyed sgrub nus mthus tshar gcod 'gyur snying nas dran bzhin gsol ba 'debs lags na: dregs pa bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs bdag snang ma rig gsum gyi rab rib sangs: ye rdzogs padma'i gsang gsum mngon mthong nas: nang gsal kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob ste gzhan phan 'phrin las mi nub mtha' rgyas 31ga: de ltar gsol btab byin rlabs 'jug bar chad rkyen las rnam par rgyal sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhesapa 'di yang sprang spyon nus ldan dpa' bo la mdo khamasaganas kyi ya gyal nub phyog stag mo'i yang rdzong du tshogs ston phul skabs rjetsasgo rgyan chen po'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas pha phog gi tshul du nod pa nyid gnas de ru ra bar phab pa dge legs 'phel

ḍa zab chos dri med sang yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi zab sgrub sde brgyad sgog tig 'bar ba bzhugs so: padma kro dha rā dza yaḥ rten/ pa rja dmar nag me yi 'phreng ba can skal ba can gyi spyod yul ste dben pa'i gnas su dam rgya can gtor ma sgrub phur la bsten te sngon 'gro bas mtshamasagacod ni hū hrīḥ ye nas rnam dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la: nga bdag mtshan 'dzin spros pa ka dag kyang : 'phral byung ma rig nyon mongs / bral sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'di khyer la rang snang mtshan ma'i yul du mtshams bcad do 'og min gsang chen yul du nye mi nus: slo gu ru kro dha rā dza ṭa zung gur ni hū hrīḥ bla med gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di ye nas rnam dag ye shes lnga yi klong nyag gcig byang chub sems gyi ra gur ste do na gyis glags mi rnyed dzñā na dhartu rakṣa rakta brda sgo dbye phyag dal 4'a ni hū hūḥ mtha' bzhi'i dri ma bral ba'i chos nyid la: ma rig gdos por 'dzin cing

dri ma dbye: lhan skyes lha zhal mjal la phyag bgyi'o: srog gi gta' ru 'dzin cing bsgrub par bya: snyed pad ma pra we sha ya phaṭa: a ti pu ho: tsitta badzra sa ma ya hūṃ: de nas byin 'beb ni hūṃ hrī che ba'i dbang phyug padma thod 'phreng rtsal: mdzad pa mtha' yas gu ru gangs can mtsho: dregs pa zil gnon dmar nag me yi phreng : rngam brjid padma 'od nas sku bskyod la: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab pa dang : skal ldan bu la ye shes dbang chen bskur: sgo ma hā gu ru bidu dha ra sa ma yā a we sha ya a ā: mchod sa byin rlabasani hūṃ trī bharnya stong gsum khyon mnyam yangs pa phu sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes rgya mtshor bskyil: srid pa rab bsgral rakta'i rba klong 'khyil: 'dod yon ro mchog ba ling brjid ldan spungs: sa āḥ(ཿ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥ'iḥ oṃ āḥshā ma hā rakta dzwa la marnyal hūṃ trī ༷'iḥ skyid āḥ/ ma hā bha ling ta te dzwa bha ling ta bha la bha ti gu hya hrī shwa sa ma ya hūṃ hrī thaX rnam lnga byan rlab ni hūṃ hrīḥ bla med gsang ba mtshog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: ro mnyam bde chen mchod sprin spro ba ni: dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen bdug pa spos: zhun me mkhris

pa'i chab dang sha rus zas: rkang gi gling bu la sogs mchod pa'i sprin drag po dgyes pa'i bskangs rdzas sna tshogs bkod: o badzra a sogs/ pu dza badzra spa ra ṇa kho: de nas lha bskyed ni moX chos sku mi 'gyur kun khyab nam mkha'i klong : rang bzhin 'od gsal snying rje yongs su 'khyil: thugs rje gang 'dul gzigs 1 ཿdmar po: bde chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor spro phyir shar: o āḥ/ badzra sa ma dhi hūṃ hrīḥrab 'jigs rngam pa'i bkod pa yongs rdzogs klong : dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung bas ma'i dbus: chos 'byung dmar nag rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i khar rgyu yi yi ge spro bsdus zhu ba las: bdag nyid rig 'dus gu ru drag po rtsal: dmar nag g.yas sngo sna/na dkar khro zhing gtum: zhal gdangs ljag 'dril drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs: dmar zlum spyan dgu'i sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs: rno dkar mche gtsigs smar smin me 'bar: ral pa gyen bajis zod skam dbu rgyan dang : dar sna'i con pan rdo rje gshog pa brkyang : rtsa phyag rdo rje rtse lnga bhan dmar 'dzin bar mas ral gri dang ni kha ṭwāṃ

gdengs tha mas tho chen sdig pa'i snying nas gtser: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su 'chang shadas bzhi bsgrad pas rgyal bsen zil gyis gnon yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor mthing nag ni: khro 'dzum gri thod yab la 'byud stobs rol: dar dpyangs thod sbrul rus rgyan gzigs shams mdzes: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bde stong zung 'jug sku ye shes me klong 'bar ba'i gar dang bcas: sprul pa'i khro tshogs sdig phag thun mtshon 'gyed: dus gsum las skyes 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed de yi phyi rim pad nyi du tra'i khar: shar du rdo rje drag rtsal dkar gsal khro lto ru ratna drag rtsal lhun gnyer brjid: nub tu padma drag rtsal dmar nag rngams: byang du garma drag rtsal ljang nag gtum kun kyang dur khrod dpa' chas rgyan du klub g.yas g.yon gnam lcags rdo rje sdig pa gdengs: rang rang rigs kyi yum dang 'khril sbyor rol: za byed gtum rngam sprul pa'i thog zer 'khyugs de rgyab sgo skyong rta phag seng sbrul gdong lcags zhags sgogs dril 'dzin cing gar chen bsgyur: gzigs sham zhing g.yang gsol bzhin phyed 'gying

rol me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbus su shar kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon dang : srog gi yi ges bskul te 'og min nas: ye shesapa rdo char bzhin dbab ste bstims spyan 'dren ni hū hrī rngams pa'i grong khyer zangs mdog dpal ri nas gdul dka' 'dul mdzad padma thod 'phreng rtsal 'jigs med rdo rto bu'i skur bzhengs la: snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs bsal phyir gshegs su gsol dug lnga rang mtshan gzul ba'i gdon tshogs dang : smon log bdud dpung 'dul ba'i / la babs: kun bzang thugs kyi rnal 'byor skal ldan la dgongs brgyud byin rlabs chig rdzogs dbang bskur zhig 37 ma hā gu ru padma kro dha bidu dha ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza gas gsol ni hrī skye med dbyings nas sgyu 'phrul bde chen gar rnam rol ma 'dres gtso 'khor dam tshig par: ye shes phyag rgya gnyis med mnyam pa na dam tshig dag pa po bsre bar bya oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni na mo gdod nas 'du 'bral ma mchis he ru ga: ye shes gsang sgog dag pa'i gzi byin ldan: 'khor 'das

stong pa chos sku'i dgongs pa can padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:6 sarba a ti pu ho:pra ti dza ho:mja 'bul ni hūṃ ༷gzung ba dag pas nyer spyod bdun gyi sprin:'dzinapa grol bas 'dod yon lnga yi dpal:dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakta'i skyems:chos kun mnyam sbyor bde stong dgongs pa'i gsang bdag mtshan rtog pa thad garabasgral ba'i rdzas re dog ro snyoms brtul zhugs mchod pa'i mchog:ting nge 'dzin las spros pa'i phyag rgya mo:rmad byung bkod rdzogs rig pas dang blang nas:padma drag po'igasang gsum bskang phyir 'bul:chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i dngos grub stol:snyed ma hā pañtsa pu dza khā hi bstod pa ni hūṃ 〉〉tshebasladabang phyug padma thod phreng rtsal:skugasum lhun rdzogs rigs kun 'dus pa'i dpal:bye ba phrag brgya'i 'dren ston thugs rje can gu ru gangs can mtsho la phyag 'tshal bstod:mam las skyes pa'i rdo rje la sogasapas:mdzad phrin rnam thar bgrang 'das blos mi dpag cir yang 'char ba'i bla ma thugs rje can:o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod:zhibalimi thul drag cing rtsub pa'i

rdo/— rigs 'dul bar rigs pa'i drag stsal rigs lngar bzhengs gza' the'u sde brgyad yongs kyi gtsug gis gtugs: dregs pa'i sgog bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgongs pa mi zad gter la mnga' mnyes shing : 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang ma tshogs 'du ba'i sgo: khros pa'i gar gyis srid gsum ar la gtadaḥ thabs mkhas he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sku yi gar ngoms 'dod khams dbyings su rol: gsung gi nga ros gzugs khams mtshan ma stong : thugs kyis gzigs pa'i gzugs med snyoms 'jug grol padma drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstodaX ༅gas pa niḥ hoḥ tha snyad chos la bdag dang mtshan mar bzung ༷ bskyed rim a 'thas rdzogs rim rtsis gdab can:gang yang sems kyis bcos pa'i chos nyid de: khyab brdal chos sku'i dgongs par bshags bgyi'oḥ badzra sa ma ya āX de ltar padma he ru ga'i sgrub pa smad du byung ba'i sgo rin pho srog las phang na'ang skal ldan bdud las rgyal ba dang ཿ bar chad sgog las grol ba dang phyin log blo las dpen pa dang dus kyi rgud pa bsal ba dang dmag 'khrugs mtshon cha zhi ba dang ཿ legs yon bkra shis sgo 'phel phyir bdag

nyid padma he ru gas thugasabacud sgrom rgya lasabasagate gnyisamed don gyi rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje laḥpha nor bu yi dpal du gdams dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥsam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lhazhesasprang ma nu nusaldan dred po la rje yo rgyan padma'i zhal dngos su gzigasanas gnyan po galu yi stag mo'i yang ོnga nas pha phog gi tshul du bstsal ba rang gzhan la phan phyir gnas de ru ra bar brisapa dge leg 'phelasabo maṅga lamaḥ

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcag me 'bar gyi dza cha lha lnga'i dril sgrub bzhugs so:/ dha rwa dza mā gas mā spyomi bdag nyid rtsa ba'i thugs ka rtsa gser gyi mchod rten tshon gang ba: seng khri tshad med bum pa bre: chos 'khor gdug 4 lter pad zla nyi ma'i khar gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur khro bo ni: ser nag khro gtum dpal chas rdzogs: g.yas g.yon 'khor lo zhags pa 'dzin:rje ni: rwa gdengs sayi tsha tsha 'phro: ste bar gser 'khor rtsub bcu pa'i: dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo hrī rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dal du sgom: rang dang drag khros gsang ba'i snying po'i bskor zer gyi 'byung po 'bog rgyal byed 'khor rtsibs khro bcus 'phrin las 'gyed phyogs bcu'i gdon sna/ srung gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin thugs mchog rol pa'i dal du bsgom: longs spyod 'khor lor rta mgrin ni: dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer mos:

bde chen 'khor lor gshin rje gshed rgyal kun sku yi dbang phyug gsal: skyed byed sprul pa'i 'khor lo phu yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga gsal: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo ru 'phrin las yaka me dbal sgom ba spu 'od lnga'i drwa gur 1nga : sprul pa sdig phag phra mos gtams: dpal kyi sgra gseb thod phreng rtsal: mthing gsal gri thod thod rnga sgrogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar sdud: sgrub mchog rtag tu byin gyis rlobs: de steng ye shes ga ru ṭa: dmar nag rlung gi gshog pa can: kring hring sgrogs shing klu gnyan gsol: bar chad 'byung po gzir zhing bskrad: ra bar padma 'dab stong gi: ze'u 'bru snang mtha' tshe dpag med bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: 'chi med tshe dbang bu la stsol: thugs dam chen po go cha'i lha: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal bar bskyed: ye shes me yi 'od zer 'bar: gtor byed rlung gi bu yug 'tshubs: dug gsum las skyes 'byung po rnams: zhi ba chen por bsregs sbyangs byed: stong gsal rig pa'i ting 'dzin sgom: 'di na rno la ngar bawa bgo shan tu zab pa'i man ngag yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya

ḍa brda thim lha zhesastag mo' yang rdzong nas skal bzang du thob pa'i cho skor rnamasaganasade ru saldan dpa' bosadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zen garmā kairti bgyisapa dge legasa'aphel maṅga lo

/ske/ sman rag gtor mchod 'bul ba niḥbyung āX hūḥchags pas ma gos ye grol snang mtha' yas:kunakhyab snying rje'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal:phrag brgya'i bla ma gu ru gangs can mtshor:sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtogs pa spor chos kyi lhun po dga' rab rdo rje dang :nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin shrī seng :snying thig srol 'dzin bī ma mi tra la:sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtogs pa spor:rdzogs chen ston pa dzñā na su tra dang :lta ba'i sgol 'dzin na ga rdzu na dang :yang dag mngon gyur hūṃ chen ka ra la:sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtogs pa spor bstan pa'i gzhi ma khri srong lde'u btsan dang:spyod pa'i srol 'dzin mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho:mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal la sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtog pa spor gsung gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang :nus mthus gter grub dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhabs smon lam dag pa khye'u chung lo tsā la:sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtog pa spor zab mo gter gyi char 'bebs bdud 'dul gling :sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpa' bo rol ba rtsal:

chos nyid klong rdol bdud 'jomasardo rje la: sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtog pa spor: snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma dang : dam tshig dag pa chos bdag bu slob tshogs gter gyi lde'u mig gzungs mar bcas pa la: sman gtor rakta'i mtshod 'bul rtog pa sbor padma drag rtsal me 'phreng yab yum dang go cha lha lnga drag rtsal rigs bzhi dang phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul khro bcu sgo skyong la sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul rtog pa spor: bka' yi srung ma sgog bdag gza' klu gsum: bcud kyi gnyer 'dzin dge bsnyen spyo kha ba: zab mo'i bstan srung dregs pa sde brgyad la sman gtor rakta'i mtshod 'bul phrin las sgrubs: padmas gnyer gtad gnyan po g.yu rtse dang : phug gsum ldong lnga gling drug dbang byed pa'i sgrub gnas srung ma gter gyi gnyer 'dzin la sman gtor rakta'i mchod 'bul grub 'bras stsol: tshe ma hā pañtsa rakta bā lirnya khā hi: dza:rdo rje lce yi dam tshig padmo yi: rdo rje sbyan gyi gsang bar hūṃ sgom te thabs shes theb srin rtse sbyar phyag rgya yis dpa' bo yab yum dbyer med bdud rtsi blang: reg myang bla med dngos grub

rdo/— mchog thob dmigs kwa ya sirnyi tshe wākka sirnyi āḥ tsitta sirnyihūṃ: sarba sirnyi hrīḥ de ltar dgyes mchod phul pa'i mthus rnal 'byor nyams chags rtog sgrib byang rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam skong nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas daro sa grub stsol don gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ze tshom med do sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu hya brda thim snyi ces snying nor chos kyi bdag po me tri'i mtshan can nas dar bcas bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul bzhi pa nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la

rdosgo zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi mdun bskyed dregs pa zil gnon bzhugs so:sgo/cha na mopadma kro dha ra dza ya mthumaspyo(skya'i bdag bskyed bsgom pa'i rnal 'dror pa mdun skyed drags po' da la bzhengs hū rang nyed drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi: rten dang brten par shar ba las zla ba chu zla ji bzhin du mdun skyed dbang chen dkyil 'khor ni rngams brjid dur khrod bkod rdzogs dbus: rab 'jigs thod pa'i sku mkhar 1nga pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar dregs pa zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i: drag po me yi 'phreng ba can: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas mthing g.yon dkar sbyan dgu 'khrug zhal gdengs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs ha ha hūṃ phaṭa nga ro sgrogs: dmar ser ral ba srid rtser 'byil thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i 'phan nyi zla'i snyan cha 'od stong 'byugs dur khrod dpal chas rgyan du klubs gar dgu rngams pa'i gzi byin can: rtsa phyag rdo rje sdig pa gdengs de 'og gri gug bhan dmar 'dzin de 'og ral

gri kha ṭwāṃ ga: nyon drug gdon gyi gshed du bsgoms: sku las me ri me dpung 'phro: khro chung sdig phag bu yug 'dzabs: yum mchog bde chen rnal 'byor ma: mthing gsal gri thoda'adzin dang spyor: bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin gyis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid mkha' ru sdud: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: ser nag ral gri po ti 'dzin: mgrinapar padma dbang chen rgyal dmar nag thod dbyug sbrul zhags bsten: thug gar gsang bdag gtum po mthing gnam lcags rdo rje bsdigs mdzub bsgyur: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni: dbus mthing phyogs mdog gri thod 'dzin: gsang gnas yaku me dbal ljang tho chen zhags pa gdengs thabs 'dzin: kun kyang khro gtum dpal chas rdzogs rab 'bar me yi klong du bskyed: drag po'i ral gseb thod phreng rtsal: mthing gsal kha ṭaṃ bhan dmar 'dzin: gru mor thod rnga bkal ba'i sgras: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskul dur khrod rus rgyan me 1nga bzhengs de steng ye shes ga ru ṭa: dmar nag me yi phung po can: klu gnyan gtod kyi gshed du shar: rwa bar sangs rgyas snang mtha'

ḍa yas:dmar gsal tshi mda' bum pa 'dzin:bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis bskor :sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs:ye shes dwangs ma'i por gsal phyi rim padma 'dab bzhi la:shar du rdo rje drag po rtsal dkar gsal rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin lho ru ratna drag po rtsal:ser nag be con dur phag 'dzin:nub tu drag po rtsal:dmar nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin:byang du garma drag po rtsal:ljang nag ral gri khyung nag 'dzin kun kyang dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs:khro gtum rdzogs me klong 'bying:de yi phyi rim sgo bzhi la:gdong can mkha' 'gro mched bzhi yis:lcags zhags sgrog dril bhanta 'dzin:'phrin las bzhi yi las la rgyu de rgyab sa pa sde brgyad ni:mtsho la gza' skar bkra ba bzhin:gtum rngams 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha bsnams:gus 'dud bcas te 'phrin las sgrub gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' / dang :stobs ldan ging dang laṅka'i tshogs:ma 'dres nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin gsal:kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru dang :rang rang srog gi sa bon las:'od 'phros

dag pa'i zhing rnam dang rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas: rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i tshogs: padma drag po'i rnam pa sa spyan drangs bdag mdun so so la dbyer med du ma ro gcig bsre padma kro ta sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa ma yā dza dza 〉ཿbe ho: dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs bstims dam ye gnyis med bzhugs gsol gdab gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal zhing rmad byung tinga'adzin mchod pa bskang brda dang rtags kyisabastod pa bya ting 'dzin dmigasapas 'dzab rgyun skyong 'phrin la rnam bzhir mnga' dbang bsgyur grub pa brgyad kyi yon ma thob padma he ru'i gtan srid zin ze tshom med do rdorje'i bka' sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhesapa 'di'ang khyung tshang stag mo'i rdzong nas kho bo sprang spyon nusaldan dpa' bo la rje mo rgyan sang rgyasaganyisapa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byasate zab gter gyichosaskor 'di pha phog gi tshul du bstsal ba'o/ dusader chosabadag dpa' bo dpa' mo rnamasakyis bkra shisadage ba'i skyes dang bcasate bskul ngor gnasade ru dag par phab pa'iyi gepa ni gan kerti bgyis pa dge leg 'phel sarba ma lam̐

ḍa dbang bskur rgyasagadab ni rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas bskul: rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te bum pa bdud rgyun can gyi dbang bskur sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ: bdud rtsis sku gang dri ma dag bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa yi ye / chen po mngon gyur tshe lhag ma yar 'khyil dbu can gyur e oṃ swā hūṃ hā: slang yang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dra mnga' gsol 'gyur med rgyas gdab phyir gnas gsum rdo phyag rgya yi sku gsung thugs su dbang bskur ro kā ya wākka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra slar yang dam srog lcags kyu yis rnga yab gling nas o rgyan rje: lo paṇa dpa' bo mkha' 'i/ sprin spyan drangs bdag mdun bum gtor dang lhar gsal rim bur sib sib bstim: slo sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri sha ya ho sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya sa: dam gi phyag rgya lha mo bzhisaganyisasu med par bsre bar bya'o 'di yang snying nor me tri'i ngor nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes so sarba ma li

/ zab chos dri med 1nga yangs las drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi 'dzab dgongs tshangs pa'i 'byug sgra bzhugs so: / padma kro dha rā dza ya masam〉(21 ting 'dzin bskyed rim brtan po yis 'dzab dgongs tshangs pa'i 'byug sgra 'dis ma rtog 'byung po zal gnon cing ye shes thugs kyi dbang snang ba'i rang bzhin padma thod 'phreng rtsal: stong nyid gar dbang ye shes mtsho rgyal dbyings zung 'jug phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yi rgyal kun rdzogs bskul: snying po ye shes thug kyi 'khor lo yi: gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'od zer spro bsdu byas 'khor 'das dpal yon dwangs ma gcig tu dril yongs thob dmigs ting 'dzin zag med dgongs pa'i gzi byin gyis snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos skur sad: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye pa kun thugs kyi rdo rje mngon gyur ngang: ma āḥhūṃ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dza sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: dgongs pa chos nyid don la bzhag 'phro 'du 'phran

las rta la drangs rgyal kun dbang byin daro sa grub bskul rig 'dzin mchog gi sa la sbyor sa ma yu de nas sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni 66 dpa' pa yab (1bde chen nas thabs kyi rang bzhin me yis bskul byang chub sems kyi mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lnga ldan dgyes pa bskang: 'khor 'das dpal yon gcig tu dril dpa' mo yum gyi mkha' dbyings nas shes rab 'dzab rgyun thabs kyis bskul: tsand+ra'i bcud chen spro bsdu yis: dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams myong zhing: ye shes thugs kyi dbang thob dmigs: lo āḥ/ lo artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i gzi byin gyis: 'khor 'das dpal yon dngas ma 'askul: sa ma yā de nas la sbyor 'dzab dmigs ni hūṃ hrīḥ ma skyes stong pa chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes gsal ba'i klong yangs nas: ma 'dres shar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha kun kyang 'dzab kyi dgongs pas bskul 'phrin las rnam bzhi lcan grub cing: 'khor bcas spi dpal mchog thob dmigs: tshe ya marnya ka hya bṛ wa badzra pa ṇi ḍagli ni haḥriX ni sa ༷badzra hūṃ yakā hūṃ raku 〉ཿaX ya ma duḥrtsatsamanaḥn sa ma

/// ya:/ hūṃ sno/ hūṃ 〉ཿ/ hūṃ sno/sating 'dzin 'dzab kyi mchod sprin spro 'phrin las dmigs pas sde kha bsgyur sa ma shā yang cig spya dril bzlas sngags ni oṃ a mi dhe wa a yuḥsirnyi (ཿkhrom ga ru ṭa hūṃ phaṭa badzra ma hā gu ru sarba / hriṣṭi 'awa kṛ ta na na hūṃḥrgya kṛ wa (ཿbadzra pa ṇi shā:ṭākki ni haX ri niḥsaḥ(ཿbadzra nyuX yaka /༷ rakru / badzra ratna padma sarmā he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa:badzra kro ta hūṃ ka ra snyi dza ya ni lan dan tra ya manta ka ārya a tsa la hya snyi wa a pa ra tsitta a dṛ ta kun li tre lo kya bhi dza ya ma hā ba la gha ha na da ha pa tsa bhanta shā lu tinyi tshisto bhisto sbo ṭa sarba dzaḥ/ baṃ ho aḥyaḥmalngag tshamigaḥn ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā 'phrin las gcig rdzogs bzlas sngags 'dis dug gsum gdon gyi snying khrag lhud dregs pa sde brgyad las la 'chun gcor 'das dpal yon dbang du ra rag 'dzin sal ngesapar sbyor the med do rdo rje bka' sa ma phu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang khyung tsha gam po g.yu rtse' yang rdzong ོ po'i tshogasaston spro skabs bdag sprang spyon nusaldan dpa' bo la rje smyo rgyan chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas nas ka li pra tsa li tsa dur mu kha he le (ཿzhes o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i bdo' skad du gsung pa'i don chos sde 'di nyid nges par gsal

ba'o/ lasakyi bskul ba'i chos bdag dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis dam tshig gi rdzas dang mos gus yis bskul ba don da ldan phyir gnas de nyid du dag par phab pa' yi ge pa na lung zin ga kairti bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sabo maṅga le

/sgo 'dzab kha dbye ba ni hūṃ mtshul phaṭa dza: ye rdzogs rang gsal gu ru zhi drag dal: dgongs brgyud gzi yis gzigs pa lam snang shar: snang grags dran rig bla ma he ru gas dgra gsum bdud bzhi g.yang sa drug bcom nas ma dag dmigs med dag pa rab 'byams klong 'khrul ba ar gtad rig pa nyag gcig ngang: sku gsum lhun rdzogs 'grub pa skal pa bzang: rtsa sngags bzla 'di yang spyo rgan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nus ldan pas so ༄/ 'dzab bskul ni hū dzaḥ bzhengs shig rnga yab dpal gyi ri nas bzhengs: bskul lo zhal bzhes thugs dam dus la bab: gzugs sku 'gags med nyi zla'i zer bzhin stsol: gdul bya nyon mongs smag rum bsal bar mdzod: skal ldan rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed: tshe chos gong 'phel klong rdol shes rab kyis: drangs te 'phags nor yid bzhin re skongs char: zab gsang sgom sgrub chos rgyal bdag la stsol: skyabs gcig rdo rje 'chang gi rjes zin nas: bya ba las kyi 'khor los gzhan phan

'grub: 1gas pa thos bsam 'khor los bstan pa zin: spongs ba bsam gtan 'khor los lam mthar phyin: padma he ru ka dpal myur 'grub shog: sgrub sngags bzla 'di yang dgong pa'i blta stangs kyis gzir tshe ḍakki mang pos glu 'di ltar blangs so sa ma wā nus ldan pas so // go cha lha lnga rgyan gyi shog dril rgya bzlas dmigs ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lha de'i thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can spros tshe bdag snang ba mtha' yas yab yum skye 'chi med pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i 'phrin las bskul gdug pa 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can padma ga ru ṇa dug gsum rang mtshan du gol ba'i gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i las la bskul: skyabs gcig padma thod 'phreng rtsal skal ldan sgrub mchog rjes su 'dzin zhing nyams rtogs spel ba'i dgongs pa la bskul rtsa gnas su bzhugs pa'i he ru ka thams cad bde stong dga' ba bzhi'i don la bskul te sgyu lus kyi zag pa bcom te dngas ma'i he ru ka nyid du dag smin rdzogs pa dang : phyi nang

rdo/ snod bcud kyi khro bo dang khro mo thams cad bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'dzab rgyun la bskul ba'i gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad nye 'du mdzad cing: snang grags rig gsum o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du shar nas bde ba mchog gi rdo rdzel longs spyod par dmigs la:skyed a mi dhe wasogs tsamigaḥnaḥ.a nu rā ga bho dhi tsitta/ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu a we sha ya a ā: de ltar bzlas pas nyams rtogs 'phel tshe bsod ye shes yon tan 'phel sa ma mā zab pa'i shog dril log tu gab skal ba can gyi dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zhes snying nor mi tri dang pra tshwa'i mtshan can la nusaldan pas gus phul sarba masgo lam

rdo/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las: las bzhi'i sngags kyi lde kha bsgyur ba rtsa ba'i dum bu gcig bzhugs so:rdo/ na mo gu ru kro dha rā dza ya: thosgogi(31 bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang sgrub dang skrub pho grub pa'i dus las sbyor 'dzab kha bsgyur rims ni rang nyid padma drag poragasal ba'i sku las bsil zer zla ba'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzis chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i rdul tshogs ka nas dag cing: ma rig 'khrul ba'i rba klong rang sar skems la: rnam smin sgyu lus kyi phung po lha ru sad de snang zhen gdos mtshan gyi dri ma mtha' dag zhi zhing rten 'byung nad gdon bgegs sogs nyer 'che'i rkyen snang ma lus pa grol nas:rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du dag smin rdzogs nas zhi ba'i 'brin las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub par dmigs la: sgrub sngags mthar nad gdon 'jigs tshogs shirnyi ku ru ye swāhā: zhi sngags bung ba'i rgyang glu ltar gyer la 'phrin las grub par bya'o yang rang nyid padma drag por gsal ba'i sku dang sngags phreng las gser mdog rin chen sgron me'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i

gzis rgyal ba'i mkhyen nus brtse ba'i ye shes yon tan thams cad bskul ba dang lha dang drang sgong nyi zla 'byung bzhi snod bcud brtan gamo'i dngas bcud dpal yon ma lus pa dril ba dang : mar 'phros ba'i 'gro ba'i gnas yul gyi bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs nas thams cad rig 'dzin gyi zhing du sad pa dang : bdag cag skal ldan sgrub pa po rnams la skye 'chi med pa'i tshe nub pa bral ba'i dbang thang: dbul phung med pa'i bsod nams: zag pa zad pa'i nyams rtogs 'byul ba dag pa'i 'bras bu: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rgyal srid tshe 'di nyid la thob cing 'phrin las rab 'byams rgyas shing phri gang dang bral bar bsam la sgrub sngags mthar tshe dpal 'byor drug puṣṭi ku ru ye swā hā rgyas sngags seng gesa'agyed dang ldan par bzlasapas tshe dpal yon ma brgya che rgyun ring du 'grub par bzla'o yang rang nyid padma drag por gsal ba'i sngags 'phreng dang sbyor mtshams las spros pa'i 'od zer rta bdun 'bar ba'i gzis: 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon bde stong gi dngas ma thams cad 'ub 'ub tu bsdus shing dril ba dang ཿ gnas yul rigs sngags zhing skyes kyi rdo rje rnal

rdo/— 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kun nye 'du mdzad cing sbyor ba bdun gyi 'phrin las la brten nas kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi yon tan mngon du byed pa dang khyad par 'jig rten dregs pa can zhi ba dang rgyas pas btul du mi rung ba dag: rnal 'byor ba'i lta dgongs ting nge 'dzin gyis ring ba khugs su gzhug: 'khyil ba rta la drangs log sdug mtha' la gtad nas dam can dregs pa pho mo'i srog snying phyi nang gnyis med du 'phrog nas mthong khol mngon sum byung nas dbang gi 'phrin las gang brtsam thogs med yid bzhin du 'grub par bsam la: sgrub sngagasamathar 'gyesar 'das dregs tshogs wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang sngags spyang mo'i mduraglus bskul na bsam pa tsam kyis 'di bzhin du 'byung ba la 'bad do yang rang nyid padma drag por gsal ba'i sku las pho nya mtshon thun sdig phag grangs med pa 'phros nas: ma rig pa gsum gyi du tra yul med du bsgral zhing ā 'thas kyi bdud bzhi ro snyoms su bshig 'gro drug gi gnas yul gzhi rtsa dang bral bar stong pa rten med du bshigs par bsam pa dang : khyad par dam log zhing bcu tshangs ba thams

cad rnam smin gyi mi sdug pa'i phyir du spu gri so 'thab pa'i mtshon dbal la bkod nas las ngan pa'i rgyun gcod bag chags kyi grong khyer bshigs: zhabrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas pa'i mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'bad med du 'grub par bsam la sgrub sngags mthar badzra (ཿ yakka hūṃḥ raka ྅༷ aḥyaḥmaḥduḥnasatsaḥ shashaḥ gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa: stag mos sha chen la rol ba'i 'dzab glus mngon spyod drag po' phrin las grub pa la 'bad do dus la bab pa'i tshe dngos grub skyol bskul ni hūṃ hrīḥ rtsa ba klu gnas sked pa raka'i zhing: rtse mo 37 rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas padma rgyal po rje 'bangs lo paṇa bcas: thugs dam ma g.yel dam tshig chen pos dgongs: bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bsgoms bzlas chud ma gsan yal yol btang snyoms le lo mi mdzad par: snying nas da gzigs drin chen sprul ba'i sku: dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis brda bstod bro gar bsgyur: dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis nyams dga' dngas spro bskyed: ging dang lang ga'i rtags mtshan bzang po ston: chos skyong dregs pas phyi nang rkyen gegs sol: dngos grub rdzas la gzi byin nus mthu bskyed

rdosgo— myong grol rig 'dzin sa thob skal bzang stsol don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzod dam tshig can rtsa sngagasamathar kwa ya sirnyi maḥ wākka sirnyi ā tsitta sirnyi (ཿsarba sirnyi trīX stong tshig gis mchod cing bstod la dusasu dngos grub bskul len rgya cher bya'o chos ba gnad che 'dzan las myur rno la ngar btags ci bzhin no sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes snying nor pradzñā dang me tri zung gis mos ngor nus ldan pas spel ba dge legs 'phel

/ཿ zab chos dri med 1nga yangs las gsang ba'i nyams len hūṃ sgrub dregs pa ar gtad zhes bya bzhugs so:du kro dha ra dza ya 5365za 'bru gzhong dbus su lha phur bkod da la'i ldang khrir bzhugs su gsol rnal 'byor dam tshig dag pa yis dgongs pa'i ngang bskyang 'di skad do rdo khrod klong 'bar ba'i thod mkhar me rlung dbus:bdag mdun padma drag po rtsal:dmar nag rdo rje lcags phur gdengs:khro gtum gar dgu'i dbal ngar zur gsum pa:dus gsum gdon gyi snying la zug:me rlung rab 'bar 'tshubs ma'i klong:che btsan 'gran zla bral bar gsal:srog gas pa sde brgyad 'dar zhing sngangs:ma rig 'khor ba'i rba klong skem:ye shes thugs kyi btsan sa 'dzin rdo rje srin po'i ngur sgra sgrogs yang ni ba'i sku chog dbal ngar can:dam sri 'byung po'i gshed du che khro rgyal stobs 'dus dal du sgom:rdo rje srin po'i ngur glu len:yang ni gtor ma'i

lha tshogs kyang: drag po me yi 'phreng ba can: 'big byed dpal ngar ldan pa yis: pho bdud thams cad g.yas su bsgyur: mo gdon thams cad g.yon du bsgyur: dam sri 'byung po phye mar 'thag bzod dka'i bkrag mdangs 'bar bar dmigs: rdo rje srin pos hūṃ glu len: yang ni bdag mdun bum gtor lha: kun kyang mthing nag 'bar ba'i gar phyag gnyis gdab pur 'dril zhing 'debs: zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bzod par dka': dbal phur rgyal bsen sgog la gzir me dang rlung gi gzi byin 'khyugs dregs pa sde brgyad ar la gtad khams gsum 'khor ba stong par byed: ha la gdong drug gar spros te: rdo rje srin po'i ngur glu len: sam mā rjesasu dngos grub len pa'i dus hūṃ hrīḥ rang bzhin snod mchog pho brang mtshan rdzogs dbus: dam rdzas rmad byung dpal chen sgrub phur rnams: padma drag po'i dal dang gnyis su med: byin rlabs yongs rdzogs 'phrin lasa'adus pa'i dbang: skal ldan sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dngos grub dang: mthu stobs rmad byung dpal chen stobs kyi dbang : gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa'i

ḍa 'phrin las rgyun da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol: he ru ka sarba sirnyi pha la a la la ho de ltar drag sgrub rnal 'byor na bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal nyams yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel don gnyis lhun grub the mi tshom sa ma phu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces lung zin du mas bskul pa dang bri gzhi shog gu'i mthun skyen sbyor ba po rnams kyi thugs bzhed skang phyir kho bo sprang dus ldan dpa' bos sbas yul drag ma'i yang rdzong nas zab mdzod kyi brda gsang las dag par pha ba pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma kirtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo le

/ske zab chos dri med klong yangs las:drag po gnam lcags me 'phreng rtsal la brten nas nyon mongs lha 'dre'i 'khrul sbubs bshogs pa thugs rjes lcags kyu bzhugs so ༄/ na mo gu ru padhwa kro dha rā dza ya za/gru41masnga1 ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i 'dre rsā mongasa.a 'thas 'jul ba'i gdon bdag 'dzin rang khar spyod pa'i sri btsun gzugasaspyang gi rgyab ser dang sngags pa dam med spyod pa 'chol bu med bdud mo sgog la rngams de dag dus sri ldang nas su gsang sngagasarnal 'byor sgrub la 'tshe de dag 'khrul ba rtsad bcad nas rang la rang ngo shes pa'i phyir zugs rje'i lcags kyu 'dir brtson na rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par ra sa ma mā sder ram kha phod chag bral nang 'byu sna tshwa rgog g.yer ma dang la phug lo ma zas kyi rigs lan chags grangs mang bsags pa'i khar thal ba bag tsam bkram pa ni sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lha 'dre'i yid dang mthun pa ra spro de nas drag po' nga rgyal gyis rnyi yig la ni 'gugs bstim ni na mo mdzadag gsum kun dngos lhag pa'i lha:padma drag po'i bden stobs kyis nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i lha 'dre rnams:ming byang 'di la gnyis med khug:lan gsum mam dgu brjod nyes pa

bsgrags pa ni kyi ma rig pa las 'khrul ba'i 'dre: nyon mongs dug lnga rang mtshan bzung: nga khyod 'dzin pa yang yang 'thas: zhe sdang dbang gis 'gro la 'tshe: 'dod chags las kyis dpal 'byor rlom: gti mug rmongs pas gnod pa'i sems: phrag dog dbang gis kun la rtsod: nga rgyal rgyas pas 'khor bar 'khyams shin tu nyams thag 'khrul ba'i gdon yang cig rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon gsang sngags bden pa'i tshig la gson: sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin la bsad pa'i lan chags srog la 'ong: brtung na nad ni mang bar 'gyur: dpal 'byor 'phrog na nor dbul zhing: ci byas rang gi lus su smin: sdug bsngal tshor ba sems kyis myong: rgyu 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i bka':chos kun rten 'brel rmi lam tsam: 'di la zhen chags ma byed par: rang snang 'khrul bar ngo shes nas: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rjes su snyogs: de don khyed kyis ma brjed cig:a āḥ gshin lcags pra ti bā lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan grangs nyer gcig gis bsngos la 'di skad gyer hrī nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos bden gnyis bslu med bden

rdo/— pa mngon sum mthong: sems can nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i myos pa la: bde gshegs thugs rje'i 'od lam dam chos ston: gzugs su snang ba snang stong zung 'jug ste: yi dam rgyal ba'i sku ru lam du khyer: sgra ru grags pa grags stong chos sgra ste: yi dam rgyal ba'i bsnyen sngags dang du longs: sems kyi 'gyu 'phro rang grol 'dus ma byas:rig stong yi dam thugs la longs spyod cig: sna tshogs ma 'gags rang grol rgyan du 'chong: der 'dzin spros pa bral ba'i rang sar zhog: gang shar rang grol ye shes don la ltos:rtog dpyod mtshan ma spros bral ngang la zhog: 'khor 'das bde sdug sems kyi byed las te: re dog ro snyoms sku gsum ngang la zhog: smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin:dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam chen po ste: 'di don rtogs na 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal: khyod nyid bde gshegs kun gyi sras su 'gyur: a a phaṭa: mashāsagacod na ༷ snang srid gdod nasadag pa sku gsum klong: don dam rang ngo shes pa lta ba'i dbyings gzhes med thig le mngon gyur bsgom pa'i gnad: dag mnyam rang ngo shes pa spyod pa'i bab: de

don rtogs na gnod bya gnod byed dngaḥng bdag gdon gyi ming yang mi dmigs so:'di don ma rtog 'byul ba'i sems can rnams:ye shes 'phrul gyi mgo mas rab gzir ste/stong nyid spros dang bral ba'i dbyings su bskrad:don dam ye shes mtshon chas mtshams bcad do:/ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab don dam srung ba'i rwa gur phub sa ma ku'askoskoshegatu zab pa'i chosadusakyi snyigasamar gyur pa na sem ༅ nyon mongs la ba'i gdon grangasamang bu yug bgo tu 'a sa de la thabasa'adi shin du gnad chosabyed pho charkyen lasagrol sems༅ yongasalabade skyida'abyupand mug mtshon gsag rgud pa zhi legasatshog yar lnga'i zla ltar 'phel nag phyogathagadug pa'i mgo 'phang dma' dkar phyogasadabu 'phang mtho zhing btsan nag po'i rig rnamasamago'aphang dma' thamasacad 'di yi yonatan las 'byung bar ra ro gdon mi za bka' 'di rgyal chen sku lnga dang dge bsnyen spyo khasathub par srungs dam nyam lag tu ma shor zhig thugs kyi grasadang 'phrad par shog sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim snyi zhesapa'adi'ang sngagasagazhon bkra rab brten nasalha reg bcasabasku'atshar kho ོ sa na rdo mkha' 'grogasang ba'i 'phrul yig lasazhal sate dag bar phab pa'i yige pa ni me dra dhwa dza bgyi pa dge legasa'aphel sarba maṅga le

rdo/rdo zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag pos 'khrul ba sbub bshigs pa'i bdag mdun bum pa'i bskyed bzlas gzhan phan thugs rje'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ༄/ na mo padma kro dha rā dza dṛ he ru ka la ya gzhig rsā86) 'bar ba'i sku mchog khros pa'i brtul zhugs 4nga padma he ru ka la phyag la' lo nyon mongs rang mtshan gol ba'i gdon tshogasarnams ye shesachosaskur sad byed 'di kho na de la bdag mdun bum pa'i bskyed bzlas las dang po bdag bskyed bsgom pa 'di lta ste stong pa'i ngang las dag chen 'od gsal ba'i zhing khams rgya tshad bzung las 'das pa ngo mtshar ba'i rgyan dang bkod pa rnams par mtha' yas pas yongs su mjes shing phun sum tshogs par brgyan pa 'od lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su: rin po che'i khri rkang glang chen brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khar: sna tshogs pad mo rab tu 'dzum zhing gyes pa'i steng rta bdun dang ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan gyi khar bdag nyid sangs rgyas mi 'byugs pa sku mdog sngon po sprul sku'i cha lugs can g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam

gzhag gis rdo rje sngon po bsten pa: zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing mdzod spu dang sku'i 'od zer gyis ngan song gi 'gro ba rnams dang dmigs yul gang na gnasapa de'i lus dang sems rnam par mi 'khrugs shing gri rigs bco rgyad gyi gdug pa'i bsam sbyor dang rgol ba ngan pa zhi zhing khams gsum gyi 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i bsdus pa rnams la thugs rje bsil ba'i chu rgyun gyis bde ba mchog la bkod cing bag chag kyi gnas yul thams cad ma gnas par sbyangs bar dmigs la: na mo ratna tra ya ya: bsgo rka ka ni keka ni: ro tsa ni ro tsa ni: to ṭa tro ṭa niX tra sa ni tra sa ni: pra ti ha na pra ti ha na sarba garma pa ram̐ pa ra ṇi me sarba sa twa nañtsaswā sna sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib bgachags thams cad shidzña ku ru swā shā zhes sems can rnams la brtse ba'i snying rje tshad med pas ci nus su bzla'o mthar smon lam gdab pa ni rku mgon med 'a1sna ba nyam thag snying rje'i yul: lasanyon dbang gyur nyon mongs gdung ba can gzhan gnod spyod pa rtsub cing sgog la rgol: de dag 'khrul snang rang sar grol ba'i phyir thabs kyis cho ga zab mo 'di byas pas:

ḍa 'gro ba ma grol grol dang ma bsgral bsgral: dbugs dbyungs mya ngan 'das la 'god gyur cig gang na gnas pa'i yul zhen bag chags grol 'khrul ba ga bzung lus sems mdud rgya chad gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma rang grol te: bde gshegs mi 'khrugs gdul byar 'gyur bar 31ga: lan gsum gdabs de nas mdun ) bsgom pa ni hrīḥ tsitta badzra sa ma ya hā stong pa'i ngang las sbyo las rin po che'i bum pa rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan ba'i dbus su: ma chags padma 'dab brgyad dang nyi ma zla ba zhal sbyor ba'i khar: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo ba 'dren pa'i pho nya: gsung gi dbang phyug padma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa: dmar la dkar ba'i gzi 'od 'bar ba bcu drug lon pa'i nod can: phyag g.yas rig pa mi 'gyur ba'i mtshon don gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa la bsdigs pa: g.yon pa snang stong bhanta bdud rtsi tshe bum dpag gsam shing gis kha rgyan

can lte bar brten pa: kha ṭaṃ ka theg rim brgyan 'phreng rdzogs pa yum lha lcam gyi ngo bo mchan khung g.yon du 'chang ba: rgyal po rol ba'i rtabs su bzhugs shing pad zhwa sgro dar melong rdo rje phyed pa'i tog ldan dbu la gsol zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du 'phro 'gyed pa: rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po 'dung ma dmar po phod chen mthing nag chos gos dmar ser za 'og gi ber chen sag lho 'ja' ris can rnams legs par gsol ba: de yi thugs gar pad zla'i khar stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyal po 'jin rten dbang phyug dkar gsal skyabs sbyin dang pad 'phreng 'dzin pa: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gdan la rol zhing longs sku'i brgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes par gsol ba: sku'i 'od zer gyis ngan song gi 'gro ba mtha' dag sgrol bar mdzad pa: de'i thugs gar 'od lnga zlum 'khyil gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdul bral shintu rnam par dag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can sprul ba sku'i cha lugs can thugs sgog hrīḥyig dang bcas pa gsal ba tsam gyis 'dor ba dong sprugs byed pa'i ded dpon: bod rje 'bangs lo paṇa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i

ḍa sprin phung ltar 'thib pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes pa'i tshogs spyan drangs la bstim mo: nyu trīX rnga yab dang mibo gru 'dzin zhing: bde chen padma brtsegs pa'i klong dkyil nas: 'gro ba'i 'dren ston rgyal ba 'od dpag med: sras dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol /sa rje'i gter chen 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: gang la gang 'dul thabs mkhas mdzad pa can zhi dang khro tshul rnams 'gyur bsam mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren phyir /sa 'dir gshegs su gsol: mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig padma 'byung: gu ru mtshan brgyad 'gro 'dul ston pa drug 'phrul mtshan nyer lnga rgyal tshabs sprul par bcas /sa 'dir 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol: tho badzra sa ma ya dza dza: trīḥ sna tshogs pad gdan nyi zla mdzes pa'i khar: 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje'i gter chen po / 'byung gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas: gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren phyir bzhugs su gsol: sam ya st+waṃ: na mo: ma bcos skye 'gags 'gyur med ye shes sku gang

'dul mdzad pa phrin las mthu mnga' ba'i padma 'byung gnas sku gsum dkyil 'khor la: ma rig nyon mongs dag phyir phyag mchod 'bul sa ma ya na moho trīX sngags kyidaga' ston mchod yon zhabs bsil dang: me tog sdug spos ma me dri zhal rol: dbyings las spros te ye shes dbyings su 'bul: nyon mongs 'gro khams 'dren par mdzad dugasol sa badzra a rpādu pursha dhu pe a lo ke gharnye ne wi hye shapta pra titstsha ā /: trī stong gsum khams na lha rdzas mchod 'os pa'i: mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan 'gyur sgra yirigs zhim pa'i dri dang mngar skyur ro sna tshogs: 'jam mnyen reg bya dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sgo badzra du pa shabha gharnye ra sa sparnye pra titstsha ā hūṃḥtrī: mig la ya mtshan yidal bde sbyin cing reg na dga' ster rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdangs ldan rnams: sku gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul oṃbadzra wā phye mā le girti nirti garma mu tra pra titstsha ā hūṃ:trīḥrtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a dṛ ta: sku gsum rgyal ba dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi: bka' drin zla bral bla ma thams

— cad la: sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi: trī: rten 'brel rtsa ba rlung sems bsgral pa'i khrag bde stong kha sbyor sa pa bcom pa'i skyems: sngags kyi gsang chen rakta tshar gsum bsgrengs: don gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ma hā rakta khā hi: hrīX stong chen gzheng par nga ba'i dpal bsgos bkod: 'dod yon phun tshogs ro mchog brgya dang ldan: mdzes sgeg yid 'ong lha mo'i gar dang bcas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir la: ma hā ba bla ta kha hi: hrīḥ snang ba dbang chen stong pa phag mo yum: zung 'jug rtsal mdangs 'khor 'das byang chub sems: bde chen dwangs ma lnga ru bcud dril de lhan bla ma'i gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul sto dhi tsitta ma hā su kha ho: / trīX gsung gi rdo rje padma 'dzum pa'i zhal: bde ba chen pos rjes chags bzhad pa'i gar: 'dren pa'i la gyur rdul bral rnam dag sku: 'od dpag med mgon chos sku'i rgyal la bstod: tshad med thugs rje'i 'od zer bsam mtha' yas: 'dren stobs 'phrin las nam mkha'i pha

mthar brdal: chags thogs ras med rtag par gdul bya'i skyabs: spyan ras gzigs dbang nam mkha'i rgyal la bstod ko sha'i mtsho gling bram ze ge sar lhum: rang byung sangs rgyas skye shi gnas mi mnga': tshe yi rig 'dzin rje btsun thod 'phreng rtsal: padma 'byung gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bstod: thugs grog hrīḥyig la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: 'phags pa mchod: sems can gyi don byas 'khrul ba'i gnas yul sbyangs rig drug gi sa bon skem: slar 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus bumalhar thim bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar dmigs la: na mo ratna tra ya ya na mo ārla a mi ta bha yā: ta thā ga ta yā: arta te samyakle brnya mā: nam ārya a wa lo zhi te shā ra yā bo dhi sa twa ya: ma hā sa twa ya: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka yā: ma hā padma saṃ bha we: tadu tha: shuddhi bi shudhe shudhe e ge shukhye akṣi: shwa dha ni bi shwa dha ni: ga ga nibi shā dha ni: tsitta bi shā dha ni: a wa ra ṇa bi shwa ni: karmā a wa ra ṇi bi shā dha ni: ha na ha na: sarba a wa ra ṇa ni: da ha da ha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni: pā tsa pā tsa pañtsa a nan tadu ni

rdosgo padme padme a kṣi padma nirma mye: ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭaḥ ha ha ha ha: saṃ dza lo su nya dza li: sirnyi wa le swā hā: 'a aḥshaXsatshomaḥnya ci nus bzlas mthar sngags kyis mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī ma bcos spros bral bla ma snang mtha' yas: bde chen longs spyod bla ma spyan ras gzigs: pad sdong las phyon bla ma thod 'phreng rtsal: sku gsum lhun rdzogs dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdud rtsi ye shes gyi chu rgyun gang 'dul 'gro ba'i 'dren byed dam par gyur smon lam ni hrī bdag lus sus mthong 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib dag: ngag sgra gsung gyur bdud rtsis 'gro khams smin: chos dbyings ye shes rtsi yis 'gro khams grol: gang 'brel don ldan rig 'dzin gral thob re ga: las bum sgrub pa ni oṃ su bha wa sogs stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du rang byung gi gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che bar pad nyi'i khar: / las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang : g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa khro bo' chas du ma rdzogs shing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong du: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi g.yas 'byeng gi

tshul du rol ba'i thugs srog las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims: nyu ཿ rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: 'jigs tshogs mthar mdzad khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyel 'bar ba'i gar gyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i gdan la bzhugs: rtse gcig gus pas brda yis gar phyag 'tshal o badzra sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya st+waṃ: a ti pu ho: nyu trīḥ 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu can bdud rtsi 'khyil: ye shes khro bo chen po dgyes bya'i phyir: bla med mchog gi mchod pa rnams pa lnga bzhes la 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: badzra a rghaṃ sogs shapta pra ti tstsha ā hūṃḥ hūṃ trī skye med chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang 'gags med ye shes gar mdzad he ru ga: 'phrin las lhun grub khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil: las rnams mtha' ru phyin phyir bdag gis bstod thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng bu nyiḥlngang nag la sngags 'phreng gis g.yas su 'khor ba las zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyan bab pas bum pa gang bar dmigs la o badzra a bṛ ta satsholi ha na

/ / ha na hūṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brjod oṃ badzra a mṛ ta utta ka hūṃ phaṭa: ci nus bzla mthar mchod cing bstod la smon lam ni gang zhig bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis:bdag gzhan rgyud la gnas pa'i nyon sgrib dang : shes bya'i bag chags dri ma sbyang ba'i slad: ye shes bdud rtsi 'bebs par mdzad du gsol: lha 'od du zhu ba las bum chu dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsi gyur: gri sman sgrub pa ni rjeX rin chen las grub gzhal med khang mjes nang: padma zla steng sangs rgyas sman gyi bla: beeḍūrya yi 'od ldan gzi byin 'bar phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pas a ru 'dzin: sku las spros ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: 'gro ba'i nad mtshon zug rngu kun 'joms byed: ma rig 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs grol byed cing: zhabs gnyis skyil krung mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar: gang 'dul 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam par dmigs: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo mchod do skyabs su mchi'o: 37 na mo bha ga wa te: bhe ṣa bye

gu ru beeḍūrya pra bha rā dza ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ahe te 〈myaka saṃ bhuddhā ya tadu thā: o bhe ṣa bye bhe ṣa bye: ma hā bhe ṣa bye bhe ṣa bye: rā dzā sa muṅga te swā hā: lan bdun brjod dmigs yul re zhig chags pa'i lus la mtshon rbab kyis smas pa sogs bag chags 'jigs sgrag 'khrul snang gi zug rngu mtha' dag dang bral nas: bcoms ldan 'das sman gyi bla drang sgong sman gyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig : rjes su sman dbang bskur ba ni hrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston sngon gyi lus la gri rigs bco brgyad kyis: btab pas sdug bsngal bag chags rgyun gcod phyir hrīX nad mtshon mu ges 'jigs pa kun skyobs pa'i: bcoms ldan sman gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis: las nyon zug rngus 'ching ba kun zhi zhing: bde skyid lha dang mnyam pa'i dbang thob shog sangs rgyas kyi mab dang sman gzungs smon lam gong ltar du brjod de ltar bzlas pa mthar phyin pas drag pos gzul ba sbugs bshigs na gshin por thar lam thob pa da gson po bde ba' go skabs rted 'gro don 'phrin las bsam yas 'byung gang 'brel don dang ldan par 'gyur sa ma mā

— rgyal ba kun dngos padma yi thugs bcud dgongs pa' pha nor 'di khyung tshang stag mo'i yang rdzong nas dgongs brda snyan brgyud gtad rgya grol re zhig thabs 'di sbas rgyas btab dusakyi yo lang zhang gdul dka' 'phel 'grib gso ba'i phyar dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe rten 'brel dus bab shog skyar bkod bka' 'ad dregs pa sde bcu dang dge bsnyen spyo khas thub par srungs dam nyams la ja bar thugs sras rig 'dzan dpal du shog sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang rags sras shes rab thogs med kyisabakra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor ldan khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod 'phrul gyi yi ge la bsgyur ba po ni lung zan na kairtis bgyisapa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo le

sa/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las gu ru drag po gnam lcags me 'phreng rtsal la brten nas gshin po'i 'khrul snang sbubs bshig: 'dul dkar thugs rje'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so: sgo/— na mo gu ru padma kro ta rā dza ya: sgoṭwāṃsnyathespyod mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku mchog he ru ga: dbang chen padma drag po la phyag 'tshal:nyon mongs a 'thas 'khrul ba'i 'dre bdud bgegs: phyin ci log rtog lta spyod dang len rnams: rang grol bde ba chen por sad bya'i byir 'khrul ba sbubs bshig thugs rje'i lcags kyu bstan: sa ma yā: de yang bdag mdun bum bzlas gri sman bsgrubs: ming byang 'jag gzugs bla rten dri gos bskon: dug gsum gdon gzugs chang glud bdun tshan gsum: yakta me dbal sdig nag rngams pa'i gzugs: kha phor glud rdzas 'dod yon bza' btung bshams dang po gtor ma cha bzhi gtong ba ni:o su bha wa sa sbrangs la: stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur: slo a09 na maḥ sabo twa thā ga ta a wa

lo ki te sogs bha ra nyuX lan gsum gyis brlabs te hūṃ hrīḥ stong dbyings nam mkha'i khams la rten bcas pa'i: lha klu drang srong dge bsnyen gnod sbyin sogs: dregs pa sde brgyad rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas: skad cig yud tsam 'dir byon gtor ma bzhes: bdag gis gang brtsams las la ko long dang : ru nga gdug rtsubs med par grogs mdzod cig: rgyun gtor mchad saṃ bha ra' sngags lan gsum brjod la 3sna āḥhūṃḥ dri za grul bum mkha' la rgyu ba'i tshogs: 'byung po ro lang sha za'i tshogs rnams kun: 'dod yon gtor mas brngan pas tshim gyis la: zhi zhing byams pas 'gal rkyen ma byed cig: saṃ bha ra'i sngags lan gsum brjod oṃ aX 〉ཿ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga yi phung po 'di: 'phrog ma pañtsi ka la sogs pa yi: yi dwags sde rigs 'byung po yongs la bsngo ngoms shing tshim nas gnod 'tshe ma byed cig: saṃ bha ra'i sngags lan gsum brjod 31 āḥhūṃ: dug gsum rang mdangs 'byung po yid gzugs can sha khrag drod mor dga' ba'i bgegs rigs rnams: lan chags glud kyi gtor mas tshims gyis la: rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig

ju/ hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab byang chub sems kyi srung gur phub de nas ming bya bskyed pa ni stong pa'i ngang las ming byang de nyid gson po'i rnam pa ras gos dkar po gyon zhing gdong bla ma dang lhar phyogs nas dad gus tshad med pas bag pheb bzhin du gnas par gyur kyi: nyon cig nyon mongs rjes 'brang 'khrul ba'i gdon: med la bden par zhen pa'i sems can rnams: mtho ste srid rtse dma' ba na raka yan: thams cad rten 'brel las las byung ba yi: ma rig gsum gyi mngal rgyar dub dbang gis chos nyid don dam bden pa'i zhal ma 'tshos 'khor ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul rgyur bden par bzung: nga khyod gnyis su zhen cing gdung ba yis mtha' med 'khor ba'i du khar rtag tu tshud: byis pa rnams ni 'jig rten chos kyis bslus da ni rang snang 'khrul ba ngos zungs la: bde gshegs yongs 'dus bla mar skyabs su song hrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: sgo gsum gcig dril yi dam lha la gtod: ma yengs bla ma'i gdams ngag tshig la nyon: srid pa'i grong la phyi

mig la blta cig: gnyen bshes chags zheg med par 'dir shog cig: bden brjod ni na mo dkon mchog kun dngos che mchog padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i bden pa'i mthus: dmigs yul re zhing chags pa'i ming bzhi skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig: a yi dza badzra aṅku sha dza: driXye dza badzra aṅku sha dza:lan bdun bo da gshed bral ni kyi: nyon mongs las las skyes pa yi: dmigs yul re zhing chags pa de'i: lus ni driḥyig sngo skya'i tshulaX phyi rol kṣaḥyig dmar skya yis: sha lpags bshin du bsdams pa las: 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gis gdung dmigs: bdag nyid padma drag po yi: thugs srog hūṃ yig dmar nag dang : dmar ser phaṭa kyi tshogs spros nas aX driḥktaḥyang dngos med gyur: aḥdriḥktaḥhūṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brjod hūṃ phaṭa kyis kṣaḥdriḥyang dngos med 'ja' ltar yal bar dmigs la: drwa ba rus pa'i rnams par gnas: rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo laḥ dkar po dngul chu'i thig pa lta bu'i rnam par gyur bden brjod sngon du 'gro bas dmigs yul bag chags ngan pa'i gri lcags dang bral

༄/cha bar gyur cig: ma badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa: lus kyi sgo phyes par bsam: ma badzra a we sha ya a rnam shes lus la zhugs par gyur: ma badzra rakṣa hūṃḥ snying gar rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga ba as mtshan par gyur: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: phyag rgya bzhis mi 'gyur bar rgyas gdab: yag brgya bzla las dang nyon mongs pa' bag chags bshags sbyang bya de nas 'byung po'i tshogs la yas glud bsngo ba ni oṃ su bha sogs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod rnams su oṃ las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po gcig tu gyur: ma āḥhūṃ sngags drug phyag drug gis spel la bden brjod sngon du 'gro bas dmigs yul re zhing chags pa'i tshe sgog bla la re ba'i 'byung po yid kyi gzugs can pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad glud gtor len pa'i slad du 'dir 'dus shigaḥ lan gsum brjod ma badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ ratna pa sha (ཿ padma spro ṭa baṃḥ karma ganḍi hoḥ de bzhan gshegs pa bzha'i marga brjodaḥ zur dug gsum las skyes ma rig 'khrul pa'i gdonaḥ nyon mongs a 'thas nga yul 'thas pa'i 'dreḥ zad med 'dod yon gtor mas mgu byos

la 'gro la ma 'tshe byams pas chos 'di zungs saṃ bha ra'i sngags lan bdun brjod gong ltar lan gsum bskyar de nas dug sbyong ni bden brjod sngon du 'gro bas dmigs yul re zhing chags pa'i tshe srog dbugs mdangs bla la za ba'i 'byung po thams cad oṃ phu le phu le phud phudaX ha la ha la phud phudaḥ shirnyi ku ru phud phudaḥ puṣṭi ku ru phud phud: pa shaṃ ku ru phud phudagri gshed dur 'dre za 'dre gshan lcags sarba sha hūṃ da ha da haḥ pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma raḥ ku ru ku na ma ra ya phud phud swā hā lan bdun brjod sdig pa 'i bskyed chog na bdag nyid padma drag po rtsal du gsal pa'i mdun du sprul ba'i yaka me dbal lcags sdig gi rnam pa shin tu khros shing gtum pa 'jigs rngams bltar mi bzod pa'i rang bzhin can du gsal pa'i thugs sgog las 'od zer spros te rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas yakta me dbal gyi tshogs de 'dra ba spyan drangs la bstim moḥ badzra aka dung dung ru ru bha sha badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren niḥ hū hūṃ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs zhing na bzhugs pa yiḥ rgyal dgongs brda snyan shog ser tshig gi brgyudaḥ yongs rdzogs ngo bo padma thod

ḍa 'phreng rtsal rjams brjid yakka me dbal phyag rgyar bzhengs: hū hrīḥ zhi ba khro bo zhi ma khro la sogs: ma rig ru tra 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can: thams mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: dug gsum a 'thas gdon tshogs 'dul bar mdzod: / hū: rab khros lcags sdig nag po mgo dgu pa lus po dmar nag zhal / dag gis gang: 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed pa'i dri ngad spro: nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs gshed du bskul: hū hūṃ dgra la bab na dug gi kha phru thob: bgegs la / na du pa rdul du rlog: sri la bab na srog snying tshal bar thong: 'byung po dam sri brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: / hrīḥ med la yod par blta ba'i sems can gyis: gnyis snang ba'i mtshan ma chos skur gzhig ye nas spros bral bde ba chen po'i zhal: rtogs na srid pa'i sgong rgya gtor bar byed: hū hūṃ hūḥ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ma gu ru artsig nertsig rgo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: a hā hā phaṭa: badzra yasba dung dung ru ru bha sha hūṃX gnod byed za 'dre gshin lcags kyi mo sa rakta tsitta la kha kha khā hi khā hi lan bdun brjod la bstabs

rngams bya'o khyer cig khyer cig he ru ga sred chags zhen pa'i 'byung po yi: dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: stobs shig 'khrul snang chos skur gzhig: / bzhi'i sngags dang drag sngags rol mos la sa rngams 4sa te bgegs bskrad par bya'o lha 'dre de nyid ā dkar po zhig tu gyur te snang stong bde ba chen por bsres la stong nyid snying rje'i don du mnyam par gzhag pas lha 'dre'i 'khrul ba sbubs bshigs te gnod bya gnod byed mtshan 'dzin ka nas dag par 'gyur ro: dzñā na dhartu rakṣa rakta: chos kyis sbyang ba niḥtrīX nga niyang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston sku yi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dmigs yul lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: na mo ratna tra ya yā: tsho ke ka ni: sogs nañtsa dmigs yul gyis tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sarba pa paṃ da ha na shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: trīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te:'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: brjod med gsang ba gsung gi byin rlabs pa'i: bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dmigs yul ngag sgrib bkru: na mo ratna tra ya yā na mo ārla

)sgo— a mi ta bha ya sogs sidhi wa le dmigs yul gyi tshe sogs swā hā:trīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston mi 'gyur thugs kyi byin rlabs chu rgyun gyis: dmigs yul rlung sems sgrib pa dag gyur cig: sa ātu badzra gu ru padma sirnyi (ཿ yo gu ru artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te hū hū phaṭa: a hū hū phaṭa: 'aḥ.amagaḥs maḥhaX dmigs yul gyi sogs swā hā hrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston:ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yis: dmigs yul nyon mongs sgrib pa dag gyur cig: 37 badzra a mṛ ta kurnya li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: 37 badzra a dṛ ta utta ka hūṃ phaṭa: sa bhir rku dhi swā hā: tso a dṛ te hūṃ phaṭa: dmigs yul gyi tshe 'khor ba sogs swā hā: hrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston pha rol phyin bcu'i rang bzhin chu rgyun gyis: dmigs yul dri ma rnams bcu dag gyur cig oṃ a mi dhe wa la yu sirnyi hū hrīX khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa ma hā gu ru padma sirnyi

hūṃḥya manta ka hya ṣṭṛ wa badzra pa ṇi ḍākki ni ha ri ni sa badzra hūṃḥ yakka hūḥ raka hūṃḥ hū hūṃ hūḥ hū hū hūṃḥ / hū hūḥ hū: dmigs yul gyi tshe 'khor ba sogs swā hā: sdig sgrib bsreg pa ni hrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: ye shes lnga yi rang 'od 'bar ba'i mes: dmigs yul las nyon rigs drug sa bon bsreg: 31 sarba pa paṃ da ha na aXdṛ suḥtriḥpreḥduḥdzaḥ sarba bhasmi ku ru ye dzwa la ram̐ pa swā hā lan drug brjod la me chus sbyangs nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: srid las rnam grol mngon par byang chub phyir: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song sdom pa zungs: sems bskyed pa ni nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te: 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: thams cad mnyam nyid dag pa rab 'byams sgom: gi sman gso bzhi dbang/ trīX slar skyabs su 'gro ba niḥhrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: rnam par smin phyir sku gsung

/rgo— thugs kyi dbang khyod la bskur ro sgo gsum smin grol the ga:rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wākka tsitta gu ṇa garma a bhi ṣiñtsa hū smonalam gdab pa ni hrīḥng ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te:'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston:mthong thos dran reg rnam grol sar 'god pa'i 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro don mthar phyin shog:o swā sti sirnyi sarba maṅga le:'dod yon bsngo ba ni hrī:nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te:'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston:mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes phyir:zag med ye shes bdud rtsi 'di longs spyod:slo las 'dod yon nam mkha' gang bar gyur:badzra spra ra ṇa dzaḥhrīX dngos bshams ting 'dzin las byung nor sna 'di:rab gsal yid kyi dbang po tshims phyir bsngo:mi sdug gzugs kyi bye brag ji snyed pas snang dang stong pa zung 'jug rtogs gyur cig:ming tshig grags pa sgra yi bye brag kun grags stong 'gag med chos sgrar sad gyur cig:bzang po'i dri ngad snom pa'i bye brag kun:tshor stong 'dzin med don la gnas gyur cig:mngar sgyur ṣa bska sla ba'i bye brag

kun: myang stong zhen med ngang la gnas gyur cig: 'jam rtsub dar zab reg bya'i bye brag kun: bde stong zung 'jug spyod pa mthar phyin shog: yid dbang gang shar 'gyu 'phro'i rtogs tshogs kun: rig stong ka dag chos sku mngon gyur shog: mi zad sbyin pa'i nor gyis ser sna grol mi 'gag tshul khrims rgyan gyis 'chal skyon dben: mi g.yo bzod pa'i gos gyis sku rngu skyobs mi brtson dpa' ba'i go chas le lo 'joms: mi 'khrugs ting nge 'dzin gyis nyon mongs 'joms: mi dmigs lhag mthong rtogs pas srid zhi grol: chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing 'phags pa'i nor bdun gter la spyod par shog: spar chog ni trī: nga niyang dag rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas te 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: sgo gsum 'dun pa lha dang bla mar gtod: dbyings rig ma bu chos sku'i dgongs sang bsre: a phaṭa: a phaṭa: a phaṭa: ma bcos shes pa stong gsal rjen ne ba: 'pho ba bya byed yul 'das zang ka ma: chos kyi dbyings la rig pa'i 'od gsal 'khyil: sku gsum lhun rdzogs 'khor ba dongs sprugs shog

phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam brjod rjes su ming bya bsreg pa ni stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i me thab zlum la 'khyil ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing las / bag chags rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa sreg cing sbyang nas ye shes lha yi gsang ba gsum du sad par dmigs la: trīX nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te:sna/ ba sdug bsngal gyur la dam chos ston: kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i rdzun mtshang stong bya'i phyir: phung po ye shes me yis sreg cing sbyangs: trī zag med ye shes bdud rtsi a dṛ ta:/ mchog til dang 'dod yon mchod sprin 'bul dmigs yul las nyon bag chags dri ma sbyang sa: gnas nga na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem gyur cig: a dri su tri pre du dzaḥsarba ni da ha na shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: smon lam gdab pa ni ho: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: mdang da na ning gi lo zla zhag dus la tshe lus snga ma bor zhing phyi ma ma rnyed pa 'i bar do' 'gro ba ga na gnas pa de dag cho ga zab mo 'di yi mthu la brten nas: rigs drug gi skye

sgo khegs par gyur cig: 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang ya nga ba'i g.yeng sa gsum ma nges pa'i rtags drug rang snang 'dzin med bde ba chen por grol bar gyur cig mngon shes lnga dang rjes dran drug gi mthu la bsten nas rang snang dag pa'i zhing du grol bar gyur cig: bla ma dam pa'i rjes su zin cing lam sna 'dren par gyur cig: yi dam lhag pa'i lha yis dbug dbyung zhing lung bstan pa thob par gyur cig: yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas shing bag chags ngan pa'i skye rgyun chod par gyur cig: myur lam zab mo'i mthu la brten nas phyir mi sdog pa'i sa thob par gyur cig: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gdengs dang ldan nas 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i ded dpon du gyur cig: bsreg thal 'jim pa dang bsres te tshwa tsha gdab la: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros: rnam par snang mdzad longs sku gangs can mtsho'i thugs rgyud bskul: sku de las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung: thugs rten rnams la thim pas dmigs yul gang na gnas pa de'i las nyon bag chags shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par byas te byang chub sems dang ldan pas 'gro ba

ṇa gang la gang 'dul gyis don byed par gyur cig dbyangs gsal rten snying lan bdun gyis rab tu gnas shing shis pa brjod sa ma mā e ma rgyal dbang padma thod 'phreng rtsal mi / snying dbus rtag bsten nas ma rig 'khrul ba'i lha 'dre la 'khrul ba sbubs bshig thabs brtson pas las nyon ma rig rang ngo shes byams dang snying rjes rgyud brlan te sems can kun nyon dbang gyur ba'i dug gsum / rnams rang sar grol nad mug mtshon 'byugs g.yul ngo zhi gzhan don 'phrin las rlabs chen 'grub thabs 'dir brtson pa don mchog ldan sngags kyi 'phrin las zab cing myur 'brel tshad don ldan e ma med bka' gsapa sde bcu dang dge bsnyen spyo khas thub par srungs dam med lag tu mi 'chor bar skal bzang rin 'dzin dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu bye brda zim lha zhes pa 'di'ang rigs srasashes rab thog med kyis 5 ༷༵ mchen pa' lha reg gi skyes bcas bskul ngor kho bo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro 'phrul gyi brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zan kurma kirtas bgyisapa dge zhang bkra shis par gyur cig

rdo/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi bka' sdod dregasapa'i mchod byang bsdus pa bzhugs so:rdo/ na mo gu ru padma ka re ya pho sgo mchod gtor byin gyis bams pa ni gtor snod bhanta gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du gtor ma de nyid dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la:na mo rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang :mchog gsum sku gsum bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus spyir mchog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgra:bzhes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra:khyad par du bdag cag dpon sgob chos sde grwa tshang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig:bstim shigaḥdza:/ baṃ ho:dbyings las thun mtshon gyi char spros te dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung khrol bur gtub ste:sha ri khrag gi rgya mtsho nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam par gyur:sngags drug dang phyag drug gil byin gyis rlabs te:mchod rdzas rnams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la:rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung

po zad pa med pa'i gter chen po gcig tu gyur o badzra spa ra ṇa dzaḥhūṃ bhyo:dad dang dam tshig dbang gis 'bod lags na:bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmags tshogs sa ya 'bum rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings nas gzugs skur bzhengs dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol:'phrin las lhun gyi grub phyir gus phyag 'tshal:gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra yis bstod:gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo:dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i 'dzab mchod 'bul:thugs dam chen pos nye bar bzhes su gsol:badzra sa ma ya:dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥmachod 'phreng ni:dzaḥtheg chen bstan pa'i bya ra ba:padma'i zab gter gnyer 'dzin pa'i:spug nag 'od 'phro gtso 'khor bcas:sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs:sgrub pa po rnams srung ba dang :dam log snying khrag chub kyis drongs:dzaḥganam sa phyed kyi bdag po ni dge bsnyen chen po mthu rtsal can:skyes bu rdor legs mched 'khor bcas sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs:zab gter bstan pa srung ba dang :dgra bgegs gnyis
