ḍa la bka' chad chod: dzaḥ khams gsum yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i: ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan pa lha rab shams po gtso 'khor bcas : sha khrag gtor mas la mchod bskangs: dregs pa'i cho 'phrul ngan gtong dang : byad phur rbod gtong bzlog tu gsolaḥ dzaḥsrid gsum srog la dbang za ba'i: las gshin ki ging dmar nag gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob: bka' chad gdug rtsub myur du ston: dzaḥ ma mo srid / rgyal mo yi sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi sprul pa ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs dam nyams bstan pa'i dgra bo la thur khrag nad char ltar phob dzaḥ bdud yul yongs la mnga' mdzad pa'i: sgos rje trang dkar mthu rtsal can: gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas sha khrag gtor mas la mchod bskangs: yid la brnags pa'i dgra dang bgegs zhags pas ching la rdul du rlog dzaḥ dmar po btsan gyi sde dpon pa skyes bu lung btsan mthu rtsal can

'byung ba lnga yi btsan rgod bcas sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: bka' 'das dam log pho mo rnams: zhags pas chong la btsan mdung thob: dzaḥ skyes bu sgog bdag yongs kyi gtso: rgyal chen be dkar sku lnga po: bka' blon ru 'dren sde bzhi'i tshogs: sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: nyams pa can gyi dgra bgegs rnams:spyo 'bog brgyal nad phob la sod: dzaḥ gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag gi: phyag nyan ka la yaka yi: bka' nyan pho nya g.yog dang bcas sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: bdag la do bsdo ya bzung ba'i: dgra bgegs 'byung po myur du sod: dza rgya mtsho klu la dbang bsgyur ba'i: klu rgyal nā ga ra dza dang : 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa'i 'khor:sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: gnod sbyor rgol ba'i dgra dang bgegs kha rlangs dug gi spu gris sod: dzaḥ sa brgyad sems dpa' chen po ni: khyung tshang gnyan po g.yu rtse dang : bse yi skye bu 'khor tshogs bcas: sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: zab gter bstan pa srung ba dang : sgrub pa po yi 'phrin las stsol: dzaḥ

rdo/— gter srung stag srin zor ba'i gdong ཿ klu mo a lcam bzhin bzang la: 'khor skyong dgra 'dul dbang phyug rnams: sha khrag gtor mas gsol mchod bskangs: zab gter chos 'di'i bstan pa srungs: byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor: gdul bya 'khor slob mnga' dbang bsdus: bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing mdzod:'phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yā: de ltar dregs pa' mchod phreng 'di drag po bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyun du mchod gsol byed nus na gegs zhi rkyen bzlog bsam pa 'grub nyams rtogs spel ba'i grogs po byed the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang khyung tshang stag mo'i rdzong gi zab mdzod kyi brda lasakho bonu ldan pas zhal bdus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma kairtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs las: rgyal chen sku lnga'i gsol mchod bsdus pa dregs pa dbang sdud zhes bya ba bzhugs so:tho gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya: cabyu41 srid gsum zil gnon he ru ga'i bka' sdod pho nya brngan pa ni hrīḥ padma ta krita badzra kro dha hya snyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: hrīḥ rngam brjed rol ba'i gar rta mgrin rta skad bshad la phyag 'tshal bstod skye 'chi med pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchog bdag cag sgrub pa po la stsal dzin dgongs pa'i rol mtsho las byung ba'i: 'dzad med klu yi dga' ston lta bu'i dbyig: thugs kyi rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: snying po'i /gas mdzod cig: chos nyid sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i ltad mo rtsa 'dod rgu'i dpal yon nam mkha' mdzod kyi dkor: sku yi rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la / gzhi 'dus sde srung skyobs mdzod blo bral ting nge 'dzin kyi 'phrul mo che: gzhan 'phrul lha yi dkor las lhag pa 'di: yon tan rgyal chen 'khor dang

bcas la 'bul: zab chos bstan dang der 'dzin srung skyobs mdzod: zad med nam mkha'i mdzod du spros pa yi: dga' ston yid dang mthun pa'i mchod sprin rnams: gsung girgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: padma'i brgyud 'dzin chos 'khor rtag tu srungs brten brkang sgrub rdzas yo byad mtha' yas pa: padma'i gnyer gtad thams cad blos blanganas: 'phrin las rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul zab gter bstan dang gtsugs lags 'dus sde srung: bka' sdod stobs ldan gnod sbyin tsi ma ra: shel ging dkarapo tshangs pa dung thod sogs ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul pa bsam yas dpung: thugs mthun gtor ma sha khrag ja chang skyems: 'dod yon ma tshangs med pas thugs dam bskangs gsang sngags bstan dang de 'dzin grwa sgob skyong bshad sgrub 'dus sde nub med dar rgyas mdzod: 'da' 'khu bzlog pa'i cho 'phrul mi ston par: padma'i brgyud 'dzin sbyi bo'igatsug tu bkur thugs mthun bzhed don ma lus yongs 'grub mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: gtor skyems 'bul zhing thugs dam bskangs 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs

/ /— med 'grub sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces rgyal chen 'du ba'i dus ston la pheb pa'i nyamasabyung tshe bskang gsol gnyel bcol 'di skad cig nyid la rig ngor phab po stag mo' yangasardzong nas kho bo nusaldan pa smras te garma kirtisabris pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lo

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'phreng rtsal gyi bka' srung spyo kha'i bskang gsol phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:na mo padma kro dha rā dza ya: tsha)shā rten thugasamathun gtor ma zhal shes ltar bcas la mngon rtogs bsgoms pa ni hūṃḥ rang mdun me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus dug 'khyil ba'i klong: dge bsnyen chen po spyo kha ni dmar nag srin po khros pa'i zhal: 'khor lo g.yas la zhags pa g.yon lcags kyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum ra gi 'jol ber mdzes ldan klub: chibs su bra bo g.yu rngog bcibs gong thag glo smed sbrul las byas: rnga rngog gseb nas sbal sbrul 'phyo: skad cig ri rab gling rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan de yi steng dpa' bo phyed 'gying stabs su rol: khros na sku smad sbrul mjug las mdze grum dam nyams dgra la 'beb sprul pa sdom sdig 'gyed: g.yag nag zhing bkal rol du khrid: mun pa sgra 'then mdun du gnas: bka' sdod dregs pa'i bu yug 'tshubs: rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i:

dregs pa spyan drangs gnyis med bstim spyan 'dren ni hū dza byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i sku: dge bsnyen spyo kha zhes su grags: pho brang chen po spyon kha'i mtsho: de dang nye ba'i sdig mtsho ru bzhugs pa'i dam tshig dkyil 'khor nas 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byon: sngags 'chang bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: sirnyi baṃ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ ti ya sa ka dza: re ma ti sa ma dza: mu ka le ni sa ka dza: wa ka le ni sa ka dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hū dza: dam chig rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang : bla rdo sgog gi 'khor lo la: skyes bu dge bsnyen spyo kha ni:'khor dang bcas pa tiṣṭha lhan: phyag la' ni ho rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs srung zhing: khyad par sngags kyi gnyer 'dzin pa: grogs po dge snyen spyo kha la: 'phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: gsol mchod ni kyi dgongs sdon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas: lha yi dge bsnyen chen po khyod: bzang drug dkar gsum phud kyis mtshod: dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: bar snang 'ja' gur 'khrigs klong nas: dregs pa'i dge bsnyen mthu rtsal can zla rgyas zla phrum gtor mas mchod: bsnyen

ḍa sgrub sgom pa'i grogs mdzod cig:ljon shing brag ri gtams pa nas:dge bsnyen btsan gyi sbyi rje bor:sha khrag gtor mas mchod pa 'bul:sngags 'chang /ga gi grogs mdzod cig:rgya mtsho klu yi gting rum nas:dge bsnyen chen po spyo kha la:thugs mthun mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul:mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig:che mchog padma drag po yi:rnal 'byer bdag cag sgrub pa pos:srung ma bsgrub par ma chad dam:khyod nyid 'ong bar ma chad dam:dam tshig ci bzhin gtor ma bshams: nas gsol zhing 'bod lags na:skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir byon brngan ston mchod pa dgyes par bzhes:'dod don 'brin las grub par mdzod:kya:3 rgyan thod 'phreng gi:dpal gyi phug ring dkyil 'khor du:khyod nyid dam btag bdud rtsi blud:zab gter dpal gyi gnyer byang gtad rgyud 'dzin srung ma'i grogs por /sa:tha tshig de ni dran gyis la:deng dus padma drag po yi:rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod pa'i don:yar phyed tshe 'di'i don phyir de:tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang thang dang :

'khor 'bangs snyan drag rgyas par mdzod mar phyed phyi ma'i don phyir de bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin mthar phyin nas: rig 'dzin sa la sbyor ba yi: don rtags 'od skur grub par mdzod bgo zhing bcol ba'i las de dag: myur du grub mdzod dam tshig can ma bul ma 'khyang sa ma yā bstod pa ni hūṃ bhyo: padma'izab gter bstan srung ba: dge bsnyen chen po spyo kha yi zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshe: skya rengs dang po'i rta la bcibs: lha yi dge bsnyen khyod la bstod: rgyas pa'i 'phrin lasamadzad pa'i tshe: bsil ldan zla ba'i zer la bcibs: rnal 'byor yongs kyi tshogs khang 'grim: gter bdag chen po khyod bstod: dbang gi 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la bcibs khams gsum skad cig nyid la bskor: dbang sdud rgyal po khyod la bstod mngon spyod 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshe: bra bo rlung gshog chibs su bcibs: dgra bo'i tshe srog rbad kyis gachod: gdug rtsub klu yi rgyal la bstod: bka' nyan klu gnyan gtod tshogs dang : yang 'khor sprul pa sa ya 'bum: kun kyang nyid kyi cho 'phrul te: 'brin las mtha'

/sgo yas khyod la bstod mchod cing bstod pa'i byin rlabs kyis: phyis su dgra jag chom rkun dang kha char bu yug gnod pa srungs gzhi la gnas tshe 'tsho rdzid dang : srung skyobs mel rtse ma g.yel cig: mthu rtsal can gyi dge bsnyen khyod: ji srid byang chub ma thob bar: bdag gi grogs su brten par bgyi 'phrin las rnam bzhi char ltar phob: don gnyis 'grub pa'i grogs po mdzod thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā: bshags pa ni ho: ye shesalasagrub rdzu 'phrul can: legs nyes ltong grogs 'dzin pa yis: dge bsnyen khyod dang 'gal ba'i las: nongs pa gang song bzod gsol bzhes: badzra sa ma ya bi shudhe a 'di sgrub 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon ma 'phel tshe bsod chosakyi rgud pa sel sa lam gegs med mthar phyin 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim thi zhes pa 'di'angamo rgyanachen po'i bka' yis gnang ba thob bzhin khyung tshangasaganyan po' yang rdzong du kho bo nusaldan pasadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin ma kairti bgyisapa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma le

rdo/ dag snang mi zad rgyan 'khor las mdo khams gnas kyi gtso bo rdzong chen bzhi yi ya gyal bkra shis stag mo'i yang rdzong gi bsang gsol phan bde'i char 'bebs bzhugs dres: rdo ṣa na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍakki ni ya: las bzang shing sna tshogs dud pa btang phye mar 'byu sman sna tshogasasbyar rnal 'byor lha sngags gdeng ldan pas rol mo sna rgasasgra snyir te kye: gzhi dbyings ka dag chos sku'i nam mkha' la gzhi snang lta bu kun bzang bsang gi sprin ngo mtshar rdo rje'i rol ston mtha' yas pa sgyu 'phrul ltad chos gsum dgyes bskyed gyur o badzra spra ra ṇa khaṃ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang bsgyur spel de nas rang nyid padma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i thug ga'i 'od zer lcags kyus bskul nas mdun du 'khod par bsam la: kye bcu gsum gser gyi khri la mnga' mdzad cing: sa brgyad dregs pa sems dpa'i zol 'dzin pa: khyung tshang g.yu rtse rdo rje thog rgod rtsal dung sman bco brgyad dgra lha nyi shu gcig: ru 'dren lnga brgya rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas: dad pas 'bod do dam tshig ci bzhin tu: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mos

ngor byon: kun bzang bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa bzhes: rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'dod don char bzhin phob: rtag tu srung skyobs mel rtse 'tsho ji mdzod: dgra bdud bgegs dpung sma phob rdul du bzlog las dbang srung rta bsod nams chos srid spel: bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol: kye shar gyilha btsan dar ba skya gcig dang lto yi dge bsnyen nor skyong mched sde gsum nub phyogs bse ging chen po stobs rtsal can: byang phyogs drag pa'i phyag brnyan 'bar ba rtsal dgra 'dul dbang phyug gling ring shan pa dang : 'jigs med gzhen nu'i dpa' bo la sogs pa'i dregs pa'i che shes dam tshig 'dzin pa kun: padma'i bka' bzhin gnas 'dir da tshur byon yid mthun 'dod lnga'i dga' ston bsang mchod bzhes: srid na ya mtshan che ba'i dpal kun stsol: dam pa chos kyi mdzad phrin mtha' rgyas shing: snying po'i 'khor slob 'dus sde dar rgyas mdzad bkra shis phyog las rnams rgyal 'phrin las 365: bka' dang dam la ma 'das sa ma yu zhesabasang mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di yang chosabadag padma'i mtshan can gyis bskus ngor kho bonus
ḍa ldan rdo rjes sba mul stag mo'i yang rdzong nas dag par phab pa yi ge pa ni pa ṇi'i mang gis bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel sarba maṅga lo

/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po gnam lcags me 'phreng rtsal la brten pa'i bshags pa dri med shel bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo gu ru padma kro dha ya: 〉thitha ྅/rdo sa dri med ye shes thugs ni mkha' ltar dag: rang bzhin 'od gsal sku mchog gdos mtshan bral: sku co ga bde ba chen po'i klong: kun bzang he ru ka dpal dgongs su gsol: gzung 'dzin yid chos ma byung ma skyes pas: rtsa ba yan lag 'das nyams dmigs su dgongs pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis: kun rdzob sems kyi chag nyams chos skur bshags: ye stong ka dag bde chen rgyal mo'i 1nga: rang bzhin 'od gsal padma zung 'jug gar las gtso 'khor sprul par shar: ris chad gdos por bzung ba mthol lo bshags: rnam pa lam byed slob pa'i rnal 'byor la sor byang sngags / sor shar: gang la 'da' nyams dri ma byung bas nongs: mi gnas mi dmigs dgongs pa'i dbyings su bshags: ngo bo lam byed mi slob rnal 'byor la srung

mtshams las 'das ka dag rdzogs pa che'i dgongs pa'i gzi yis chos can mtshan ma grol:bshags bya bshags byed spros dang bral bar bshags:a ā:de ltar lta ba'i klong bshagasa'adis gzung 'dzin yid chosadri ma kun ka dag dgong pa'i dbyings su grol gsapa chen por btsan sa zin sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin du masabaskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jom nusaldan dpa' bo khyung tshang stag mo' rdzong nas mkha' 'gro'i zab mdzod zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung 'dzin ga kirti bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma le

/ba zab chos dri med klong yangs las drag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang phyir rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba 'bul thabs bsod nams sprin phung bzhugs so:na mo padma kro ta ya: shā zetshu1sa/ hū hrīḥ rig pa ka dag gsal ba'i mar me 'di: dbang chen padma drag po'i dal du 'bul: nyon mongs chags pa bsgral 'i skyes: 'khor ba ka nas dag phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: snang srid ro mnyam chen po'i ba lirte 'dod yon mtshan 'dzin dag phyir 'bul gyis bzhes 'khor 'das ro ñtsa a bṛ ta gzung 'jin ka nas dag phyir 'bul gyis bzhes sngags kyi dga' ston dza gad skyem kyi mchog bde stong rtogs pa 'bar phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: a la grul snang ka dag nas: bde chen padma 'od du rje'ogs smin regag: de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs nyams rtogs mkha' ltar 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi zhes kho bo nusaldan pa'i dgongs pa'i rol mtsho las shog skyar bsgyur ba'i yi ge'i risabyed garma girti so sarba ma le

༄/— drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi dgyes bskong rol ston phan bde'i char 'bebs bzhugs so:/ /— na mo padma kro ta ya: royisgrochen sha chang gtso bor gyur ba yi bza' bca' bsang bar 'o pa'i rigs dum gcig sgod du bsags byas te sbyangs spel nam mkha' mdzod du spro snyed āḥ/ kun bzang khyab brdal yangs pa'i bhanta rtsa 'dod yon ro mnyam ye shes dga' ston tshogs: gang shar rang grol lha mo'i gar dang bcas: rdul bral mchod sprin nam mkha' mtha' yas pas: che mchog padma drag po bskang phyir 'bul: ma rig 'dzin rtsol sems kyi spros pa bshags mtshan bcas bdud bzhir gol ba'i rū tra bsgral: don dam bde ba chen po'i dgongs par bstabs: gnyis snang sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa las nyams pa skong zhing blo bral ye shes kyi: tshe 'dir he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog de ltar phul bas tshogs rdzogasashing sgrib dag nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes chos bdagapadma chosa'aphelargya mchosabaskul ngor kho
bo nub na pasasmras/ zab mdzod las bsdus dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni kerma kirtisabagyis pa dge legasa'aphe la sarba maṅga le

/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las dgyes bskyed tshogs kyi kha 'phang ratna'i dga' ston bzhugs: dha rā dza mā: zamabashacan sgo padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du snang srid ro mnyam mchod pa yis dgyesapa skong shing spros 4gsu tshogasa'aphrin gdab pa 'di lta ste de gsal brdal khyab kyi dbyings na bzhugs pa'i o rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsal dgyes bskyed mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang : rje 'bangs nyub rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol: deng gsang chen phun tshogs lnga ldan gyis sgrub pa zab mo'i dkyil /na mchod 'khor dang bcas pas: rgyu bsod nams gyis tshogs bsags shing byang chub gyi sems rin po che bskyed la: yang dag pa'i lta gas chen po rdzogs nas 'bras bu sku gsum lhun gyi grub pa'i slad du 'bul lags na bzhes pa ci gnang: zhe slob bus gus 'dud kyis rgya zhus

mthar rdo rje slob dpon gyis lan gnang ba ni ho dam tshig srog gcig gis bsdus pa'i rdo rje rgyal thebs dbya sa kyi 'gyu gdang ba garma mu tra rdo rje gdong 'khrugs sgrub pa'i drod 'dzin las kyi g.yos sbyor sgrol ba'i ging ka ra phyi nang gis brda sbyor ba rdul phyag bya rog sogs dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams kyang : rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba la gnas shing rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis khog phub: gsang sngags mtha' bcus dam tshig la sel ma zhugs par chos khams ro mnyam du rtogs pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi dga' ston bsod nams dang shes rab ye shes bla na med pa'i tshogs bsags pa'i lta dgongs la yang dag par gnas na: che mchog padma drag po rtsal dang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i 'khor tshogs bdag rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pas bzhes par gnang ngo: kun gyis mgrin gcig tu a la la ho: kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings kyi ka pā lar: 'khor 'dasaro mnyam rdo rje'i dga' ston shar dag pa dam tshig nyer lngas rnam mdzes par: padma drag po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir spro ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni

rdo/ sarba dharma ga ga na ā:stong pa'i ngang las:ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng :gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs mchod pa'i lha mo mjes sdug yid 'ong grangs dang mu med pas bskor ba'i dbus:rang byung rlung me thod byed kyi khar ā:las ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du:sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtsor bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon gyis bkod pa thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur:kha chod nyi ma la gnas pa'i kwa li so gnyis dang :zla ba la gnas pa'i ā li bcu drug :srog shing rdo rje sbu gu can gyi rtse mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtshan pa: rwa rnams kyi nang khong sang du gnas pa'i rig lnga yab yum gyi ngo bo sa bon rnams gnas par bsam:'og nas me rlung 'thab pa'i drod kyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhu zhing rab tu khol bas:sbur rlang rdo rje'i khong sang nas brgyud de rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon rnams bskul: de las 'od zer mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor spros: rgyal ba rnams dgyes pa bskangs shing :sku gsung thugs yon tan 'brin las lnga'i dbang byin dngos

grub dang bcas bcud ma lus pa bsdus te bstim: mar spros 'gro ba rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams kyi las sgrib sbyangs: tshe dpal 'byung lnga'i dngas bcud ma lus pa bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la bstim rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon bde stong dga' bzhi'i ngo bor mer gyis zhu ste dbyangs gsal gyi dkyil 'khor la bstim: nyi zla'i kha chad ārla lnga bcu dang bcas pa: 'od du mer gyis zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas: zag med ye shes gyi bdud rtsi mkha' khyab 'khor los rgyan du gyur: gzhan yang ri rab kyi bang rim dang po la bkra shis rtags mchog brgyad: nam mkhar 'phur lding byed pa'i bya rigs sna tshogs bang rim gnyis pa la rgyal srid sna bdun dang gter gyi bum pa bzang po dang : bar snang la rtse gar bsgyur ba'i ri dwags rnam pa sna tshogs: bang rim gsum pa la phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzas mchog brgyad dang rten med kyi mkha' la lding 'gros rnam 'gyur ngoms pa'i g.yung dwags rnam pa sna tshogs: bang rim bzhi pa la nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal dang : gar 'gyed 'phar lding

ḍa 'phyong rtsal 'gyed pa'i gcan zan rnam pa sna tshogs 'dab rgya mtsho chen po'i sbu ba las gzugs mdzes pa sna tshogs phyur ba: rba rlabs las sgra snyan pa sna /sa ldir ba: ngad pa las dri zhim pa sna tshogs gyi spos sprin 'khrigs pa: ljags la brdar bas bsil 'jam yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa: gdeng ka nor bu 'dzin pa'i dga' bsam mi khyab pa: yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa'i chu gnas rnam pa sna tshogs 'phro ba: gzhan yang 'bru sman dar zab go khrab mtshon cha gnas mal them skas sogs mdor na sna/na thams cad kyis thugs dang mthun pa'i bskang rdzas dpe kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu rgya che la khyon yangs pa dus 'khor ba ci srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngag du mar brjod nas spel lo tshogs bsgral ni tshogs sgod lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: tshogs rdzas de nyid yid brnag pa'i dgra bgegs dngos su bskyed bdag mdun kyi sku las spros pa'i pho nya lcags zhags sgrog dril thogs pa grangs med pas bdag cag sgrub pa po la bsam sbyor

ngan pa re ma pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkugs nas tshogs rdzas la yang yang bstim: na mo: mchog gsum kun dngos padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang srung ba go cha lha lnga drag po rigs bzhi las mkhan lcags sdig nag po dang bcas pa'i bden pa dngaḥ bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan dam can rgya mtsho'i bden stobs kyi mthu la brten nas bdag cag la bsam spyor ngan pa shom pa'i dgra bo: thar lam la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rigs: tshe srog bla la 'jab cing sku bar re ma pa'i rgyal bsen gdug pa can thams cad rang dbang med par bcing pa lngas bcing nas tshogs rdzas du pa la khug cig: lan gsum dang badzra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūṃ be ho gzhung bzhi bsgral bstabs bya'o lhag gtor byin rlabs ni āḥlas bhasto yangs shing rgya che bar lhag gtor 'dod yon gyi phung po sha chen gyi ri bo: rakta'i rgya mtsho: rus pa'i kram khrod ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur: o āḥhūṃ ha ho dhiḥ lan gsum bsags glu rkang kling thod rnga'i sgras bskul la lhag sdud kyi pho nya dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams 'du ba

chen po'i pha phab kyi dga' ston la gshegs shig byon zhig: e a ra lihring tri phe phe lhag gtor gtong ngo bskul gtor byin gyi brlabasapa ni gtor snod bhanta lcang can gyi nang du gtor ma zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la: na mo: che mchog padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden mthu dang khyad du srung ba go cha lha lnga drag po rigs bzhi bdud dpal khro bcu las mkhan lcags sdig nag po bka' nyan pho nya dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus: ma rung ba'i sems can bcu tshang zhing lta spyod phyin cu log tu gyur ba'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa thams cad rang dbang med par skad cig nyid du sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig lanab dzaḥhū baṃ ho dbyings nas thun mtshon gyi char bab pa'i dgra bgegs kyi phung khams dum bur gtub te sha ri khrag gi rgya mtsho nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam par gyur: 6 hū ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum bo da la dam 'dog bya sngon tshe dpal chen po dang bar du padma thod 'phreng tha ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal bzhes chad kyi gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi

phung por dmigs nas dregs pa can thams cad la 'bul bar byas te chad mdo gtong rin po che'i snod du bshal chu rgya mtsho 'jig rten bas kyang rgya che la bcud 'dod yon lngaldan gyi phung por dmigs nas g.yar dam can bod skyong bstan ma sman phran sprul pa 'bum 'bum dang bcas pa la 'bul lo: 3( a hūṃlan gsum/bstan ma gtong /bro dmig ni chosadabyings stong pa nyid kyi sgom rgyar rnam rtogs gnyis snang du tra dam sri 'byung po thams cad brub par dmigs la: nam dkon mchog gsum dngos che mchog padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden mthu dang : bsrung ba go cha lha lnga drag po rigs bzhi bdud 'dul khro bcu las mkhan lcags sdig nag po bka' sdod pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i bden pa chen po'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod ba'i dam sri 'gab 'dre bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad chos dbyings sto pa'i sgrom rgyar khug cig lan gsum dṛḥtriḥbadzra azo sha dza: dzaḥhūṃbe nyo: tri sgor 'gong po span dag khug dza gri sri bse rag dbul gdon pho mo azo sha dza: tree dza: gnam the'u bar the'u sa the'u thams cad

ḍa mā ra ya rbad nan dri khur mā ra ya rgyal bsen klu gnyan thams mā ra ya sto bha ya na sha yaḥrbad nan nan: ma āḥ/ swā hā: shirnye puṣṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa ltar zo mnan bya gtor snod yar btegs pa'i dus su rgyal bstan rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rgyas pa dang : bstan pa'i sbyin bdag thams cad mnga' thang bsodas dpal gyi 'byor ba ldan pa dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams sku tshe ring zhing thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub la gnas pa dang : mdor na 'jin rten gyi khams su/sa ldan gsar tshes kyi snang ba lta bu'i yongs su mdzes shing brgyan par gyur cig: rgyu a yu pubye puṣṭi ku ru ye swāhā mchod dmigs na rnam par bkod pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ spros pa'i phyi nyer spyod bdun gyi lha mo: nang 'dod yon lnga: gsang ba sman gtor rakta: yang gsang sbyor sgrol de kho na nyid kyi dga' ston spel ba'i lha mo nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam par spros te: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad la mchod pa rgya chen po phul bas bdag gzhan gyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyis tshogs rgya chen rdzogs par

bsam la dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis mchod bstod dmigs ni gzhan yang mjes pa'i lha mo rnams kyi sku yis bro gar bsgyur ngag nas tshang pa'i glu dbyangs kyi rta la drangs nas lhatshogs rnams gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bstod cing thugs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur dad gus bsam mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bstod tshig brjod: slarabadag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob te bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed dbyer med du gyur bar bsam mo bzod gsol mthar bshags pa ni ho bla ma drag po dmar nag me yi 'phreng ba can thugs mkhyen brtse ye shes kyis gzigs pas bdag la dgongs su gsol: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du lam zlos pa dang : sgyu lus bde ba chen po'i grongs khyer zhu bde 'dzag med kyi thabs zab mos smin pa dang : shes rig gathug ma'i ngo bo ye shes chos kyi sku ru btsan sa ma zin padang 'khrul ba bag med kyi ngang du bying rmug 'phro rgod 'thor 'byams su gyur pa thams cad mi 'chab mi sded par gnong zhing 'gyod sems dang ldan pas bshags sbyangs

rdo/— bgyid lags so tshe 'di dang byi ma'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bas tshangs ba mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol badzra sa ma ya ā: yig brgya lan gsum gyis sku gsungathugs gyi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bshags sbyangs bya'o rten bzhugs ni ho rten dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la lha ye shes gyi 'khor 61 rab tu gnas shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: gnas skabs su 'gro ba'i 'dren ston byed pa dang : mthar thug rten de 'byung bzhis zhig tsa na ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'gro ba'i khams su gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs skur bzhengs bar mdzad du gsol: slo su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā zhes rab tu gnas shis pa brjod pa'i bden tshig ni phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re gsung zhing me tog 'thor lha tshangs dbang dang klu gtsug na rin chen: gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong: srin po liṅka'i rgyal po drang srong bden grub smra ba rnam kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i bden tshig brjod cing me tog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing sngon rnam gyi char chen po 'beb par gyur ye dharma

sogs shis brjod rgya cher bya'o: smon lam ni: na mo gu sa gnas snang rnga yab dpal rir 'char bar shog: o rgyan sprul ba'i rjes su zin par shog: nang don rtogs pas yon tan 'byor bar shog dben pa'i gnas su sgrub tshug zin rlabs chen spyod pa'i gzhan don 'byung gu ru'i bstan par bya ba byed nam yang bla ma nyid dang 'bral med mthar thug thugs kyi thig ler byang chub 'phrin las rtsol med chags thogs bral khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig: dza ya dza ya su dza ya: gzhan pang bsngo smon rgya cher gdab desani bsam don 'bad med 'grub gnasaskabs ring dpal gyisa'abyor nam zhig rig 'dzin zhing du spyod sam mā ye ma rgyal b.lidabang bo padma yi thugasabacud shin tu zab pa'i skor bdag 'dra rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis rin chen brda yi rgyar bcug nas sdig nag sbasapa'i mtsho ru bkod gter srung klu bdud 'jigasarngams can dge bsnyen spyo khar bya ra bcol ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga yi dus rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa padma'i rigasal rdo rje'i ming nus ldan khyung drag rdo rje yis rtags dang rten 'brel phun tshogs bcas snang ba brda dper shar las bton sred len snyed tshil sgru ma'i gter 'jig sla rkyen mang dang

ḍa mi 'dra mi nub dgongasapa'i rol mtsho ni brgyud gsum rang bsrel theb pa de su ma mgu yang blo bde 'byung nga sprul de dang 'di 'phrad shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhesapa 'di'angazin shes rab thogs med nas yang yang bskul ba dang rtsa ba' chosabadag me tri'i mtshan can gyis bkra shis lha reg rin chen shog dkar 'bru sman snying po' zhun gyis skyes bcasanan tan chen po'i bskul ngor 7 kho bo sbasarnal 'byor rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje nu ldan khyung drag rtsal gyisalha de'i sgrub pa chen po mdzad pa'i thun gseng rnamasasu gang shar bsre bslad med par gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin me tris bgyis pa dge legasapa sarba maṅga le

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs las:drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi:dgyes ston tshogs mchod sprin gyi phung po bzhugs so:na mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya: cabasgo rje mi bza' ba yongs su tshogs byas shing de la rnam rtog dri ma gcod ro mnyam dgongs pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro ོra nyams pa sor chud byed gsang sngags thab kyi cho ga ste 'di la brten pa gnad du che sa ma mā sha chang la sogs tshogs ston rnams dang po byin gyis rlabasapa ni ā mtshan ldan bhanta /nga:sha lnga bdud rtsi 'dod yon gter chen po ting 'dzin rdo rjes sbyangs bkrus bsregs byas te mtshan ma yongs bcom zag med bdud rtsir spel gas su rab spros nas:sgyu 'phrul padma gsung gi dgyes pa bskang ram̐ ye khaṃ:o āḥstsaha ho hrīḥbadzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ spyan 'dren ni snahrīḥgatum rngam 'jigs/ rtse mo zangs mdog dpal gyi gzhal yas nas skyabs gnas kun dngos o rgyan padma 'byung:dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas zhi

drag rnam 'gyur bkod pa bsam yas su rnal 'byor mos ngor tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs rtogs sgrib chags nyams thams cad bskang ba dang ye shes thugs kyi dbang byin dngos grub stsol o badzra sa ma yā dza dza tshogs mchod ni yo.uḥ〉ཿ tshogs kyi dngos po sha sna snying sna stong: rnam pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi gsos rang bzhin rigs lnga'i dga' ston myong grol tshogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam skangs phyir 'bul: yo ma hā ga ṇa tsakra byu dza khā hi: bar bshags ni rta mtshan mar 'dzin pa rtog pa'i gol sgrib kyis: chosanyid don la rmongasashing yul rjes 'brang so byang sngags kyi dam sdom las 'das skyon: ye shes tshogs kyi bskang zhing bshags bgyi'o o badzra sa ma ya ā: gosabasgral hūṃ hrīḥphyogs bcu'i 'jin rten ye shes khro bor spros: bdag gzhan mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdud tshogs bkug sku las spros pa'i mtshon cha'i rnam par gtubs rnam zhes bde chen zhing du byang chub byas: gzugs phung dga' ston tshogs kyi longs spod spel: gu ru badzra kro dma rā dza rbad: j-inyi tshu ma rwa ya sod bstab pa ni e bde chen klong

rdo/ yangs zhal gyi hom khung du: rnam rtog bdud tshogs 'bar ba'i phung khams stabs: zang thal rol pa'i mgrin pa la brgyud de: chos nyid ltor thub thugasadam bskang gyur cig dgra bgegs kyi me sa rakta tsitta la khā hi: lhag ma na bhyo: dang po phud kyis gu ru zhi ba bskang: bar du tshogs kyis padma drag po mchod: rol ston rdzas kyisa'adus pa rgya mtsho ngom: tha ma lhag mas 'khor yug bka' nyan brngan bhyo dbus na mi gnas phud la mi 'tshal ba'i: lhag ma zhal chab len pa'i tha tshig can dbang phyug nyerabargyad ma sring ging ling rnams pham 'bab bzhes la 'phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub:snye ma ma hrīngaḥbha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi: chad tho ni bhyo:snyed rgyan slob dpon padma thod 'phrengagi bka' dam la bzhag 'dzam gling dregs pa can nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi srung ma rnams: rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pas 'dir byon la chad kyi gtor ma 'dod lnga'idaga' ston bzhes: rnal 'byor dpon slob sku tshe bsrings ba dang : theg pa'i yang snying nang rgyud sde gsum gyi: bstan pa rin chen yar ngos zla ltar spel 'jin rten dus kyi rgud

pa mtha' dag sol: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: bstan ma ni bhyo: tshogs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa ni: bka' dam la gdung bstan dang 'jin rten gyi bde legs byed po brtan ma bcu gnyis po: lhab lhub rgyan dang ma sman dpung dang bcas: tha tshig ci bzhin 'bod do da tshur byon: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ston brtse ba'i rnam 'gyurabacas dbu 'phang dma' bzhin bshal chu'i brngan bzhes la: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin sgom pa'i mthun skyen sbyor: 'gal zla dgra bgegs dam sris 'tshe ba bzlog mtha' midabus su ldang ba'i rgud pa sol bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod ma sarba lo ka pā la e dam bha lirnyi kha khā khā hi khā hi: rta bro ni hrī dbang chen khros pa ma mo'itshogs rnams kyis: gnyis snang dam sri 'byung po dbang bsdus te chos nyid stong pa'i sang du bro rgyas thob don dam mngon gyur bar du ldang med rgya: ma ā hūṃ swā hā stum bha yanan nan: hrīḥ dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: rigs kun yongs 'dus padma he ru ga'i: gsang gsum byin rlabs tshad rdzogs ye shes dbang : mi gnas spros

— bral thugs kyi 1nga nas stsol: sgrub mchog pho mo smin cing grol ba dang : tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog spyod shog kwa ya sirnyi o: wakka sirnyi ā tsitta / sarba sirnyi trī: bshagasapa ni rdo gnyis snang sems kyi dbang gyur ma rig pas: cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gyur pa dang : sdom pa gsum la nyams pa'i skyon zhugs pa khyed sngags kyi phun tshogs dal du bshags: badzra sa ma ya ā: bsngo smon ni ho: snang srid rnam dag bde chen zhing du shar: phun tshogs gzhi bzung bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsringasas gzung 'dzin khams gsum srid pa'i gdos grol nas: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gral dbus spyod par re ga: bsdu rim ni ā: snod kyi zhing khams gzhal yas khang la /: de yang lha dang lha rnams gtso bo la: dam tshig ye shes sems dpa' srog yig la: gyen rdzogs nā dwa chos sku'i dgongs par bzhag: a ā: lha ldang ni shin tu phra ba 'od/la gting klong nas ye shes sgyu ma phyag rgya'i dal du ldang rjes thob shes bya bcu ru legs spyod cing: sku gnyis mdzad pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs: a phaṭa shis

brjod ni na mo gdod nasadri bral padma rgyal po'i zhal: lhan skyes bde stong drag po yab yum zhal: 'phrin las mi nub mkha' 'gro dam can gsang: mnyam rdzogs rtsa ba gsumagyi bkra shis shog: smin byed dbang gis sgo gsum mtshan ma sbyangs grol byed bskyed rdzogs dgongs pas btsan sa zin: mthong sgom mi sgob gsang lam mthar phyin te: kunabazang he ru'i dpal 'byor shis pa stsol lta ba yas 'bebs snang srid chos skur shar: spyod pa mas 'dzegs rtsol med sgyu 'bras zhib dgongs pa mi 'gyur blo bral rtogs pargyas gcer mthong cherdogabasapa chen po'i bkra shis thegag: de ltar tshogs chen bsags pa yis gnas skabs tshe yi bar chad zhi dam tshig chag nyams sor chud 'gyur nyams rtog tshe dpal lang tsho rgyas lha 'dre migasum dbang du bdu dgra bdud bgegs gyis glags mi snyed the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham dzi zhes pa 'di'angasbrang spyon nusaldan dpa' bal bskal pa chu lug zla tshes bzang por mdo khams gnas kyiya gyal gnyan po khyung tshang g.yu rtses srung skyobs byed pa'i yang dben / nub phyogs stag mo'i yang rdzongs su tshogs ston rgya chen 'bul skabs rje o rgyan chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bstan nas gdams pa 'di pha phog
ḍa gi tshul du gnang ba'o de yang don chen po dang ldan phyir gan de dra ra bar phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le

rdos dpal ri'i smon lam na na mo gu phu 'di nas lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i gling: rtsa ba klu yi rgyal bos thod du bcing: rtse mo khams gsum lha yis bstod bsngags phul: rked par 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs 'dabs su rakru'i yul gling brgya rtsas bstod: spo la dpal ri padma 'od gyi gling: tshad med lhun grub gzhal med khang mdzes nang: rang rig ngo bo bla ma padma 'byung: sgrub dang rgyud sde'i yi dam sprin phung 'khrigs: 'phags bod lo paṇa bshad sgrub bsgro gling 'ur: mkha' 'gro sde lngas tshogs ston dgyes mchod spro: ging dang liṅgas dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdung: 'phrin las spro bsdu mi mjed zhing la 'byed: mdzad pa'i rnam par brjod 'das blos mi dpog:cir yangs 'char ba'i bla ma thugs rje can: yang yang dran no mos gus thal mo sbyar ci 'byung re ltos blo snying khyed la gtad skyid sdug legs nyes 'dun ma nyid la bcol:gsol ba lhang lhang 'o dod drag tu 'bod: rnal ma'i nyams len thugs kyi sgrub par brtson gu yangs blo bde bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyer: rig pa hur byung mgon khyod thugs dang

bsre gnas snang bla ma'i gsang ba gsum du blta man ngag snying thig sems kyi dkyil du bcug: gces dgu cog bzhag bya btang blo bde bdag: nam zhig sgyu ma'i g.yar khang bor ba'i tshe mgon khyod dgyes sde mtsho rgyal 'dzum ngoms shig: dpa' bo dpa' mos glu gar rol mo bcas: mngon brjod me tog 'ja' lam la drangs te: zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas su bsu ma mdzod: padma 'od gling shar sgo nas zhugs te: 'dus pa'i grwa mjug zin pa'i skal bzang thob bla ma'i zhal mthong gsung gi gdud rtsi sim sa lam nyam rtogs rtsal chen rab rdzogs te: mgon khyed dgyes pas 'phrin las par gyur nas: gang 'dul mdzad bzang thabs mang la drangs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren ston byed shākyar cig: de ltar dpal ri'i smon lam ni nyin mtshan du rnams kun tu gdab thugs yid gcig bsres dam ldan rnams rang snang zhing der the mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin me tri'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul bzhi pa nusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i 'phrul mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni chosabadag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legagasa'aphel sarba maṅga le

/— zab chos dri med klong yangs las:drag po gnam lcags me 'bar rtsal gyi bskul ba bdud las rnam rgyal bzhugs so:/ mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya:sme34jo sha za dud bto rol mo sgrogs wa za me sbar go gas g.yab sngags rgagru ya maza byasata pho nya dam can lasal sbran dkyal lor lhazla gam dbang chen padma 'byil ba'i klong chags bral ge sar zla nyi bdud bzhi'i khar:'jigs bral che ba'i stobs rdzogs he ru ga:padma drag po dmar nag gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad thabs bsgrad dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su klubs rus rgyan dar dpyangs rab 'bar me rlung 'tshubs:ye gang bar spros:dam tshig khro bo 'jin rten khyon mnyam 'gyed:las kyi khro bo nyi rdul ltar du 'tshubs:phar phyin drug rdzogs phyag mtshan mtshon cha gdengs /ba pa'i zhal gsum pa:theg pa rim dgu 'byed pa'i spran dgu bsgrad:ste bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'i mche ba gtsigs:mnyam nyid don ston shing nas hūṃ smra

sgrogs smra smin me 'bar 'byung po gzhes bsregs byed:gdosamatshan rang grol dwangs la 'od kyi sku:ye shesasgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor tshogasa'abyed:gzhesas bral longs spyodardzogasamadzad go cha'i lha:dwangasam 'od lnga'i klong du sa ler shar:dam tshig thugs dam zhal bzhes lhag pa'i lha:dgongs pa'i dbyings nas bskul lo da tshur bzhengs nyon mongs rang mtshan bsgral ba'i dga' ston 'di:bzhes la rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las grub pa dang :nga bdag mtshan mar bzung ba'i dgra bgegasakun:stong nyid ye shes chen po'i klong du sgrol:ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo ka dag ste:he ru ka dpal srasasu byang chub mdzod:thugasadam dusal bab so sam mā:mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzod:de ltar padma drag po yi bskul ba bdud la rnam rgyal 'di byasapa'i dgra bgegasartsad na gcod mngon spyod lhun gyisagrub par 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu gye brda thim snyi cesapa 'di'ang sngagasaskyesabakra shi rab brtan na lha reg bcasate bskur ngor kho bo rgyal mtshog bshad pa rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro gsang brda rig pa'i rang bsrel lasazhal bsdus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni dge btsun zhing rgyam bya ba brasapa dge legasa'aphel sarba mgi le

rdo/ zab chos dri med 1nga yangs las drag po gnal lcags me 'bar gyi dregs pa dam 'dogs zab mo bzhugs so:༄/— na mo padma kro dha rā dza yā: 'tshadzā ཿ tha tshig bdud rtsi'i phud mchod cing padma drag ngo 'i ting 'dzin gyaḥ hrīḥ bdag nyid gang shar rang grol he ru ga: slob dpon padma snang srid zil gnon rtsal: che ba'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i dam tshig las bod khams lha srin dregs pa kun 'dus shig: dzaḥ slob dpon padma thod phreng gis: mang yul kha la'i la thog tu gangs dkar sha med la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung: khyod lha srin de yi rigs gtogs pa'i: sngon gyi khas blang ji bzhin du brgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig: 'dam re da lha ba'i snying drung du: thang lha yar bzhud la sogs pa'i: dge bsnyen thams cad dam tshig las: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung na dmar rgod tshang bya ba na 'brog gnas thams cad dam tshig las bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung

khams kyi g.yar mo thang chen du: g.ya' spang skya gcig la sogs pa'i ma sang thams cad dam kha btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung mthon po rtse dgu'i dga' tshal du: spu gri mched gsum la sogs pa'i klu bdud btsan dmags dam la btag la: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung khams pa brag gi rkang gcig der: the'u rang thams cad dam la btags bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung khyod lha srin de yi rigs gtogs pa'i: sngon kyi khas blang ji bzhin du rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' zhig: spo rong g.yag mig sa yi snar dregs pa sde brgyad dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung ru dam lung pa nag po na/ ma mo lha sman dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung ro ha khra mo brag gi tshal sha za thams cad dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung g.yu yi mtsho sngon bya ba na klu gnyan sa bdag dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung has po ri yi yang gong du: gza' dang skyes mchog rdor legs sogs dregs pa yongs rdzogs

/ske dam la btags bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung: khyod lha srin de yi rigs gtogs pa'i: sngon kyi khas blang ji bzhin du: rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' cig: gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa srungs: sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig bka' 'khu dam las 'gras pa'i bdud: nag phyogs gdug pa'i lha srin rnams skye med dbyings su ar gtad bya dgongs pa'i gzer gyis 'chor med bcing de bas bka' las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mdzod cig pa si hūṃ na ra gan a cig tsig dung dung 'dus 'dus sa ma yā: zhes brjod bdud rtsi'i phud gtor 'bul 'di ni mdos zor bskyal dus dang btsug lag mchod rten bsgrub pa'i sngon sde brgyad mchod dus sogasal bya de 'bras gang brtsam gegs med 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes chos bdag rnams kyi bzhed don grub phyir nu ldan pa smras te darma kairtesabagyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam̐

rdo/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi: dgyes bskang kun tu bzang po'i rol ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rdo/ na mo gu ru padma kro dha rwa dza ya (1 3kra3/sa snang srid 'dod rgu'i dpal yon gyis rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogasashing dam pa sku gnyisathob par 'byur sa ma yu rol mo snyan pa'i glu dang bcas hūṃ hrīḥ rab brjed rngam pa zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: lang ka pho mo yongs kyi srog gi bdag: drag po dmar nag me 'phreng thugs dam bskangs: shin tu bde mchog sbyin pa'i dam 'dzin ma rigs kyi dgyes bskang dpal ldan sgrub sde mo za byed srin mor bzhengs shing rgyas 'debs mo: nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin bde stobs thugs dam bskangs: bde chen zhing bzhugs rigs kyi bdag por shar: chags bral padma rā ga'i lcan po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi mdangs 'bar: bcom ldan 'od snang mtha' yas thugs dam bskangs: bzhugs pa ste med nam mkhar rab brten zhing

gzigs tshul phrin las thog med stobs dang ldan:las su rmongs pa klu gnyan gtod kyi gshed khro rgyal ga ru ṇa yi thugs dam bskangs:bde chen mkha' la 'bum srin 'khyil ba'i rjer ye shes rjes su 'gro ba'i dgyes ston rol phrin las mi nub bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon:gu ru gangs can mtsho yi thugs dam bskangs:rdul bral sku yi khyon la dbang bsgyur zhing:srid zhi mnyam nyid rdo rje rnon po'i 'bigs:ye shes gzigs pa mtha' yas nyi ltar gsal:dri med 'jam pa dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskangs:chags pa'i skyon bral ma tshogs las la 'gyed:bshad pa'i glu yi theg pa'i sgo brgya 'byed:stobs chen bro yis 'jigs lta zil gyis gnon:dbang chen he ru ka yi thugs dam bskangs:gsang sngags chos kyi ston dang sdud pa po:phyi nang nyer 'tshe bsrung ba'i dam tshig 'dzin:ye shes thugs mchog mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong:dpal ldan lag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangs:sa spyod gnas su 'byung ba'i lha mo lnga mkha' spyod dbyings su rigs lnga'i ma chen lnga:'og min gnasasu ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga:'bum phrag sprin gyi

rdosgo phung po'i thugs dam bskangs:drag rtsal sprul pa nyi ma'i zer bzhin spro rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam phra min mu stegs rigs ngan rbod gtong gzhom:'phrin las yakka me dbal thugs dam bskangs:ngo bo gcig las rnam rol mtha' yas pa drag rtsal rigs bzhi sgo skyong mkha' 'gro ma:bka' sdod pho nya gter srung dam can sogs:dkyil 'khor lha stogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:hū hrīḥsnang srid ro mnyam tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs bde stong dga' bzhi'i skyem gyi thugs dam bskangs kun gsal rig pa'i sgron me'i thugs dam bskangs:ye grol lta ba dag pas thugs dam bskang:ting 'dzin rdo rje'i ltad mos thugs dam bskangs:gang shar rang grol dgongs pas thugs dam bskang:tshogs drug zang thal rtogs pas thugs dam bskangs:bskang bya skong byed dngos mtshan dag pas bskangs:khyab brdal rig stong rdzogs pa chen por ā de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs:sgrib dag nyams rtog mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim lha zhes sprang spyon nus ldan dpa' bo la yo
rgyan chen po'i zhal mngon sum du gzigasanasasbagamulastag mo'i yang rdzongasan gnang ba de nyid du myur bar gtan la phab pa dge leg 'phel sarba maṅga le

༄/— 341( dge bsnyen spyo kha'i bskang ba bsdus pa ni kya:rgya mtsho klu la mnga' mdzad pa'i dge bsnyen chen po spyo kha ba:sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i zhal khro 'dzum bzhad pa'i thugs dam bskangs:snga dro'i dus su rgyu ba'i tshe:skya rengs dang po'i rta la bcibs:rnal 'byor zhi ba'i 'brin las sgrub:lha yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskangs:nyin gong dus su rgyu ba'i tshe:seng lcam dkar po'i khri la rol zab gter yongs kyi gnyer byang 'dzin:gter srung chen po'i thugs dam bskangs dgung mo'i dus su rgyu ba'i tshe:dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la bcibs khams gsum phywa g.yang 'gugs mdzad pa'i dbang sdud rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs:mun rub dus su rgyu pa'i tshe bra bo g.yu rngog chibs su bcibs:dgra bo'i tshe sgog spar gyi 'debs:sgog bdud nag po'i thugs dam bskangs:mtshan gyi dus su rgyu ba'i tshe:bsil ldan zla ba'i zer labacibs:sgrub mchog yongs la mel rtse'i skyong:dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskangs re 'ga' lha yi dmag dpon mdzad:drang srong gza' dang lhan gcig 'khod sde brgyad

sdong zla pho nyar 'gyed drang sgong chen polithugs dam bskangs:re 'ga' gnyan gyi dmag dpon mdzad:'bar ba'i mig ldan thabs gcig gnas:gdug pa ma dros las la 'gyed:me yi phung po'i thugs dam bskangs:re 'ga' sa bdag dge bsnyen mdzad:'khor los bsgyur dang lhan gcig gnas:tsang kun lto 'bye las la 'gyed sa tshon bdag po'i thugs dam bskangs re 'ga' klu yi dge bsnyen mdzad:she le thod dkar gdan gcig gnas:klu chen brgyad po las la 'gyed nā ga rā dza'i thugs dam bskangs re 'ga' gtod gyi dge bsnyen mdzad:shel gyi phung por stabs gcig gnas gting sing dkar po las la 'gyed mthu stobs can gyi thugs dam bskangs:pho brang spyo kha'i mtsho la gnas:dpal gyi phug ring zab gter bsrungs:sdig nag mtsho la mnga' dbang bsgyur gangs ldongs gnyer skyong thugs dam bskangs:hūṃ hrīḥthugs dam bskang pa'i dam rdzas ni:nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga:sman gtor rakta ga ṇa tshogs:bla rdo sgog 'khor brten sgrub rdzas:sha khrag snying sna 'bru sman dar:bza' bca'

rdo/ btung bar 'os pa'i rigs: g.yag nag zhing bkal mchod pa sogs: thugs dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyi dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskangs sprul 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam gnyan po de skong la zhi rgyas dbang drag grub pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā de ltar thugs dam bskang ba yis rnal 'byor 'dod don lhun gyis grub chags nyams dri ma sor chud 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'di'ang yang gsang rtagamo'i rdzong nas padma'i zab chos 'di kho bonu ldan pas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zinapo kairtesabagyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le ༄/ dga' ston tshogs la rol ba ni nyo bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba kun gyi dgyes ston rdzas: dngos grub rnal 'byor dpal du shar: theg chen dgongs pas spyod 'gyi'o: ga ṇa tsakra a la la ho: sirnyi pha la oṃ āḥ/ trīḥ rol ba za pos dga' ston spyod ngan so 'brul ba'i skye sgo khog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya 'di yang padma' mos bskul ro ra dbang rsā
bshad pa'i rdo rje smras yi ge garma kirtis bris dge bsagadul bya smin grol shog sarba ma le

rdoskocha gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba ni bhyo: 'du ba can gyi gnas mchog ni:shar phyogs bde chen 'brug mo'i rdzong: bkra shis ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum:phyag brnyan ging dang gnod sbyin tshogs: dga' ston 'dod yon dpal la rol g.yo ba can gyi gnas mchog ni:lho phyogs khyung tshang mchod rten rdzong:yon tan dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro 'bum:phyag brnyan btsan dang ma mo'i tshogs:ro mnyam bdud rtsi'i dpal la rol:dur khrod can gyi gnas mchog ni:nub phyogs yang dben stag mo'i rdzong:bde stong zhal bzang mkha' 'gro 'bum phyag brnyan ma bdud klu gnyan tshogs:myong grol sngags kyi dga' ston rol:bsil ba can gyi gnas mchog ni:byang phyogs ri ṣi skor gyi rdzong:'dzum bzang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:phyag brnyan bdud dang laṅga'i tshogs:dam rdzas rgyan gyi dga' ston rol:lha bu dung thod dkar po dang:nor skyong gnyan chen spun gsum dang : dge bsnyen bse yi skyes bu dang : pha waṃ long bu'i dam can rnams:'dir byon dga' ston tshogs la rol khyung tshang gnyan po g.yu rtse dang

'jigs med gzhen nu'i dpa' bo dang : rdza rgyas shan pa 'brug rgyal dang : glo ring btsan rgod dmar nag sogs: 'dir byon dga' ston tshogs la rol mtsho nag 'phrin las phur ba'i gnas: mtsho dmar padma dbang chen dal mtsho sngon dregs pa'i dpal gnas dang : 'jigs med yang dag thugs kyi mtsho gzhan yang sum brgya drug cu sogs:bdun brgya nyer lnga'i bla mtsho la brten bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: 'dir byon dga' ston tshogs la rol: 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa dang : 'od sku thob pa'i dngos grub 365: zhesasbyor sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu byu brda zim lha 'ad yang nus ldan dpa' bos so sarba maṅga le/

rdo/— zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po me yi phreng ba can gyi rtsa sgrub nyi zla'i ga'u'i tshogs mchod dngos grub bang mdzod bzhugs so:༄/— na mo gu ru badzra kro dha rā dza ya: glu/stergu duskedu1sa he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo rin za mdzes pa'i snod kyi nang bza' bca' gas pa'i dga' ston bsags mtshan 'dzan rtog pasam bslad par rgyal ba'i dgyes ston spro ba la dang po byan gyis brlabs pa ni ā: ren chen snod mchog yangs shing rgya che bar bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs rnams bsags mtshan 'dzin gnyis rtog dri ma ram̐ ye sa: sku gsum thugs mchog bskangs ba'i bdud rtsir spel: ā hūm̐ ha ho trīḥ spyan 'dren ni ( hrī rnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal gyiri: bde chen pad 'od mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje: padma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs lo paṇa bcas: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: pad drag po dmar nag me 'phreng rtsal: drag rtsal rigs bzhi go cha lha lnga sogs dga' ston ye shes tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs: dam tshigs nyams

chags ma lus bskangs ba dang : mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: sa ma hā gu ru padma kro dha rā dza sarba sa ma ya dza dza tshogs phud ni ho: chos nyid rol stonamanyam pa chen po'i rdzas: 'dod yon lha mos 'dzum pa'i gar dang bcas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs phyir 'bul: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyirabazhes su gsol: tshe ma hā ga ṇa tsakra byu dza ho bar bshags ni ho blo chung rtog pa dman pa'i dbang gyur te: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dang las dang nyon mongasadri ma bag chags kun: ye shes tshogs kyi thabs la brten te bshags: sa ma yā bhi shukhye ā: bsgral ba ni hūṃḥ thog mar bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bsgral: de nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i snying rje yis: ma rtogs sems can gnas su bsgral bar bya sku dang ye shes chen por byang chub re ga: sarba rū tra dzaḥtriḥpra we sha ya phaṭa: bstabs pa ni (ཿ bdag med yul med de bzhin nyid kyi klong: ma rtog 'o ga rtog du tra bsgral ba yi: phung khams skye mched dbang yul don snying bcas: gnyis med mnyam par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol

/— e sarba rū tra zlo tri me sa rakta tsitta la khā hi: tshogs la rol pa ni ho: gtsang dang sme bar blta ba'i rtog pa bcom: bram ze gdol ba khyi phag spyod pa la rnal /ra ro mnyam rtogs pa'i dgongs spyod kyis sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tshogs la spyod a la la ho: lhag ma ni phe: chos nyid dag pa rdo rje'i gsang srog can: ma sring /'a la rgyu ba'i dbang phyug tshogs: ming pos tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do phyon: dpal gyi pham phab lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams char ltar /sa tshe 'dir lus 'di 'od phung grol ba dang : mthong thos dran reg sangs rgyas sar 'god pa'i: ka dag lhub grub rgyal sar mnga' brnyes shog: tshe ma ma sarba uṣṭi ṭa bā ta khā hi: bzod gsol ni ho: gnyis 'dzin ma rig sems kyi dbang gyur te: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin ma gsal bying rmug 'thibs: sems dang rig pa'i shan 'byed la ma /: ma rtog 'gyu ba 'gyur med dbyings su bshags: badzra sa ma ya bhi shukhye ā: yig brgya bzlas la lhag chad bskangs bsngo smon ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge

tshogs kun: gcig tu bsdus te 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: rang rig lhan skyes sku gsum ye shes klong: 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: lan gsum bsdu ldang ni ā zhing khams gzhal yas da la lha tshogs la: 'khor rnams gtso bo de nyid ye shes sems: sems dpa' ting 'dzin thugs srog na dwa la: smra bsam brjod bral gnyug sems phra bar bzhag: a phaṭa: skad cig stong gsal rig pa'i ngang nyid las: gu ru drag po'i nga rgyal ma bral bar: snang srid sgyu ma'i dpe bcu lta bur spyod 'og min me ru 'bar bar dag smin gyur:shis brjod ni na mo: bka' rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs mkha' dang mnyam: yi dam rgya mtsho'i dngos grub sprin ltar gtibs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bde stong sbrang char 'bebs: srung mas bu ltar skyongs ba'i shis pa stsol: dang po rlung sems shes pa rang sor gnas: bar du chos nyid 'od gsal ma bu 'dres: tha ma 'jigs med gdengs thob chos skur sad: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis thegag: de ltar dga' ston tshogs phul bas bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs 'gyur sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba kun dngos gu ru rjes dad ldan

//sko jo mo mtsho rgyal la man ngag thugs kyi yang zhun gnang shin tu zab cing rno nus che stong gsum gser kyis phyur bkang ba'i yon gyis mi 'gugs mkha' 'gro'i brda kho mo'i thugs sras las can la 'phrad nas 'brel tshad 'dren gyur cig bka' 'ad dge bsnyen spyo khas srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim dzi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin dge legasadapal bzang po' bgo skal du gyurapa'i rten 'brel dang slob bu dad dam gtsang ba chos sru gas bkra shis wa reg shel gyi me long sogs kyis skyes bcas bskul ngor kho bonasaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis khyung tshang stag mo'i zab mdzod kyi gtad rgya las gtan la phabapa 'i yi ge pa ni lung zin ste tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo le

rdo — bskang rdosabyin masani oṃ āḥhūṃḥ skye med dbyings kyi ka pā lar: 'khor 'das dpal yon tshogs su shar: snang la bde stong lha mo'i sprin: kun bzang tshomarmod bla na med oṃ āḥ(ཿ 'gags med sems kyi ka pā lar: rten 'brel lugs 'byung tshogs su shar tshogs yul rang ngol lha mo'i sprin zang thal tshogs ston bla na oṃ āḥ/ཿ 'gyur med rig pa'i ka pā lar: 'od lnga lhun grub tshogs su shar kun khyab ye shes lha mo'i sprin: mtha' bral tshogs rdzas bla na med: sa ā 〉ཿ phun tshogs gamachog sku gsum zhing sgrub mchog rnal 'byor lha yi zhal: rol ston rigs lnga yab yum rdzas: myong grol sngags kyi chos nyid du: bslu med bden pas 'byung gyur cig:mkha' mdzod sngags dang rten snying brjod la mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du spel bsgyur bya'o sa ma yu rnal 'byor lam rgya tshogs rdzogs thabs skal ba can gyi dpal du shog rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi cesapa 'di'ang lu me tri'i mtshan can gyis nan tan chen posabaskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul mdzod las brgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid gyis bgyis pa'o sarba maṅga lam̐

)/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las: drag po me yi phreng ba can gyi rtsa sgrub zab mo'i tshogs mchod dngos grub bang mdzod kyi bskangs ba padmā ra ga'i phreng mdzes bzhugs so: ༄/— na mo gu ru padmā 17 dha rā dza ya: ṅka/gyegrugrebyu1/ dngos 'byor yid sprul dga' ston tshogs kun bzang rol ba'i dpal spel te chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod kyi brgyan dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskangs phyar spro hūṃ trī 'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskangs: gting gsal bde ba chen po'i 'od klong nas: longs sku rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskangs: 'ja' 'od ma 'dres thig le'i pho brang nas: rdzogs chen ston pa nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskangs: rnga yab dpal ri pad 'od pho brang nas rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskangs: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin 'khrigs tshogs rje mo: rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor thugs dam bskangs: blo gam dgu rdzogs dbang gi pho brang nas: grab chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskangs: bka' bab don brgyad 'phrin las pho brang nas: thugs sras

rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskangs: smon lam mthu btsan zab gter mdzod 'dzin pa sprul ba'i gter ston rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs bla ma sangs rgyas dngosamathong dam tshig gtsang: gter sgob las can rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs: dga' bzhi'i zlos gar zab gter lde'u mig 'dzin dgyes sde phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi thugs dmabaskangs:phyogs med 'brel tshad don ldan pho brang nas:bka' gter rnying ma bla ma'i thugs dam bskangs:hūṃ hrīX dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'khyil ba nas:gu ru drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangs: zhi ba'i 'brin las 'od dkar nub med pa:rdo rje drag rtsal yab yum thugs dam bskangs: bsod nams lhun po dgos 'dod bsam 'phel dngos: ratna drag rtsal yab yum thugs dam bskangs: bde stong 'dzum g.yo sde brgyad gtsug na spa: padma drag rtsal yab yum thugs dam bskangs: bdud bzhi'i srog 'phrog 'gro drug g.yang sa sgol:karma drag rtsal yab yum thugs dam bskangs sku gsung thugs yon 'brin las mi nub pa:sprul pa go cha lha lnga'i thugs dam bskangs:41ga 'khrul

༄/— gnyis snang rū tra'i gshed gyur pa: las mkhan lcags sdig nag po'i thugs dam bskangs: tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs bka' nyan sgo ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs: dge dang mi dge mi g.yo thal 'byin dbal: phyogs bcu khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: tshogs brgyad rang mtshan gol ba'i dgra sde'i byed: pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskangs: zab mo'i gter 'dzin sdig nag mtsho la gnas: srung ma dge bsnyen spyo kha'i thugs dam bskangs: / hrī0 ma bzungs yul snang dag pa'i dga' ston dang : ma dmigs 'dzin pa grol ba'i lha mo dang : ma bcos rang byung don gyi tshogs ston 'dis: ma lus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskangs bskangs bya skong byed dngos mtshan dag pa rnga 'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings lhug par āX de ltar bskangs bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrab dag don gnyas lhun gyis grub sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim thi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin dge legs dpa la bzang po dang dad ldan slob bu chos srung nas bkra shas dge ba'i skyes du ma bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor 7 kho bo bdud 'dul khyung drag rol pa
rtsal gyisamado kham stag mo'i mang rdzong gi mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin sī tri bgyi pa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma le

/— zab gsang dri med klong yangs las drag pa gnam lcags me 'bar gyi bskul ba gdug pa zil gnon zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na 31 gu na padma 11 dha rwa dza ya: nas 1)56ni// drag po mngon spyod las byed tshe sha khrag gtor ma bshams pa la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim nan du bya sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor bskul zhing bskang bar bya rol mo sna tshogs sgra snyir zhing snyan pa 'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do hūṃ bhyodza rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas: 'gro ba'i 'dren ston padma thod zhengs shig bzhengs shig mngon spyod las la bzhengs bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul mdzod cig mtha' yi dmags dpung cham la phob na gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod 'phrin las lhun gyis grub bar mdzod bhyo rngams brjed thod pa'i sku mkhar 'bar ba nas: bdud dang dam sri srin cing che ba'i yon tan stobs rdzogs he ru ga: ma tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: chos skyong dregs pas bran ltar las mdzad cing bka' sdod

dmag tshogs bu yug ltar 'tshubs shing:dug gsum gdon la sdang mig 1ga ltar 'khyug 'jigs tshogs lta dman zil gnon nga ro sgrogs gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs srid na mtshungs dpe bral:lhag pa'i lha mchog dmar nag me 'phreng rtsal:dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin:rnam rol 'bar ba chen po'i gzi brjed bskyed bskul lo skal ldan mos ngor da tshur byon:brgyan pa'i dpal gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la smon log dam sri rgyal bsen rdul du rlog:mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod :bhyo ma tshogs mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtsug na spa:gangs ljongs mun pa sel ba'i thugs rje can:lha gcig padma'i dgyes bskyed sa ra dza:bde ba chen po'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir gzugs skur bzhengs:dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la smon log dam sris sgol ba dbyings su bzlo bhyo:ngo bo gcig las rnam rol thabs mang pos:ma rtog log 'khrul dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad ba'i:drag rtsal rigs bzhi go cha lha lnga dang sprul pa sdig phag khyung dang khro

rdo/ chung tshogs:las mdzad sgo skyong bka' sdod dmag tshogs bcas dgongs pa'i dbyings las rnam rol gzugs skur bzhengs 'dod lnga rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhengs la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod deng sang snyigs ma'i smag rum 'thugs po ru rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po'i za kha dar:dug gsum las skyes gdon sgod bu yug 'tshubs:sems can bsam spyod mi dge bcu la gnas:gson rnams srin 'dra shi tshad 'dre ru gol:dam sri mngon rgyug byed pa'i la yog gis:bstan pa sma phab sems can bde skyid bcom:chos byed bu la mi 'dod sna dgus gzir mtha' bzhi'i dmag sna drangs shing 'khrugs rtsod sgong da ser btsa' than ngan gtong lo bcud skems:phyugs la god gtong mu ge'i char ba 'bebs:nag po sum bsgril sbos bshal gas rims dang :ltog pa sgrangs lo mgul 'gags 'bog brgyal sogs gso ru mi btub nad kyi char ba 'bebs shin tu sdug cing phongs ba'i sems can gyi:las snang 'di la thugs rjes bzod nus sam:zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam bca' 'dor

ram ci: mun sel thugs rje'i nyi ma nub song ngam: gdung ni zla ba'i chu rgyun skem gyur ram: bod 'bangs skyobs pa'i dam bca' mi g.yel lam: kye ma kye hud o rgyan rin po che dbyings nas bzhengs shig padma drag po rtsal: mngon spyod 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs: dgra bgegs gnyis la bka' yi chad pas chod: mthu rtsal med byung ston pa'i phrin las mdzod: dam tshig dus la bab so sa ma yu: zhes brjod gtor skyems dgra phyogs rteb dmod pa bor zhing drag las bya des na dgra dpung rdul du rlog bgegs tshogs rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje' bka' sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhes pa 'di sprang spyon nus ldan dpa' bo la khyung tshang g.yu rtse'i gnas nas na rgyan padma'i zhal mngon sum du bstan nasagadamasapa 'ad pha phog gi tshul du bstsal ba dusader chos bdag dharma ku mud dang rkarma girti padma a snyi ratna sa ra rnams kyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma bcas de nan dan chen pos bskul ngor gnas de nyid du phab pa'i yi ge pa ni garma kirtis brgyas pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la

lha'i dge bsnyen spyo kha' bskul byang zab mo ni bhyo: byang phyogs ri bo che ba'i sku dge bsnyen chen po spyo kha ba: mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: sha khrag ra skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan: zhing bcu tshang ba'i don snying khrol: dgra yul dug mtshon nad char phob: ming med ga pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: dus la bab so sa ma yu: skye na ga raka kro ta pa tsa la ti: dgra bgegs kyi tshe bla sgog gsum la rbad rbad: gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs ba dmod pa bor zhing drag las bya des ni mngon spyod lhun gyis grub mthu yi grags pas yongs la khyab sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi zhes pa 'di'ang khyung tsha stag mo'i rdzong nas padma'i zab gter gya gnyer byang 'di nus ldan pasayi ge pa ni lung zin ra kirtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le

/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi las kyi mthar thug zab mo byad ma rdul brlag zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dzā ya ra(shā tha khyen padma drag khros he ru ga'i bsnyen sgrub rtags mtshan bsnyen pa yi mngon spyod las gyi gzhung bsrings che'i dang po gser skyems mkhyen 'og min bde ba chen po'i dbyings: rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum: thugs dam chen pos nye bar dgongs: bdud 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod drag po'i las la chos bdag ni ma nyes sgrub la brtson: phan bde'i mdzad pa skyong ba la: dgra dang bgegs kyis ma ster bas: 'di / mgon pos gzigs: rnal 'byor grogs su gzu dpang mdzod: dgra dang bgegs la bka' chad chod padma drag khros he ru ga: dmar nag me yi phung po can:ba pa'i skal ldan la smon log rgyal bsen dam sris 'tshe 'di la ye shes gzigs pas dgongs: ste med dbyings su ar la gtod: padma'i bka' nyan dregs

pa can zo dor che phra thams cad kun: mngon spyod drag po'i las la chos: brngan ston skyems gtor 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs 'gugs bsgral brlag las mdzod: cesabarjod phud gtor mja e bskyed ni bdag nyid padma drag khros dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can du gsal ba'i mdun du:yi ge eḥnag po yongs su gyur pa las: bsgral gzhi btson khang nag po rgya che la gting zab pa dug lnga las kyi rang gshed thun mtshon dug gi char ba 'bebs pa'i nang du:dṛ dab triyongs su gyur pa las: yid la bsnag pa'i dgra bgegs de nyid kyi ru pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa: nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed cing rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam pa bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing kha nas 'o dod tsi re re 'don pa gcig tu gsal gdab: bdag mdun las spros pa'i pho nya mo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas: khams gsum srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs rten ru pa la yang yang bstim mo:

rdo/ bden brjod ni na mo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis baglu ba med pa'i bden pa dang : che mchog padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i mthus: bdag cag yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs:tshe len gyi bdud bar chad kyi byad ma rbod gtong lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad: bye'u chung khras ded pa bzhin du rang dbang med par bcing pa lngas bcing nas gzugs ru pa 'di la khug cig: bstims shig dza hūṃ baṃ rdo nyer gcag la sogs skabs dang bstan nas rtags thon bar du brjod do 'gugs las ni dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma drag po yi: sku las sprul ba'i lcags kyu mas dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: badzra aṅku sha dza dza: bcing ba'i las ni ༷ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma drag po yi: gsung las sgrul pa'i zhags pa mas: dgra bgegs bcing pa'i las mdzod cig: ratā pa sha hūṃ hūṃX bsdam pa'i las ni rba: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab che

mchog padma drag po yi: thugs las sprul ba'i lcags sgog mas: dgra bgegs sgo gsum rten la sdom: padma spo ṭa baṃ baṃ myos pa'i las ni hoḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab che mchog padma drag po yi yon tan las spros dril bu mas: dgra bgegs spyo 'bog brgyal las mdzod: karma garnye ho ho: dbye ba'i las ni (ཿ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma drag po yi: phrin las lasaspros pho nya yis: dgra bgegs lha dang dbye bar mdzod: badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa phaṭa bsgral las ni dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma drag po yi: phyag 'tshan gnam lcags phur ba'i dbal: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du thob: pad ma kai li ki la ya dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa: dgra bgegs kyi bla phur rtser blang te bstims pas sras mchog bkrag mdangs dang ldan par mos dgra bgegs kyi tshe lhag yi ge'i rnam par phur ba'i khong sengs nas drangs te bdag he ru tshe'i mthud mar bskyil bar mos: 'dren pa'i las ni e ma zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: ma rtog rmongs 'khrul snying re rje snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig gis:

rdos rnam shes skye med dbyings su spar: e spa ra ṇa phaṭa: zhes rnam shes phur rtser blangs te 'og min gyi dbyings na bzhugs pa'i he ru ga'i dgongs par phaṭa gyi sgras spar: se ha ra ṇa /ཿ zhes he ru ka dang tshul mthun pa'i sras bde ba chen por sad par mos: mtshon las na hūṃ: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab che mchog padma he ru ga'i sku las spros pa'i mtshon thun gyis dgra bgegs phung khams rdul du zlog bdud pra ma ni mā ra ya bod nan: kha la dza ma ni rbad nan: ra dza dun ling shag shig shig dum dum tshal pa tshal pa khro khro bhyo bhyo rmug rmug rbad til til tshal tshal hūṃḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma he ru ga'i: gsung las drag sngags mtshon cha'ichar dgra bgegs phung khams yul la thob drig shwa drig shā ra dza dun ling: gnod byed bsen mo khug dza: dri ra tsa pa la sgog chod: 'da' na ra tsa'i cisti phyung phyung: ldog na ra tsa'i tsastu gaskrub gtab: ra ca bse mo na ga tsig tsig: a hab hab: bee the'u sod sod: gnod byed 'byung po'i kha 'dar 'dar sgog 'dar 'dar: snying 'dar 'dar: zhe sdang snying

la rngams rngams: 'dod chags khrag la sbud sbud gti mug sha la rbad rbad: rwa dza dam sri e khur thum dza ma ra ya rbad sod hūḥ dam chig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma he ru ga'i: thugs las ye shes mtshon cha'i char dgra bgegs phung po khams la thob: dri ra tsa rgyal po'i tsitta zung zung: ma sha rbad rbad: ra tsa 'khu na dum bur shig shig:sdog na ra tsa'i tsitta phyur phyur: 'da' na ra tsa'i tsitta gtub gtubs: ya dri ya ya dri ya: ma dri ya: ma zhung dri ya: ma zhung dri ya ze dza: e khur thum dza ma ra ya rbad sod: du phur nag po'i snying la ram̐ ram̐: du phung nag po'i drag po la ye ye: du phung nag po'i thod khrag la ye shud dza: tsitta phyung phyung thun thun dza dza: trag rakru sgog rbud rbud: dza re sod: gam las ni hūḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab che mchog padma he ru ga'i: phyag mtshan shes rab ral gri yi: dgra bgegs phung khams dum bur gtubs: skyid badzra khaṅga la ram̐ ram̐:dgra bgegs kyi phung khams skye mched tshal ba dum bur sbad sod: brdung las ni hāḥ dam mig chen po'i dus la bab: che mchog padma he ru ga'i: phyag mtshan rdo rje tho chen gyis

sha dgra bgegs phung khams tshal bar brdupa dgra bgegs ta tha ya tha ya rbad sod: bstab las ni hūṃ dam chig chen po'i dus la bab che mchog padma he ru mnyam nyid zhal gyi ho khung du: rba ༅ bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabs: ma rig 'khrul ba ka dag te: sku gsum dbyings su byang chub 31ga dgra bgegs kyi ma hā me sa la 1 rakta la kha twe tsitta la kha tī: bzlog las na hūṃ bhyo: stong gsum stong gi 'jin rten kun: padma drag rtsal he ru ga'i: sku yi che pa'i yongs gtam pa: gsung gi nga ros sa pa 'dar: thugs kyi dgongs pas 'khor ba stong: yon tan 'phrin las mdzad pa yis ma rtog bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma bzlog: a 'thas sems kyi 'ching rgya bzlog: re sa nyer len spros pa bzlog: 'jigs tshogs lta ba ngan pa bzlog phyi 'byung rten 'brel rgud pa bzlog nang slong lus kyi zug rngu bzlog: gsang skyen gzung 'dzin 'khrul zlog thams cad rig stong ka dag klong: bzlog basbyar sbos pa rnam dag tu ye grol chen po'i dgongs par bzhag zor las ni hūṃ bhyo che mchog padma drag po rtsal: mngon

spyod drag po'i zor la bzhengs: sku las spros pa'i mtshon thun 'gyed: gsung las drag sngags hūṃ phaṭa sgrogs: thugs gyis sbyor sgrol dgongs pa skyongs sde brgyad dmag dpung g.yas nas spros: za gsod pho nya g.yon nas 'gyed: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs la: than dang ltas ngan char ba phob: pho rgyud skyes pa mtshon chas sod mo rgyud bud med 'gags grir chug chung gsum byis pa mngal nas skem: dkor nor gzhan gyis hab thob kyis: ming tsam med par rdul du rlog mngon spyod 'phrin las grub par mdzod:badzra sarba duṣṭan e dza bhyo: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ0 phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: yad la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams mngon spyod zer gyis rdul brlag 'gyur dusagasum 'byung po 'gog cing brgyal byad ma rbod gtong drung nasa'abyin 'di yi yon tan bsam mtha' yas nusastobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal bslu med rdo rje padma'i bka' sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhesapa 'di'ang khyung tshang gnyan po'i yang rdzong nas gter spyon nusaldan dpa' bo la o rgyan padma'i dngos su gdams rten 'brel che phyir gnas de ru phab pa'i yig risakarmas bgyis dge bas rgud tshogagazhi gyur cig sarba ma le

/ ram̐ ye sa: stong pa'i ngang las gser skyems gtor ma 'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: cha āḥhūṃḥ kyi: rin chen rin thang bral ba gseraskyems dga' 'dzum dngas ba 'dren pa g.yu yi skyems mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa khrag gi skyems: gu ru zhi drag dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul gnyis snang rū tra 'dul ba'i/ la bzhengs khams gsum yongs 11la srid gsum ka dag mdzod 'khrul ba gzhi la sangs mdzod thugs dam can:/cha gab pa'i shog drilalha de stang dug khyung me yi 'od zer 'bar: rwa bar snang mtha' bskal bzang sangs rgyas rdzogs: rtsa lha'i gnas rnams go cha lha lnga shar: ye / dal dbus thugs rten 'od 'bar klong gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur dpal chen khro bo bcu: gnam lcags rdo rje nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs rig pa hūṃ dmar hrīḥ mtshan rtsa gsum bka' sdod pho nya srung bya nor longs sprod 'pho 'gyur gzhes bral bsrung ba'i ra gur gtam: ye shes lnga rdzogs sku gdung 'bar ba la: ba spu 'od zer lnga yi drwa gur klong

phrin las sdig phag khyung nag bu yug 'tshubs 'byung po gdon tshogs rgyu ba'i skal ba med glag blta bar gcod chos kyi dbyings su sgrol mi 'da' rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mchog la gnas: sam pā dzi mnyam bzhag gisasgrom rgya las nu ldan pa so

༄/ zab gsang dri med klong yang las: drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi gtor bzlog gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs so:rdo/— na mo gu ru padma kro dha rwa dza ya: tha lu rngo27 lcags sam drag po'i sgod nang du drag po' gtor go zur gsum pa che chung rga ni khru gang bya rakta byug cing rtsang mtshe dang duganyung ru dar me ris brgyan lha grangs dang mtshungs gtor chung bskor mtha' la dbang mo'i rtsang drwa bkram dmar nag skud pas gtor thag bya mdun du drag po'i rnam lnga bshams bskyed bzla drag bskul bsgral bstab bya bzlogapa'i phrin las bcol ba ni hū bhyo: rngams brjed srin pos thod btegs dpal ri nas: 'jigs tshogs zil gnon padma he ru ga: dbang gi sku mchog bde ba'i rnam 'gyur can: garadagu rngams pa'i brtul zhugs dpal bskyed la: ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon: nyon mongs log par 'khrulaba'i dgra sde dang : smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams: mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog: hū bhyo: skye med chos sku'i dbyings su kun bzang mo 'gags med

longs spyod rdzogs mdzad wa ra tī:thugs rjes gsang ldosang skyobs mdzad sa ra dza:dpa' bo'i sku la bde ba'i rgyas 'debs bzhin:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengasal:ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol:gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon:nyon mongs log par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dmasris sbyor ba rnams:mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog:hūṃ bhyo:mi zad rdul dang bral ba'i pho brang nas sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed:'bar khrorngams pa chen po'i gar dang bcas:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la ma rig ru tra sogs/ bhyo:ma 'gags chags pa bral ba'i pho brang nas:rngams bzhad rtaskad 'dul glu'i gar dang bcas dbang gi rgyal po padma he ru ga:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig dra ༅ bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol:gnyis med gnyisasu bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon:nyon mongs log par na la ba'i dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbor ba rnams mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog:hūṃ

/— bhyo mi 'khrul mkha' gting bral ba'i pho brang nas:mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin 'jigs tshogs zil gnon dpa' brjed gar dang sa:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig sogasahū bhyo:mi zad yon tan gter gyi pho brang nas:ye shes lnga yi sang las gar bsgyur ba:nyon mongs/ra mdzad mkha' 'gro sde lnga po:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsumasna/ na:nyon mongs log par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams:mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog: hū bhyoX mi nub 'phrin lasathatsho'i klong yangs nas:gdug tshogs zil gnon yaka me dbal ni:smug nag khro rgyal 'bar ba'i gar dang bcas:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig na sgral ba'i tshogs ston rol:gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon:nyon mongs log par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang:smon lam log pa'i dam sris spror ba

rnams mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog hūṃ sbyo zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:stong nyid snying rje'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin:zhe sdang gdon 'dul rdorje drag po rtsal mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol:gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon nyon mongasalog par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog hūṃ bhyo rgyas pa smad du byung ba'i pho brang nas/mnyam nyid byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin:nga rgyal gdon 'dul ratna drag po rtsal:mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la:ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs stonarol:gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon:nyon mongs log par zhabrul ba'i dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams:mi gnas zhi ba chos kyidabyings su bzlog:hūṃ smoḥdabang chen zla gam 'bar ba'i pho brang nas bde chen dga' ba'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin:'dod chags gdon 'dul padma drag po rtsal:mngon

rdo/ spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la: ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon nyon mongs logapar 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang : smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams: mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog: hū bhyoḥ gtum drag 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang nas ris med btang bsnyom 1nga las ma g.yos bzhin: phrag dog gdon 'dul garma drag po rtsal: mngon spyod mdzad pa ston phyir da bzhengs la: ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs stonarol: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon nyon mongs log par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang : smon lam log pa'i dam sris spyor ba rnams: mi gnas zhi ba chos kyidabyings su bzlog: 〉 bhyo ༷ dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul dpal chen khro rgyal bcu: ma rig nyon mongs rgyas rnams tshar gcod phyir mngon sprod drag po'i phyag rgyar da bzhengs la ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs ston rol: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon: nyon mongs log par 'byul ba'i

dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams:mi gnas zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog:hū bhyoḥ'adzan las lhun gyis grub ba'i dkyil 'khor nas tshad medalas mdzad sgo skyong mkha' 'gro bzhi phyogs bzhi'i gdon tshogs ma lus 'dul ba dang mngon spyod drag po'i phyag rgyar da bzhengs la:ma rig ru tra bsgral ba'i tshogs stonarol:gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i dug gsum gdon nyon mongs log par 'khrul ba'i dgra sde dang :smon lam log pa'i dam sris sbyor ba rnams:mi gnas zhi ba chos kyidabyings su bzlog hūṃ bhyoḥdakar po lha dang rngams pa gshin rje'i sde:myur mdzad ma mo gtum po bdud kyi tshogs myur mgyogs btsan dang stobs ldan rgyal po dang :nganagatong gnod sbyin gdug pa klu yi sde:drang srong gza' dang sdong zla dam can sogs:padma'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams:mngon spyod mdzad pa sgrub phyir dbazhengs la:ma rig dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dpa' ston bzhes:phyi bdud mtha' yi dmag dpung 'tshub pa bzlog:nang skyen nad mug mtshon chas rgud pa bzlog:gsang ba

ḍa gnyis snang dam sris rgol ba bzlog rkyen snang zhi bzlog bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: khyung bzlog ni hū bhyo:rgyu ba stong nyid nam mkha'i khams la rgyu sa pa ri rab dpag bsam rtse la brten: zas su rgya mtsho'i klu gnyan gtod la za: las su gsang sngags bstan dang de 'dzin bsrungs: che btsan khro rgyal dag dang dgongs nyam rdzu 'phrul thogs med stobs ldan ga ru ṭa: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub phyir gnad nas bskul: nyon 'khrul bsgral ba'i las la da tshur byon brngan ston sman rakar mchod 'di bzhes la: byad dang byur dang gnad mnan rbod zor bzlog: mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog: thogs bcas snang ba'i yul bdud dbyings su /ga thogs med 'dzin pa sems sgrib rang sar bzlog dga' prod chags sdang re dogs thad gar bzlog snyems byed kun rtogs ka dag dgongs par bzlog kun rdzob 'brel phong rgud nyes pa bzlog: thams cad bzlog bsgyur mdzad pa mtha' phyin de:don dam bden pa chen po mngon gyur shog: o badzra ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa sa ma
