ya bhyoḥbhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: dbang bzlog ni bhyo dkyil 'khor yongs kyi mtha' skyong dam tshig can: rnal 'byor bran mo zhal chab len mdzad pa'i: ma sring dbang phyug nyi shu rtsabargyad ni gdug rtsub mtshon sgon dam tshig rtsang la gnas las mdzad pho nya bu yug bzhin du 'tshubs yar rtse rnon pos gza' skar thang la 'phen: dpal ngar ldan pas sabadag klu gnyan 'dar rgya mdud pho brang ma tshogs bzhugs pa'i dar: ma tram̐ lus la srin mo'i 'gros stabs can dam nyams 'chi phyir mig mang ris su bsgrel: dgongs pachos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa'i ma chen dbang phyug bskul lo da tshur pyon: zas su zhing bcu'i sha la dmar g.yos mdzod: skom du mi khrag rlon pa bhantar bskyil: gos su zhingabacu'i lngags rlon dgyes par 'chong dam tshig gcig pa'i sman rag gtor mchod bzhes: las su dgra bgegs bsgral bzlog 'phrin las mdzod: khyod kyi dbal ngar rno ba'imatshon cha'i rtse: zhing bcu tshang ba'i snying la da thob cig dug gsum gdon kyi snying la bzlog: za 'dre phung sri'i snying la bzlog: shi gshed gri bdud snying la bzlog mi mthun

/sgo— 'byung po'i snying la bzlog: thams cad ma lus rdul du brlag par mdzod: nad rig bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi rtsang gis bzlog bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cubazlog: skyen ngan nyi khri cig stong bzlog: thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod bhyo: kaḥsaX raḥdugaḥtaXdriX ma ra ya bhyo bye bzlog bzlog: e sargyu sto bzlogabacho ga: e ka bhyo bhyo: bzlog bzlog: rbad bhyo:rbad nan: sbad bzlog phaṭa: 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med byin rlabs nus mthu bsam ma khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal the tshom med dopadma'i bka' sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di yang sprang spyon nus ldan dpa' bo la khyung tshangs gnyan po g.yu rtse'i rdzong chen du rje o rgyan padma' zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon gsum du gsal bar byas te bka'abastsal ba dus der chos kyi bdag po narma kirti padma a sti dharma ku mu ta ratna sa ra rnams kyis bkra shis dge ba' skyes du ma da bcas de nas du bskul ngor gnas de ru dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni narma kirtis bgyas pa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma lam̐ dge'o dge'o dge'o
༄/ zab chos dri med klong yangs las: 'dul ba gri yi sto ga zhabrul snang ar gtad ye shes me yi 'od zeragazung 'dzin rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

rdo/— na mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dza ya: tsu sti6)spyi ma chags padma brtsegs pa'i klong yangs nas: snang ba mtha' yas mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong zer: mdangasaldan ko sha'i ze'u 'brur legs bzhad pa'i: padma 'byung gnas gangs can mtsho la 'dud: snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi smag rum 'dir: dug lngas spyos pa'i gdon tshogs 'dulaba'i phyir: drag pos gri 'dul thabs kyi cho ga la: rnam par brtson pas bdag gzhan bde legs 'phel: sa ma yā: drag po'i me dkyil gru gsum sum rim la: ral gri drug bkod lte bar chos 'byung bri: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu sgo skyong gnas: mchog rnams rdo rje rwa gdengs re res btegs: thod skam ra ba rdo rje'i dra ba dang : me yi gur khang logs gsum zla phyed rdor: drag po'i shing gis me hom rim gnyis brtsegs sreg dkyil thugs rje che ldan me bshos bzhi sha khrag snying mtshan gtor ma bzhi yaja bkod lcags zangs til yungs bsres pa'i ba ling bzhi: sgo ga lang bzhi dang zan gyi nya bo bzhi: shar du rnam lnga rgyas bsdus cha bzhi dang : lho ru gzugs sgra nub tu sman gtor raka

༄/ byang du drag po'i rtsang phur bzhi bkod do rdzas dkyil phye mar thod chang dbus su bkod:me lhar g.yas bskor bsreg lhar g.yon bskor tshul:rdzas chenabacu gnyis spus gtsang yid 'ong bkrams:dpa' 'bar rlung g.yab thod chings pang kheb dang :me dar la sogs yo byad mdzes par bkod:bdag mdun bskyed bzlas sngonagatong 'dul dkar gyi:bzlas brjod grub phral gzhung bzhin tshang bar gtong:chos skyong gter srung gsol zhing tshogs bskang bya:lhag mjug bstod bskul bsgral stabasabasdus tsam gtong :de nas 'dul ba gri yi cho ga ni:gser skyems gtor ma byin gyis rlabs la 'di skad do hū hrīḥbade bar gshegs se bcom ldan 'das:sangs rgyas kunagyi ye shes sku mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid can:drag po mngon spyod las la bzhengs:gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul bar mdzod/hū trī 'i drag po rngams pa me yi dbal:thun dang mtshon cha'i tsha tsha 'phro:mi dbang log 'dren rgyu 'os min:dregs pa dam tshig can rnams kun:gser skyems gtsang ma 'di

bzhes la: drag po mngon spyod las grub mdzod: hrī nyu thaḥdrag po miyi dbal zer 'dis: pho gdon thams cad rdul du rlog: mo gdon dam sri 'thar bar byed: klu gdon sabadag 'byung po 'dul: drag po sngags kyi dbal zer la dgra bgegs dam sri nye mi nus: mngon spyod 'phrin las dus la babs: gser skyems mchod la bka' bsgo ba ni hūṃ hūṃ/ ཿdo nub drag po mngon spyod me yi las: ye shes 'od zer thun mtshon tshang khang 'khrigs rgyal bsen dam sri bdud bgegs gzhom phyir bcams: 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pho nyayongs kyis bzhes: nyes med rang khar 'dug la dbal ma ston: bden rdzun drangs shan legs nyes bka' khrims sdoms:brngan mdzad gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhesal/mngon spyod drag pos 'dul las mthar phyin mdzod: gser skyems gtor ma mchod la 'dod don phrin las bcol sreg rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni3 snyisnyun ta krita phaṭa: sarba dra phyam shā dha yatsan āḥhūṃ bdag gothugs ka nas 'bru gsum spros mchod rdzas dang rten rdzas rnams la phog: ma dag pa'i dri ma gnyis 'dzin thams cad sbyangs te/ /dag pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi

ḍa rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa spro bar byin gyis rlabs teḥ tsho āḥhū swā hā: na maX sarba ta thā ga tā sogs/ ga ga na khaṃ ma ga ku ru ye swā hā: hūṃḥshī māṃ māṃ hūṃ a we sha ya a a: las gzhung gi 'tshams lha bskyed cing bka' bsgo bar bya me mtshams bcad pa niḥ hū hūṃ hūḥ gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni mthing gsal ra: ye shes 'bar bas nyon mongs mtshams chod cig: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me ni dkar gsal 'bar: ye shes 'bar bas 'khrug sems 'tshams chod cig nga rgyal mas pa'i me ni ser gsal 'bar: ye shes 'bar bas kheng sems mtshams chod cig: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar gsal 'bar: ye shes 'bar bas rdul mtshams chod cig phrag dog 'jams pa'i me ni ljang gsal 'bar: ye shes 'bar bas gnyis 'dzin mtshams chod cig e khaṃ sum̐ ram̐ le ma ra ya bhisnan ta krita phaṭa las ltar bgegs gtor bsngo zhing bsrung 'khor bsgom pa nas lha bskyed kya 'go bar btang ngo de nas me sbar ba ni hū dang po me byung gang nas byung: stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: ye shesalnga

yi rang mdangs su rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me byung bas: phung lnga'i mtshan ma bag chags bsreg: de nas me byung gang nas byung: 'phro byed rlung gi mkha' 1nga las: bde ba chen po'i rang mdangs su yum chen lnga yi me byung bas: 'byung lnga'i bag chags mtshan ma bsreg: me la ye shes gzi byin phob hūṃ dbus nas chos dbyings ye shes me mthing gsal gti mug 'joms byed cing: bde bshegs mdzad pa lhun grub byed: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros gzi byin phob:shar nas me long ye shes me: dkar gsal zhe sdang 'joms byed cing: zhi ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub par rdo rje mkha' 'gros gzi byin phob lho nas mnyam nyid ye shes me: ser gsal nga rgyal 'joms byed cing: rgyas pa'i 'phrin las lhun grub par: rin chen mkha' 'gros gzi byin phob: nub nas sor rtog ye shes me: dmar gsal 'dod chags 'joms byed cing: dbang gi 'phrin las lhun grub par padma mkha' 'gros gzi byin phob byang nas bya grub ye shes me ljang gsal phrag dog 'joms byed cing drag po'i 'phrin las lhun grub par: las kyi mkha'

ḍa 'gros gzi byin phob: ces phyogs bzhi dbus lnga nas me sbar de nas me lha bskyed pa ni meyi mtshan 'dzin stong par sbyangs: mi dmigs ngang las skad cig gis: ye lnga ldan 'od kyi dkyil: ra yig ljang gu'i 'od zer gyis: don gnyis byas te yongs gyur sku: me lha ljang gsal khro 'dzum sgeg: me thab be con phyag na bsnams: tshangs / ljang gu ze ral spras: rkyin dmar rlung gi shugs ldan bcibs: 'bar ba'i 'od zer kun nas 'khrigs: me lha drang srong 'khor gyis bskor: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan na no: snyan gsan dbab pa ni ho dgongs su gsol: me lha drang srong gi rgyal po chen po khyod sngon lha'i dus su sbyin sreg mdzad pa ltar : deng 'dir yang rnal 'byor ba bdag / drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir: ye shes me yi klong chen po 'dir spyan 'dren cing mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul lags na: sngon gyis thugs dam dbang gis gnas mchog ra 'byen par mdzad du gsol: me dar g.yab cing spyan 'dren pa ni hūḥ dad dang dam tshig dbang gis bskul sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i: me lha drang sgong gtso 'khor

bcas: tshur gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: 'phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal sreg blugs mchod pa bzhes su gsol: sgo aste ye dī wa ri ṣi e hya hi sa ma ya dzaḥsabaṃ ho: yo a nee ka nee ye dī wa ri ṣi sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan oṃ aste ye dī wa ri ṣi sa ma ya a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: mar pa khrul ba ni hūṃ trī: me tog bdug sbos mar me dri: zhal zas dbyangs snyan rol mo'i rigs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: sman raka gtor gsum ga ṇa tshogs drang srong me lha dgyes phyir 'bul bzhes la phrin las lhun grub mdzod o.aste ye dī wa ri ṣi badzra a/ sogs shapta pra titstsha ā (ཿ o aste ye dī wa ri ṣi rū pa shapta sogs spasne pra titstsha ā hūṃ 31 aste ye dī wa ri ṣi sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lirnyi ga ṇa tsakra khra hi drag po'i yam shing 'bulab ni hūṃ khrag dang dug gis ngar blud pa'i: drag po'i tsher nag yam shing 'di: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: sha brag bam ston bcas rte 'bul: zan lang dang shog ling bsham phral mdun du eḥlas 'chi bdag las kyi gathin rje'i bsha' khang nang bu ci las gajod byed gri sri gri gshed bur 'dre

rdo/— rnams rid cing nyams thag pa'i gzugs su gyur: na mo dkon mchog rtsa gsum sku gsum brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang : khraga'athung padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : srung ba go cha lha lnga drag rtsal rigs bzhi bdud 'dul khro bcu las mkhan lcags sdig nag po bka'asdod pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i bden stobs smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas dmigs yul gshin lcags la gnod byed sgog gcod dbugs len bla khyer za 'dre shi gshed phungasri phong byed gri sri bco brgyad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cig: lan bdun nam gsum brjod phur pa 'dril zhing bsgral las ni hū hrī nga ni padma drag po rtsal: che mchog me yi 'phrengab can: rngams brjed gtum pa'i rang bzhin la: las kyi pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs yakka me dbal thog ltar 'bebs: za gsod lce sbyang glog ltar 'khyug: mtshon chen lcagasakyi phur pa gzir: dgra bgegs gang la bya ba yi: lus srog dngos po phral bar byed: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsre: mngon spyod drag po'i dus la babs: sbyor sgrol

'dren pa'i 'phrin las mdzod o padma kro dha rā dza sarba ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: thun gdab ni hūṃ hūṃ drag po'i sku las 'phros pa'i thun: ke tshe shing tshe yungs dkar nag gnamalcags dug gi tsha tsha 'khrigs: dug gsum rang mtshan gdon tshogs kyi sha rus 'du phung thal bar rlog: bla padma kro dha rā dza/ཿ ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa: sarba dusahūṃ phaṭa yakru pradus hūṃ phaṭa: rakta shaṃ kha la ya hūṃ phaṭa badzra kha ṭwāṃ ka ka la du pa3 phaṭa: gnod byed tshal ba dum bu tig gtun ma ra ya rbad sod thun gyis brab mtshon masags par bya'o bstabs pa ni (ཿ bstan dgra bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: don snying nang rol ma lus pa ye shes me lha'i zhal du bstabs: dgyes shing rngams pa'i tshul gyis bzhes bla asteye gnodabyed gshin lcags kyi me sa rakta tsitta ba su ta ko ro tsa na ke ni ri ti la khā hi: gri lcags brdung zhing shog lang bstabasate 'di skad do (ཿ drag po las kyi me dpung 'di: don dam ye shesalnga yi kong: me lha'i rgyal po khro bo'i sma: khams gsum rol byed zhal ho gdangs : rngams rol skan sga 'jag lcar smogs: dmar zlam lngags 'dril gog lngar 'khyag 'bar

) ba'i me yi sgra chen g.yo: 'ur 'ur chems chem stong gsum 'gul: gzugs dang gzugs med lha 'dre 'dar: bdag cags dpon slob yon mchod kyi:sdon la bdud du byed pa dang : gshin gyi lcags su gyur ba rnams: chos nyid mnyam pa'i zhal du bstabs: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad dang : las ngan dug btab na rnams bstabs: kha ngan snying rtsub bdag po dang za lam gshed mchu ston rnams bstabs: thams cad ma lus grum grum rol: 'chor med las kyi phyag rgyas zungs: / da byed za 'dre gshin lcags sarba sha hūṃ a mu ga: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa sma ra sma ra: ku ru ku ru ma ra ya/ phaṭa: dzosabasresapa'i zan gyi ba mi 'bul ba ni / 'bar ba las (totho yi dgyes pa bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: lcags phye zangs phye yungs dkar nag: bstabs pas dgra bgegs nus mthu nyams: gnod byed za 'dre gshin lcags sarba sha hūṃ nga ya rbad: gtor ma labyul ba ni (ཿdpal gyigator ma sha khrag dmar gyis brgyad: dam rdzas med byung 'dod lnga'i phung po 'di rngams 'arjed rol mdzad me yi lha la 'bul

gnod byed dgra bgegs log 'dren rdul du rlog: gnod byed za 'dre gshin lcags ma ra ya dzwa la pa ya na sha ya rbad bgos nag 'byul ba niḥ hū sno thugs rje che ldan ye shes me yilharaḥ gnag gci ba chu dug spyor bshos chen poḥ lcags zangs til yungs dri chen bsres pa 'diX mchod par 'bul lo thugs rjes dgyes bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan srungs sems can phan bde spel za 'dre shi gshed gri rigs 'dul ba dang ༷ gnod byed ming med 'khrul sbubs bshig par mdzod: gla atā ye dī wa ri ṣi gnod byed za 'dre gshin lcags sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya rbad dmod gyer ba ni gnod byed za 'dre gshen lcags rnams med par mdzod cig: rengs par mdzod cig rmugs par mdzod cig phyos par mdzod cig bskrad par mdzod cigaX gzer bar mdzod cigaḥ 'ching bar mdzod cigaḥ dbye bar mdzod la ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las drag po mdzod cig sa go'abyu gnyis 'bul ba niḥ sa aste ye sto dhi bhi kṣa yeḥ dmigs yul de'i tshe rabs kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed dur sri za 'dre gshen lcags sarba

/ske sha hūṃ a mu ga da ha da nya pa tsa pa tsaḥ sma ra sma raḥ ku ru ku rtsa ma ra ya rnyi phaṭa swā ྅ zhes yam shing 'bulaḥs aste yeX a dṛ ta khā hiḥ che ge mo'i tshe rabasakyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs sogs swā 1 zhesamar khu 'bulaḥ.o a ne ka yeḥ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzra yeḥ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba la bar du sogs swā sna zhesatil rigs 'bul khyen a ne ka yeḥ sarba a sirnya yaḥ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi gnyen po la bar du sogs swā 1 zhes yungs dkar 'bul la cen asnye ye badzra a yu khe che ge'i tshe rabs kyi tshe ring ba phun sogs swā hā: zhesadur wa 'bulaḥ o aste yeḥ badzra puṣṭa ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs sogs/ zhesa'abras 'bul o aka ne yeḥ sarba saṃ bha dhi ye: che ge'i tshe rabs kyi bde ba phun sum sogs zhes zas mchog lathul ma asnye yeḥ a pra ti ha ta badzra yeX che ge'i tshe rabs kyi srung ba phun sum sogs zhes ku sha 'bulaḥ o aka ne ye ma hā bi dza yeX che ge'i tshe rabs kyi nor dang 'bru phun sum sogs zhes so ba 'bul oṃ aste ye ma hā be ga yeḥ tshege'i tshe rabs kyi myur ba'i

shugs phun sum sogasazhes nas 'bul 31 aste ye badzra ghasma ri ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi nad med pa phun sum sogasazhesagro 'bul 31 akṇi ye ma ha bā la ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi lus kyi stobs phun sum sogs zhes sran ma 'bulaḥ 31 aste yeḥ ga ga na ga ga na bi lo ki te che ge'i tshe rabs kyi rigs rgyud dang chos rgyud phun sum sogs swā snazhes shing thog labyul 〉ཿ gzi brjed 'bar ba me yi lha drang srong chen po rdzu 'phrul canaḥ thugs rjes sems can don mdzad phyir sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhesasu gsol sa sadang phye maraphul la rma ye shes sang yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di me lha'i rgyal po'i khyed la mchod pa 'bulaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyisaḥ thogs med nas bsags sdig sgrib byang ba dang byang chub sgrub la bar chad med pa dang ཿ tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod 'phel rgyas shing lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba dang gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs brlag la sogs 'jigs pa'i tshogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsolaḥ 31 aste ye gnod byed

rdo/— dzwa la ram̐ kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ o āḥshāḥ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod pa byed pa'i za 'dre gshin lcags ma ra ya ku ru ye swā snya yungs dkar thab khung du dor laḥ ho dgongs su gsol loḥ me lha'i rgyal po khyed la zhal zas sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di 'bul ba'i mthu dang ཿ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs kyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la yas kyi bdud g.yos pa dang ཿ mas kyi sri ru sdang baḥ pha mtshan gyi rgyab 'dre nye ba'i byol soḥ lo kegs dang zla kegasaḥ kau rka dang gshen lcags bzhiḥ bdun zur dang gshed loḥ zod gtong dang rbad 'dreḥ byad zor dang mnan gtad rlung gi 'khor lo dang ser gyi phung shig sdang dgra gdon bgegasaḥ gri gshed dur sri za 'dre gshin lcags la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ma ra ya ku ru ye swā rta bstod pa niḥ hūṃḥ 'byung ba'i 'od la rten byed cing 'phrin las mnga' bdag me yi lhaḥ 'bar ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i drang srong chen po khyed la bstod: me lha me dang dbyer med du bzhugs nas sbyin sreg gi mchod rdzas thams cad drag po'i

zhal du bstabs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigaḥ bzod gsol ni rdo me lha drang sgong rgyal po la sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul bas sku gsung thugs yon mnyes gyur cig cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nong gang yang mi 'chab mthol zhing bshags bzod gsol tshangs par stsal du gsolaX yig brgya bzlas la lhag ra bskangs me lha'i lto ba yang shing rgya che ba'i dbus su: las gzhung ltar lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod mjug bar btang laḥ yopadma kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra badzra a rghaṃ sogs shapta pra titstsha swā hā zhes phyi mchod khrulaḥ opadma kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra rū pa sogs dharma pra titstsha ye swā sna zhes nang mchod 'bul mapadma kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra ma ha bho dhi tsitta sta na ga na sarba phyutstsha khā hi zhes gsang mchod 'bul mapadma kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi ma hā rakta khā hiX ma hā ba lirnyi kha hiḥ drag po'i yam shing 'bul ba niḥ ñtsa khrag dang dug gis ngar blud pa'iX drag po'i rtsang phur zur gsum paḥ mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: sha khrag bam ston bcas te 'bul: lcag sgod du zan dang shog gu'i ling ga bshams bsgral gartsa ltar du

ja gser skyems mkhyen gzu e bskyed 'gugs pa las bzhi bsgral ba thun gdab drang srong dmod bzlog bcas tshangs par byas la bstan mdzug rtsa sngags mtharaḥ gabye da byed za 'dre bshanan lcags / sa rakta tsitta ba su ta ko ro tsa na ki ni ri ti la khā hi gshed bkar bya go gri ling bstab pa niḥ hūṃ0 mi rig nyon mongs bud shing gang ye shes lnga klong bsreg mdzad pa'i drag po me phreng ba can khams gsum rol byed zhal ho gdang mche ba gangs ri ltar gcigs shing: rngams rol skan sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs ༷ dmar zlum ljags 'dril glog 'od ga 'bar ba me yi sgra chen g.yo: 'ur 'ur chem chem stong gsum 'gulaḥ gzugs dang gzugs med lha 'dre 'daraḥ bdag cag dpon slob sogs ( phaṭa rdzas bsres pa'igyi ba ling 'bul ba ni (ཿ drag po me yi phreng ba can khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyiraX lcags phye zangs phye yungs dkar nag bstab pas khams gsum 'khrul rgya chod da byed za 'dre gshen lcags sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya rbad gtor ma 'bul ba ni (ཿ dpal gyi gtor ma ri ltar 'jid dang ldan: dug gsum gnas stong sha khrag rus pas brgyan

drag po dmar nag me phreng rtsal la 'bul log 'dren gdon bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlogaX gnod byed za 'dre gshen lcags ma ra ya dzwa la pa ya na sha ya rbad drag lo bshasago 'bul ba ni hū sna thugs rje che ldan drag po me 'phreng la gnag gci ba chu dug sbyor bshos chen poX lcags zang sogs bshig par mdzod: rtsa sngagasamathar gnod byed za 'dre gshen lcags sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya rbadaḥ dmod gyer ba ni bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba'i gnod byed za 'dre gshen lcags rnams med par mdzod cig rengs par sogs drag po mdzod cig sa chen bcu gnyas 'bul ba ni oṃ 5hūṃḥ.artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ bho dhi bhri kta ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi 'byer ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i gri gshed dur sri za 'dre gshen lcags sarba sha hūṃ a mu ga da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsaX sma ra sma raḥ ku ru ku dza ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa swā sna zhes yamashing 'bul rtsa sngags mthar a mṛ ta khā hiḥ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi dpal 'byor phun sum sogs swā hā: zhes mar khu phul rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzra ye che ge'i tshe rabs

rdosgo— kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba la bar du sogs zhes til rigs 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaḥsarba arna siddha yaḥ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi bgegs kyi gnyen po la bar du sogs zhes yungs dkar 'bul rtsa sngags mthar badzra a yu ste/ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi tshe ring ba phun sum sogs zhes dur wa 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaḥ badzra puṣṭa ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi 21ngas spyod phun sum sogs zhesa'abras 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba saṃ bha dhi yeX che ge'i tshe rabs kyi bde ba phun sum sogs zhesazas mchog 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaX a pra ti ha ta badzra ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi srung ba phun sum sogasazhes ku sha 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaX ma hā bi dza ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi nor dang 'bru phun sum sogasazhesaso ba 'bul rtsa sngags mthar ma hā be ga yeX che ge'i tshe rabs kyi myur ba'i phun sum sogasazhes nas 'bul rtsa sngags mthar: badzra ghasma ri ye che ge'i tshe rabs kyi nad med pa phun sum sogs zhes gro 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaX ma hā ba la yeḥ che ge'i tshe rabs kyi lus kyi stobs phun sum sogs zhes sran ma 'bul rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ga ga

na ga ga na bi lo ki te che ge'i tshe rabs kyi rigs rgyud dang chos rgyud phun sum sogs swā hā zhes shing thog 'bulaḥ( ༷ rab 'bar me yi phung po can sde brgyad lha 'dre'i sroga'aphrog pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon gcig thod phreng rtsalaX sreg blugs mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ zhes pas rdzas 'dus 'bulaX oṃ ye shes sang yangs 'khyil ba'i ho khung du:dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di0 drag po me phreng khyed la mchod pa 'bul bdag cag dpon sgob sogs mdzad du gsolaḥ rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed dzwa la ram̐ kha kha khā hi khā hi oṃ gis hūṃḥ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i za 'dre gshen lcags ma ra ya ku ru yeswā sna yungs dkar thab khung du dor la ho dgongs su gsol loḥ drag po dmar nag me yi phreng ba can khyed la zhal zas sbyin sreg gi mchod pa sogs ku ru yeswā sna gzhung gi bstod pa byaḥ bzod gsol ni hoḥ rab 'bar drag po'i lha tshogs laḥ sbyin sreg mchod pa sogs stsal du gsolaḥyig brgya bzlas la lhag chad bskangs de nas bsreg lha'i gtang rag ni / hrī padma drag po'i gsang

rdo/ gsum dgyes bskang phyir me tog bdug sbos mar me dri zhal rolaḥ gzugs sgra dri ro rig bya chos la sogs: sman gtor rakta sbyor dang sgrol mchod 'bul oṃ padma kro dha rā dza sarba sa pa ri wa ra badzra pursha sogs shasta pra titstsha ye swā snya 37 badzra du pa sogs dharma pra titstsha ye swā snya sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta rakta ba lirnya sta na ga na sto dhi tsitta sarba byu dza khā hi drag po'i yam shing 'bul ba ni (ཿ khrag dang dug gi ngar blud pa'i drag po'i rtsang thogs sogs bcas te 'bulaḥ lcags snod su zan dngashog gu'i lang ga bshams la mdun du eḥ las 'chi bdag las kyi gshen rje'i bsha' khang nang duḥtri las gnod byed gri sri gri gshed dur 'dre rnams rid cing nyam thag pa'igazugs su gyuraḥ na mo mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang : che mchog padma drag po bka' bden pa dang : sogs gri sri bco brgyad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cigaḥ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum brjod phur pa 'dril zhing (ཿ nga ni che mchog drag po rtsal rngams brjed gtum pa'i rang bzhin can

yakka me dbal skar ltar 'khrugasaX za gsod las mdzad pho nya yisaḥ sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzodaX oṃ padma kro dha rā dza sarba ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ thun gdab ni hūṃ hūṃ drag po'i sku las 'phros pa'i thun dgra 'dul gnam lcags tho lum dang bgegs gzhom phag sdig bu yug 'tshubs: phung 'dre gri sri rdul du rlog rtsa sngags mthar: bdudapra ma ni mar ya rbad nan kha la dza ma li rbad nanaX rā dza du ling shag shig shig rdu rdu shig: tshal pa tshal pa khro khro bhyo bhyo shig: rmug rmug til til tshal tshal rbadanan bstab pa niḥ(ཿ bstan dgra bsgral ba'i sha khrag rusaX dbang drag dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bulaX rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed za 'dre gshen lcags kyi me sa rakta tsitta ba su tako ro tsa na kau ni ri ti la khā hiḥ mtho gas bya zhing shog lang bstab la 'di skad doḥ(ཿ rdo rje me dpung chen po ni rtogs pa'i ye shes me 'bar klong drag po me yi phreng ba can: khamasagasum rol byed sogs ma ra yahūṃ phaṭaḥ sa bsres pa'i zan gyi ba ling 'bul ba ni 〉0 drag po'i thug dam bskangs ba'i phyir lcags phye zangs phye yungs dkar nag: 'bar ba'i

brten nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad zhi ba dang legs chogs dpal yon 'byor ba'i dngos po thams cad rgyas pa dang khams gsum srid gsum mos pa rnam bzhi dbang du 'du ba dang ཿ dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad rdul du brlag pa sogs rab 'byams 'phrin las gang brtsam pa myur du 'grub par mdzod cigaḥ skabs 'dir spro na bskang tshogs 'bul de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hū hrī ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong ཿkhro tshul gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dpa' brjed sku: pha rol phyin rdzogs phyag rdzogs mtshon cha gdengs: snang srid zung 'jug padma drag por bstodaḥ gto rag gi mchod pa niḥ hū hrīḥrnam lnga'i longs spyod 'dod lnga'i phung po dang : sman rag gtor mchod bde stong phyag rgyas gar padma drag po'i dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bulaḥ las bzhi lhun 'grub gtang rag bzhes su gsolaḥ ma badzra byu dza ma hā sa ma ya hoḥ gshegs skyems 'bul ba niḥ hu hrīḥ thabasashes rgyu las byung ba'i a mṛ taḥ rtsi bcud snying po 'bru yi mar khu 'di padma drag po'i

ḍa dkyil 'dzadar lha la 'bulaḥ las bzhi lhun 'grub gtang rag bzhes su gsol rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a bṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig gus 'bul dgyes pa bskang ཿ bstod pa ni ཿ rab 'bar me yi phung po can dug lnga rang mtshan 'khrul pa'i gshedaX padma drag po thod 'phreng rtsal: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la bstod: dngos grub niḥhūṃ trīḥ mi gnas pa chos sku'i thugs 1nga nasaX gsang gsum ye shes yon tan 'phrin las gter: sgrub mchog skal pa bzang po bdag la stsol: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis saḥ sarba sidhi pha la a la la hoḥ bzod gsol niḥhoḥ ma rig bdag gnyis dbang du gyur pasanongasaḥ cho ga'i yan lag nyams dang ting 'dzin g.yelaḥ dam tshig chags nyams la 'das zhig ral kun padma drag po'i sku gsung thugs la bshagasaḥ badzra sa ma ya ā: bsngo smon niḥho dus gsum bsags pa'i dge kun gcig bsdus teḥ 'khor gsum sa dag chen por bsngo bar bgyi lus can ma lus padma 'od zhing duḥ rig 'dzin padma'i zhabs drung 'khod par shogaḥ lan gsum bsdu ldang ni hūṃ trīX rten 'brel gzugasasku'i

phyag rgyar ldang ba kun rig bsdus mi shigs gnyug ma'i ga'ur bsdu rjes chags thugs rje'i rtsal mdangs ma 'gags pa rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po la nye bar sharaḥ a phaṭaḥ shi brjod ni na mo don dam mkha' la ye shes nyi ma shar: thugs rje'i 'od brgyas yangs ba'i mun khams sel stong gsal padma drag po'i shis pa stsol dus kyi phun tshogs ka dag mnyam pa nyid: gnas kyi phun tshogs o rgyan dpal gyi riḥ ston pa phun tshogs rang rig padma 'byung ཿ rtag par 'bral med mngon gyur bkra shis shogaḥ mtha' bral ye dag lta ba'i mkha' dbyings suḥ rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud rtog bral 'gro blo'i mun sel ye shes kyis: gang 'dul mdzad pa lhun grub bkra shis shogaḥ gawa pang shisabago rgya cho bya bsngo smon yang dag gdab gyur na don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang ཿ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya ma tshang kha bskang sreg blug 'di skal pa can gyi dpal du shog gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyizhes pa 'da'ang lungazin du mas bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bzhus te dag par phab pas yi ge pa nikṣe tra'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma la

rdo/ zab chos dri med klong yang las rgyal po brngan pa'i mdos phyogs bzhugs soX rdo sa na mo gu ru kro dha yāḥ zag midza/ lcags sna go gru mkhar gzhed du 'dod dzos gzugs bas gang 'dzom bkram rgyal po mnyes byed sku mkhar bca' steng du dmar gtor nye lnga bkod hazhal gsang gyi 'brang rgyas dang ཿ khrag skong gtor chung sku glud bskor bal rgyang 'ja' rgyang shing ris dang ཿnam mkha' mda' 'phang ci 'dzom 'jug stag ras gzigs ras dar zab brgyan de nas mdos mgron 'gugs pa ni (ཿbdag nyid gang shar rang grol he ru ga'i dbu gtsug padma snang srid zil gnon rtsal che ba'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i gzigs steng gisaX rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i 'byung po zil gnon gyur bden brjod ni na moḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang che mchog padma drag po rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzinagyi bden pa dang ཿ o rgyan chen po'i rgyal tshab brgyad 'dzin dngos slob rgyad pa dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus dug lnga rang mtshan du 'dzin pa'i 'dre gdon ste 'gro'i tshe

sgog la dbang za ba'i rgyal bsen 'byung po yid kyi gzugs can thams cad lan chags 'jal ba'i 'gron du 'dus shig gri.a ga ya dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ ho lan grangasagasum bdun dgusogs gang skabs brjod mdos dzos byin rlabs ni kyeḥ stong nyid nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa phu mdos rdzas 'dod don snang zhing srid par bkor yid sprul ting 'dzin ltad momatha' yas paX ma tshangs med par lha 'dre'i yid spyod dang : mthus pa'i mdos rdzas thogs med 'byung gyur cigaḥ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gisasprel la 'dos mchod ni kye dza nga khyer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rang bzhin la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rgya ching sma ra can: gsal byed za ba smon log shugs ldan dang ཿ rgyal 'byung mched gsum brnye dmar po dang ཿ lta baphyin log pubye sku skyes sogs ma rig nyon mongs las las skyes pa yis chos grwa 'di ru 'tshe ba'i rgyal gshed rnams lan cha gas 'jal lo sgyu ma'i mgron la 'dus gdugartsub bral bzhin bag pheb ngang gnas teḥ dga' ston 'phrul gyi dpal 'di dge bar longs kyeX chos dbyings nam mkha'i 'od gsal gzhal med khang bal rgyang 'dod don

༄/— lnga yi char ba 'bebs pho gdong dpa' bos bro brdung khrig se khrigs: mo gdong dpa' mos klu len kyu ru phu mda' ni dpa' rtsal stobs dang ldan pa'i yas 'phang la 'byung lnga'i rgud gso gru gu 'khyuraX bya tshogs rnams ni 'phur dang rtse gar bsgyuraḥ gcan zan sna tshogs ngar skad mchong rtsal 'gyedaḥ te dang rnams ni myong 'gro'i gar gyis rtse yungs dgas rnams kyang bkrag mdangs rgyan dang ldanaḥ 'brong rwa zangs las byas pa chang gis bkang ཿ rin chen zo ba 'o phud ja yis gtams mdzes pa'i yol gor zla phrum spung dar zab reg bya lho sprin ltar du bsnyilaḥ sha khrag longs spyod sna tshogs ri ltar sbungaḥ go khrab mtshon cha rtse shing bzhin du gzeng ཿ skyes pa pho glud mdzes pa'i dar chas canaḥ za ma mo glud rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes byis pa'i mngal glud 'jo sgeg rgyan dang bcasaḥ mdor na khyod kyi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i gling bzhir srid pa'i spyi mdos bdag gis 'phrul 'byung ba lnga yi glud du bzhes su gsolaḥ phung po khams dang skye mched glud du bzhesaḥ tshe dang sgog gi glud du bzhes su gsolaḥ dkor

dang spyong gi glud du bzhes su gsol rta phyugs nor gyi glud du bzhes su gsol rgyu ma'i nor gyi 'dzin zhen rtog pa ngomasaX skye 'gro'i sgog la rgol ba'i gdug rtsub zhi yongs la brnab sems byed pa'i spros pa dag phyin chad bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dang ༷ bsrung bya chos grwa 'di ru ma mtshe b.raḥ rang rang so so'i gnas su bde bar dengasaḥrgyal chen sku lnga'i bka' dam bsgo ba bzhinaX legs nyes shan drang phyes la nyams med mdzodaX skabs 'dir chang glud bsngo ba ni kyeX bdag med bdag gir bzung ba ma rig pa yul med yul la sred pa'i rgyal bsen rnamasaḥ zad med sgyu ma'i dkor la longs spyod nasaḥ ma 'khrul rang ngo rang gis rig par shogaḥ cha mang bsngo kyi cha lugs du mar brdzu ba'i 'phrul mo che skye 'gro'i tshe sgog mdangs la glag lta ba'iḥ 'byung po rnams la sgyu ma'i glud 'di 'bu'༄ byin chad gnod sems gdug rtsub zhi bar 31gaḥ sam bha ras glud gtor bsngo kyiḥ zhe sdang las las skyes pa'i rgyal gdon dang ཿ 'dod chags mtshan mar bzung ba'i dam sri moḥ kun kyang sgyu ma'i glud gtor 'di khyer laḥ bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin ma gcod

— rang sar dengasaḥ saṃ bha ra'i sngags kyis glud gtor bsngo de nas bka' bsgo ba ni kye sngon tshe brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas dang has po ri rtse mchims kyi phug pa o rgyan chen po padma thod 'phreng rtsal drag po dmar nag me phreng skur bzhengs nas rgyal chen sku lnga dam la btags pa'i tsheḥ khyod kyi btsun mo blon po ru 'dren dang ཿ/'a 'khor dus mtha'i 'byung po yan chad kyi padma'i rgyud 'dzin yongs la gnod mi bya zab gsang sgom sgrub gtsug lag gnyer kha srungasaX nyes med sems can yongs la mi rungaḥ de 'dra'i bka' nan 'khor la bsgrags par byos ཿ zhes gsung rdo rje padma'i bka' dam bzhin drag po sku lnga'i tha tshig dran par gyis dus mtha'i 'byung po rnams bka' khrims sdoms: bdag cag yon mchod chos grwar 'tshe ma byed 'phrin las dus la bab so sa ma yāX lam bstan ni kye sgyu 'phrul ma mo khams gsum bkod mdzes /: 'byung po yid kyi gzugs can bskang zin noḥ da ni gdon 'che'i bsam sbyor bral bzhin duḥ zhi ba chen po'i sems kyis rang sar dengs rwa dza sarba bighan gatstsha gas

mtshams gcod bya zhing srung 'khor sgomaḥ de nas gnas 'dir me ra 'bar ba'i zhing ཿ padma drag po'i gsang gsum lhun rdzogs dal sdig phag mtshon thun sna tshogs bu yugs 'tshubs 'di ru gnyis snang gdon tshogs ru 'os min rab 'bar ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshams gcod do badzra rakṣa rakṣa sne dge ba bsngo ji smon lam gdab bden tshig shis brjod nan du byaḥ desani bar chad rkyen snang zhi bsnyen sgrub geg med mtha' phyin 'gyuraḥ sam sruḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang gnas mchog stag mo'i yang rdzong nasaḥ o rgyan chen po' mngon sum duganang ba'i chosasku skor 'di rnams lung zin chos bdag du mas bskul ngor gnas de nyid du kho bo sprang spyon nusaldan pasadagapar phab pa' yi ge pa na lung zin narma kirtis bgyis pa dge legasa'aphelaḥ sarba ma le

sha ling khrusaniḥ e ma ma mkha' gzhu mkha' gzhu swā shāḥ bdag gi sems kyi rtogs bslad thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shigaḥ sumaḥ ma ma su ru su ru tang tang hā ཿ bdag gi kha lag gi rdul bslad pa thams cad sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sang du bsdus shigaḥ baṃX ma ma sngo ta sngo ta swā ྅ bdag gi kha sna'i chu bslad pa thams cad bams ma ma ki'i klong du bsdus shig ram̐ ma ma dzwa la dzwa ram̐ re swā hāḥ bdag gi mig rtsi dang drod 'dres pa thams cad me khams gos dkar mo'i mkha' klong du bsdus shig ma ma ra'i kong nye baṃ ho dzaX bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dri ma 'dres ba dang zhugs pa thams cad rlung khams dam tshig sgrol ma'i klong du bsdus shig a mu ka myog rbad / rbadaX thim thim rbadaḥ zhes brjod pas dgra bo las ngan de 'brug thang la lhung ba ltar sgo gsum gyi stobs zad nas ling ga la gnas par gyuraḥ zhes brjod nas sa la lan gsum brdab de nas shi lngags ltar dril nas nga du gzhugs la mngon spyod kyi las bya'oḥ sa ma yuḥ 'di'ang slob bu de wa nas bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel ba ma le bzlas pa bya ba ni/ las gzhung gi bstod pa rdzogs nas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs gar nyi ma

la gnas pa'i trag yig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba mthing nag g.yon 'khor du 'khor bar bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis phog pas thugs rgyud rab tu bskul nas ci 'dod pa'i 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par gyuraX ces brjod la/ he ru ga'i yig brgya dang gong non gyi bzlas pa sngon du 'grobs: trag rakru mu tra muX ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyo nyu raka mo te ke tsa tsa: ru lu ru lu ma ning bhyo/ ma hā kā la shā sa na hūṃ badzra sa dhu tri: zhes ci nusabazlas mthar hūṃ dngos su 'byor ba'imachod pa sna tshogs dang ཿ yid sprul zag med kun tu bzang po'i sprin bde stong zung 'jug chen por mnyam sbyor bas: lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor bcas mnyes gyur cig: shrī badzra dha 〉pa la sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs kyi mchod: hūṃ drag shul rdo rje'i lang tsho 'bar ba'i sku0 mi shig brjod bral nā da'i rang bzhin gsung / 'gyur med rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan thugasaX lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ ces pas bstod/

rdo/ zab chos dri med sang yangs las drag po gnam lcagase phreng rtsal la brten nas nyon mongs lha 'dre'i 'khrul sbub bshigs pa thugs rje'i lcag kyu bzhugs soḥ rdo/— na mo gu ru padma kro dha rā dza yaḥsngokatram̐/gsha 1 ma rig las kyis mnar ba'i 'dre nyon mongs a mthas gzul ba' gdon bdag 'dzan rang khar spyod pa' sri btsun gzugs spyang gi rgyab ser dang ཿsngags pa dam med spyod pa 'chol bu med bdud dam srog la rngamaḥde dag dug sri sdang nas su gsang sngags rnal 'byor sgrub la 'tshe de dag 'khrul ba rtsad bcad nas rang 'khrul rang ngo shes pa' phyir thugs rje'i lcags kyu 'dir brtson na rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyuraḥs ma yā sder ram kha phor chags bral na 'byu sna tsha sgog g.yer ma dang ཿla phug lo ma zas kyi rigasaX lan chags grangs mang bsags pa'i khar thal ba bag tsam bkram pa ni sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lha 'dre'i yid dang mthun par spro de nas drag po' nga rgyal kyis dri yig la ni 'gugs bstim ni na mo mchog gsum kun dngos lhag pa'i lhaX padma drag po'i bden stobs kyis nyon mongs 'khyal ba'i lha 'dre rnamasaḥming byang 'di la gnyis med khugaḥlan gsum mam dgu brjod nyes pa bsgrags pa ni kyaḥm rig pa

las 'khrul ba'i 'dreḥ nyon mongs dug lnga rang mtshan bzung ཿ nga khyod 'dzin pa yang yang bcasaḥ zhe sdang dbang gis 'gro la 'tsheḥ 'dod chags las kyis dpal 'byor rnamaX gti mug rmongs pas gnod sems 'chang ཿ phrag dog dbang gis kun la rtsodaḥ nga rgyal rgyas pas 'khor bar 'khyamasaḥ shin tu nyams thag 'khrul ba'i gdonaḥ yang cig rgyal ba'i bka' la nyonaḥ gsang sngags bden pa'i tshig la gson: sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin laX bsad pa'i lan chags srog la 'ongaḥ brdung na nad ni mang bar 'gyur dpal 'byor 'phrog na nor dbul zhing ཿ ci byas rang gi lus la sminaX sdug bsngal tshor ba sems kyis myong ༷ rgyu 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i bka'aX chos kun rten 'brel rmi lam tsam: 'di la zhen chags ma byed paraX rang snang 'khrul ba ngo shes nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rjes su snyogasaḥ de don khyod kyi ma brjed cigaḥ skyi āḥ gshin lcags pra ti bā lirnyi kha khā hi khri lan grangs nyer gcig gis bsngos la 'di skad gyeraḥhrīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngosaḥ bden gnyis bslu med bden pa mngon gsum mthong ཿ

sgo/— sems can nyon mongasazhabrul bsamyosapa laḥ bder gshegs thugs rje'i 'od lam dam chos ston gzugs su snang ba snang stong zung 'jug steḥ yi dam rgyalaba'i sku ru lam du khyeraḥ sgra ru gragasapa grags stong chos sgra teḥ yi dam rgyal ba'i bsnyen sngags dang du longasaḥ sems kyi 'gyu 'phro rang grol 'du ma byasaḥ rig stong yi dam thugs la longs spyod cigaX sna tshogs ma 'gagasarang grol rgyan du 'chong: der 'dzin spros pa bral bar rang sar zhog gang shar rang grol ye shes don la ltos rtog dpyod mtshan ma spros bral ngang la shogaḥ 'khor 'das bde sdug sems kyi byed las teX re dogs ro snyom sku gsum ngang la zhogaX smra bsam bsdod med shesarab pha rol phyinaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam chen po ste 'di don rtog na 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal khyod nyid bde gshegasakun gyi sras su 'gyuraḥ a a pāṭaḥ la gcod ni trī snang srid gdod nas dag pa sku gsum klong ཿ don dam rang ngo shesapa lta ba'i dbyings gzhes med thig le mngon gyurasgom pa'i gnadaX dag mnyams rang ngo shes pa spyod pa'i bab de don rtogasan

gnod bya gnod byed dang ཿnga bdag gdon kyi ming yang mi dmigs soḥ'adi don ma rtog zhabrul ba'i sems can rnams ye shes sgyu 'phrul mtshon chas rab gzir steḥstong nyid spros dang bral ba'i dbyingasasu bskradaḥdon dam ye shes mtshon chas mtshams bcad doḥ/ bsnya sngags brjod thun gyisabrab don dam srung ba'i rā gur phubaḥs ma yuḥ'adi ni shin tu zab pa'i lo dus kyisasnyigasamar gyur ba na semasacan nyon mongs la ba' gdon grangasamang bu yug bzhin du 'dzabs de la thab 'ad shin tu gnad chosabyed pho mo rkyen las grol semasacan yongs la bde skyid 'byung nad mug mtshona'akhrugasargyad pa zhilegasatshogasayar lnga'i zlo ltar 'phel nag phyogasagadug pa'i mgo 'phang dma' dkar phyogasadabu 'phang mtho zhing btsan nag po'i rig rnamasamago 'phang dma' thamasacad 'di yi yon tan las 'byung b.ra'agyur rogadon mja bka' 'di rgyal chen sku lnga dang ཿdge bsnyen spyo khasathub par srungs dam nyams lagatu ma shor cag thugs kya srasadang 'phrad par shogaḥsam māḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim zhes pa 'di'ang sngagasaga'on bkrashisarab brten na lha regasabacasabaskul ngor kho bo nusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul yig lasazhal bshusade dag par phabasapa'i yi ge pa ni kṣe tra dha dza bgyisapa dge leg 'phelaḥsarba maṅga le

ḍa kho bo nus ldan rdo rje la rje o rgyan chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas nasaḥ.a ho ba chos 'di'i bstan pa 'dzin mi laX chos bdag ni nu rtsa lnga 'byung padma de dga' ba'i rdo rje zhesaḥ sngags spyod kyi skyes bu dam pa 'byung ༷ rnal 'byor ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas pa 'byung ཿ/sa rtse yi dbang phyug ngo mtshar zhes sngags las byung ba'i gzhen nu 'byung ༷ mos gus kyi rnal 'byor padma chosaX zab chos kyi bdag po de yang lang ཿ thug bskyed dang ldan pa pa'i ming ཿ lha rje de chos 'di'i bdag po'oX btsun pa ni garma kirti'i ming ཿ smon lam gyi 'phro bzang 'dzom pa'o rnga yul nas chu bur mig zlum pa'i sku skyes de nus mthu / pa 'byung ༷ mos ldan te 'gyur med rgya mtsho zhesaḥ sngags skyes kyi gzhon nu dam pa 'byung ཿ 1 gros dang ldan pa'i mtshan ldan ming sngags spyon gyi rnal 'byor 'chol po /nga ཿ so ma nyi bral ba'i blo rgyam zhesaX bkur sti dang phu dud byed pa 'byung ༷ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i chos dpal zhes re zhig gi dus nas 'phrad du 'ong ༷ smon lam dang ldan

pa'i a bha'i ming bsod nams kyi skal ba 'dzom pa 'byung 0 thob thang dang ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin ming ཿchos brgyad kyis dben na sgo 'di spelaḥ yangs mo yi khrod kyi dge sgong zhes:dregs pa'i tshogs bran tu bkol ba 'byung ཿ bstan gzhi yi bdag po nges don pa zab gter 'di'i rtsa ba'i bdag po'oḥ dbang chen gyi rgyud nas bkra rab ming ཿ sgo 'di la 'dud na bstan gzhi btegs: ring la du bltams pa'i skyes bu gsumaḥ chos mdzod 'di'i bka' bab dam pa'oḥ mchog gtsang gi rgyud nas dhi ming paḥ skyen snang gis ma bcol sgo 'di'i dpal gser zhol nas mi tri'i ming can gyis 'di sgrub na grub 'bras ya mtshan mthong ཿ nges med nas mkha' spyod ming can 'byung ༷ bstan pa 'di phyogs nas phyogs su sgrogasaḥ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gzungs ma yisaḥ tshe chos kyi phral rkyen 'di yis bzlog rang rang la gtod rang skal sgo 'di sprodaḥ dpon slob kyi sku tshe mdzad 'dzan rgyas bstan pa 'di'i phyogs su daraḥ dus gsum gyi gdon sgod nye mi nus ༷ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu hyaḥ brda thimaḥñtsā zhes bkra shis stag mo'i yang rdzong nas kho bo nus ldan
/— pas smras te0 ye ge'i ris byed garma kirtis bgyis dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga leḥ gnyis re zhig dgos pa'i klong nas ma gsol/ maṅga le/

/— zab chos dri med klong yangs lasaX gu ༄ drag po gnam lcags me 'bar rtsal gyiḥ rdo rje'i tha tshig 'gyur med kyi rgya bzhugs soḥn mo kro dha padma rwa dza ya zla krathalnga ngo bdag nyid chen po padma thod 'phreng rtsal niḥ ngo bo gdod nas chos sku dang rnam dbyer ma mchis kyang ཿ rang med pa 'od zer mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po rdul bral shin tu rnam par dag dang ཿ thugs rjes gdul bya'i dpal mdzod gzigs paḥ stong gsum mi mjed kyi /nga po'i don ston pa'i gu ru bye ba phrag brgyar snang ba dang ཿ mtshon tshul tsam du zhing re re la yang sprul pa'i mtshan mchog brgyad dang ཿ 'gro 'dul gyi sprul sku gzhan yang mdzad pa dang 'phrin las rnam 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam mod kyang ༷ don la gnyis med padma gangs chen mtsho bdag nyid la lhun gyis rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa dang po lho nub 'o ma can gyi rgya mtshor pad sdong las byon pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes grags pa dang ཿ gnyis pa

'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i khams gsum dbang sdud padma rgyal po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur grags pa dang ཿ gsum pa rgyal srid thabs kyis sbang te brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par sbyangs dur khrod chen po rnams su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo khrom tshogs dang thabs gcig tu gnas te bde chen chos kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod cing grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes pa'i gu ru nyi ma 'od zer zhes yongs su grags pa dang ཿ bzhi ba ni thub pa'i nye gnas kun dga' bo las chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bgro gleng mdzad cing ༷ drang srong nyi ma'i gong la rab tu byung zhing ༷ bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas gnyis par nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis sgra bsgrags te gu ru shakya seṅger grags pa dang ཿ lnga pa ni rgyal po klu yi khyab mjug zhes ba'i mchod gnas mu steg ston pa sde drug dpung dang bcas pa tshar gcod phyir bde mchog dus kyi snying por sprul par mdzad pa dang ཿ zangs gling dang gser gling gi mu stegs pa tshar gcod phyir dge slong dbang po'i sder

rdo/ bzhengs nasaḥ'akhor rnams nang ba'i bstan pa'i sgor btsud pa dang ༷rgyal po nam mkha'i shugs can rdzu 'thul chen pos dbang du bsgyur zhing nyi ma'i shugs can gza' mi dpung dang bcas pa gsang chen sngags kyi sgor smin grol mdzad pa dang :khyad par mchod rten chen po bde byed can du zab brgya'i sgrom bi to ta ma'i sgo 'phar phyes te bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin gyis gzir tshe mu stegs pa'i nang blon la me mched cing yul bsreg par mdzad pa dang gtso bo che dgu rdo rje'i thog zer gyis stong par mdzad nasaḥ'akhor lhag ma cha shas nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la btsud par mdzad pa'i gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs zhes yongs su grags pa dang ཿdrug pa ni za hor gyi rgyal khams thams cad dbang du bsgyur phyir 'byung ba me yis ma tshig pa'i grub rtags bstan teḥlha lcam dpon g.yog lha brgya dang bcas bde ba chen po mchog gi rig 'dzin gyi sa la tshe de ru smin cing grol bar mdzad doḥbaka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bshad sgrub kyi gzhi btsug nas za hor ma smin pa'i sems can gcig kyang med par mdzad nas brag

phug chen po ma ra ti gar tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub tshe sems rtags lus la shar te 'chi med padma 'byung gnas sam slob dpon chen po padma saṃ bha wa zhes yongs su grags pa dang ༷ bdun pa ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang bal bo'i yul rnams su gsang sngags sde drug gi chos char phab cingaḥ zab gter gyi dam tshig chen po gdul bya'i dpal du sbas rgya smon lam dang bcas par mdzad pa'i gu ru blo ldan mchog srid rtsal ru grags pa dang brgyad pa ni gang can bod kyi yul gru skyong phyir 'jam dbyangs mi yi rgyal po khri sgong lde'u btsan gyis gdan drangs tsheX mang yul kha las la thog tu pheb skabs: bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis sku la gzir skabasaḥ ci yang ma nyes par drag po chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis gzir tsheX bstan ma dpung dang bcas pa 'dar yed yed du byung nas sgog snying phul la bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dngaḥ khyad par bsam yas has po ri yi yang gong du gza' klu dregs pa'i dmag tshogs 'dus te sgol ba ngan pa brtsam skabasaḥ drag po chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis 'gugs par mdzad cing rdo rje'i phyag rgyas gzer zhing artsig

rdo/ nertsig zhes drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs tshe dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi srog snying dmar lhud kyis byung zhing he ru ka la phul nas dam tshig chen po srung bar blong ཿdrag po chen po'i zab gter gyi gnyer kha re sbyin cing gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i pho nyar bskos so:phyis su bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por padma thod phreng rtsalazag med bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag skabasaX dkor srung rgyal po be dkar lcags kyi sdig pa mi srun 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam 'gyur can bsam yas kyis lung pa gang ba zhig tu sprul nas skabs lta glags tshol la 'ong skabs gu ru nyid drag po chen po'i gzugs skur mngon sum du bzhengs te:phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rjes gzir zhing g.yon sdig pa'i rke nas bsdam shing a cig cig ni tsig tsig:ra tsa 'khru na dum bur shig shigaX ces gzir tshe srog snyeng lhud kyis phyung yang drag po chen pos a tsig tsig ni tsig tsig 'da' na rā tsa'i tsitta phyung phyung zhes gzir tshe kho bo'i snying kha nas lhung la khad byas yang drag po

chen po'i zhal nas a tsig tsig ni tsig tsig sdog na rā tsa'i tsitta gtub gtubaḥ zhes gad rgyang sgrogs tshe kho bo'i snying tshal bar gas la khad byas tsheḥ srog snying phul la gsolab btab pa ni ston pa'i zhal rkyen padma drag po rtsalaḥ khyod kyi bka' nyan dam las 'da' mi byedaḥ skabs lta glag tshol byas pa bzod par gsolaḥ dam tshig ci bcol srog gi gta' ru 'dzin badzra tsitta a ma na ra gnaḥ zhes mna' bor toX o rgyan chen pos ma 'ongs bstan gzhi gtsug lag khang dang rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi dkor srung du mnga' gsol loḥ de rjes o rgyan lho nub srin yul du byon pa'i dgongs pa la bzhugs tsheḥ rgyal po nyid mas dga' nas rnam rtogs ngan pa'i rtsal mdangs g.yos te gnam thog pha wong tsam sku la phab ste dar gcig la thugs snang had kyis 'byung de las ldang tshe sgog rig sngags 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo can 'di'i skur bzhengs nas rdo rje'i phyag rgyas bcing gzir: rgyal po glang chen po la zhon nas bzod gsol 'bul du 'ong skabs bka' rtags kyi phyag rgyas bcing nas gtso 'khor sprul pa ru 'dren dang bcas pa skad cig

rdo/— gis mngon sum du lhag skabs rgyal po gtso 'khor gyi srog snying mngon du phyung ste gu ru'i dbang du bsgyur bar mdzad do dregs pa gnad la dbab pa'i dam tshig gi 'bog par byas 'di yi dus su o rgyan chen pos rgyal po 'da' ba'i gnad sel gyi chod: 'khu na gtad bzlog gi cho ga ldog na gnad dbab kyi cho ga srung bzlog rdzas sngags kyi rim paḥ 'dra min brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad de gter du sbas par mdzad nas gu ru srin po'i rgyal po ru pheb par mdzad doḥ de rdzas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa dang dug gsum gyi gdon rgod g.yo tshe o rgyan chen po'i sprul pa gter chen dang gter phran rnams kyis rgud pa sel bar mdzad pa la 'dir dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis ska ru snang ba'i dus su khams kyi gnas mchog khyung tshang stag mo'i rdzong nas rje o rgyan chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas teX sbas gnas sdig nag gi mtsho nas zab mdzod kyi sgrom rgya bkrol te mngon sum du snang ba brda ru pheb pa'o de nyid rin chen re ga skyar phun sum tshogs pa'i skal pa bzang por byas

pa'i zab chos dri med 1nga yang drag po dmar nag me 'phreng rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor sogs chen po 'di'i zhal phyes pas dus kyi gdon tshogs thams cad 'dar zhing bsngags nas dbang du 'du ba dang ༷ dmag 'khrug mtshon chas rgud pa thams cad skad cig nyid la bzlog pa'i mthu mnga' ba dang : sad ser btsa' than sogs lo thog ma rung bar bgyid pa'i rkyen thams cad 'jom pa dang ༷ gso ru mi gtub pa'i dus kyi nad rims thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'i drag po gnam lcags me 'bar ram 'chol bor khros pa'i he ru ka zhes yongs su grags pa'o ༷ dengs 'dir khyed rnam sgo 'dir dbang ba'i skal ba dang ldan phyir phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi dbang rdzogs sregs pa'i srog tig 'bar ba 'di bdag he ru gas yongs su stsal lags naḥ dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyed rnams kyis bdag po ci 'byor ba tshogs ston gyi tshal du bkod la: sgo gsum 'dzin zhen dang bral bar phul nasaḥ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod de ltar drag po'i lo rgyus 'dis slob ma'i sgo gsum spro ba skyed rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i dbang chen bskur rtogs pa ye shes gzi

/ /— byin 'bebs desani drag po sgrub la dbang ཿ he ru ka dang skal ba mnyamaḥ the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin garma girti dang padma a spyo gnyis kyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyesadu ma bcas te bskur ba dang ཿ padma badzra nas bri gzha shog dkar bcas te bskul ba don dang ldan phyir kho bo bdud 'joms pas khyung tshung stag mo'i rdzong nas zab mdzod kyi sgom rgya las ngas/sa te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni garma kirtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

ḍa zab chos dri med klong yangs lasaX drag po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur dregs pa'i srog tig dmar nag bzhugs soḥn mo padma kro dha rā dza yaḥpho 42ca sha ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs chos nyid don la mi rmongs shing ཿbskyed rdzogs grub rtags thon pa yis rang smin rjesasu gas rjes 'dzan dad sag bral ba dang ཿsnying po' chosal blo phyogs shing ཿrigasabazang ngang rgyud 'jam pa dang ཿchags sred chung zhing dam tshag ldan phu dud bkur sti byed la spro de 'dra byung na rjes su 'dzin bdag mdun bum bzlos rig me /sa bsags yan lag tshang ba'i rjes slob ma'i sgo gsum khrusakyis sbyangasaḥtho 'tshams bgegs bsal srung gur phub bden don bshad la mtshul 'bul de nasagasol ba gdab pa ni kyaḥ/rten pa ma)dzad ldan na dngos grub gter skyabs kun yongs 'dus he ru ka dpal dgongs bdag gi sgo gsum smin cing grol ba'i phyiraḥzab mo dbang gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥsum zhu bla mas lan gnang ba niḥ.e maḥtshur 47ga dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa rnamasaḥgasang chen lam la spro ba ngo mtshar che sdom gsum bsrung na dngos grub skal ba sbyin

mi nus pa rnams skal med phyir dengs shigaḥ zhes brda sprad skyab 'gro sems skyed tshogasabasags bya de nas sdom bzung bya ba ni kye dmedan mchog kun dngos he ru ka dpal dgongasaX bdag gis rigs lnga'i sdom dang dam tshig 'dzin sor byang sngags kyi gsang spyod yongs su skyong ཿ kun 'dus rang byung ye shes mngon du byaX blo bral gnad las mi 'da' sa ma yuḥlan gsum zhu dam chu sbyin pa niḥ ho spyod dka'i dam tshig spyad pa'i rig 'dzin khyodaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol zhing dam tshig srog gi mna' chu 'bul bar bgyi rdo rje gsum gyi gsang 〈snag thob par regagaḥ skyong āḥ(ཿ / āX sgo zhes dam tshig gi rten bkod la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim moḥ dam tshig 'dzin du bcug pa ni badzra sa ma mā na ra gnaḥ zhes bdud rtsi lce la bzhag go mig dar bkab cing me tog sbyin de nas slob ma lha gsal niḥ snyen ma hā shu n+ya ta gañtsahoḥ slob ma'i phung khams skye mched du 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyuraX stong pa'i ngang las las byang bzhin du gsal bar bskyed ye shes dbab bstim nan du bya de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol de nas mig dar bsal ni rte ཿ bdeg

rngo/ gshegs snying po chos sku'i zhal ༷ sgrib byed ma rig 'dong ba'i mig ye shes spyan du dbye bgyid na rang byung lha zhal mjal bar shogaḥ o dzña na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ lha ngo sprad pa niḥ o āḥ(ཿ ye nas lhan skyes 'od gsal gnyug ma 'di dri bral ka dag kun bzang padma'i zhalaḥ bde stong zung 'jug drag rtsal yab yum klong ཿgdangs rtsal ma 'gags 'khor gyi rol pa cheḥ 'di don rtogs na srid pa dbyings su stong ༷ kun mkhyen mgon po'i sras su byang chub klong a a a de nas me tog 'grul ba ni hoX rigs dang dkyil 'khor ma lus yongs rdzogs pa'i kun bzang padma thod 'phreng dkyil 'khor duḥ rig pa'i me tog 'bul lo bzhes su gsol skal bar dbang ba'i rtags kyi rten 'brel stonaḥ skyed badzra (11 pra ti tstsha hoX gsang ba'i mtshan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes bdag go de nas dngos bzhi'i dbang la phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang bzhi las dang po phyi yi dbang ni bum pa thog laḥhū hrī kun zlum bum pa rgya tshad bral ba'i dbus dbang chen yab yum gnyis med rol ba'i bcud dri med ye shes dag pas yongs su gsalaḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu

la dbang bskur roḥ nyon 'khrul dri ma bag chags sbyangs pa dang ཿ snang stong zung 'jug mngon gyur dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ཿཿ che mchog drag po rtsal yab mum kyi sku gto laḥhū trīḥ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid las rol pa 'gags med che mchog drag po rtsalaX yab yum gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya'i dbang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyinaX dregs pa ma lus las la 'du ba dang : dug gsum gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i mthu thob shog rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: rig bdag rnams gsum gyi sku gam laḥ hū hrīḥ 'chi med tshe yi dpal sbyin 'od mtha' yas: gdug pa klu 'dul khro rgyal ga ru ṭaḥ mkhyen brtse'i dpal mdzad padma thod 'phreng gi sku gsung thugs dbang skal ldan khyed la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ go cha lha lnga'i sku gto laḥ hū hrīX mkhyen rab dbang phyug dbang chen bzhad pa'i zhalaX chos kyi dbang phyug mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang ཿ khro rgyal kun 'dus yakka me dbal gyi dbang mchog dam pa rigs ldan khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: drag rtsal rig bzhi'i sku

rdo/ gtad la nyu hrīḥ gzhom bral rdo rje dpal ldan ratna'i dbyigaḥ chags pa'i rdo rje 'phrin las grub pa'i dpalaX rigs kun 'dus pa drag rtsal rigs bzhi'i yiX dbang mchog dam pa skal ldan khyod la sbyinaX rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: gtsug gtor 'khor bsgyur dang khro bo bcu'i sku gtad laḥ ( hrī bdag gzhan mtshan mar bzung ba'i bdud bzhi yi: sgol ba tshar gcod khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dbang : skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyinaḥ rdo rje bsrung ba'i yon tan mthu thob shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: sgo skyong mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i gtad laḥ sa hrīX tshad mid rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad cing 0 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brtes pa'iḥ sgo skyong mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i dbang bskur roḥ mdzad pa phrin las mtha' yas dbang 'byor shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi shiñtsa sa: dregs pa sde brgyad kyi sku gtad la hūṃ hrīX dran pa tsam gyis 'phrin las thogs med bsgrab rbad na mthu che bskal na las myar ba'i las mkhan dregs pa brgyad kyi dbang bskar roḥ 'phrin las rab 'byams thog med mthu thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya

a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: spyo kha'i sku gtad laḥ hū hrī yo rgyan chen po'i zab gter gnyer 'dzin zhing dam ldan gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i grogs bka' sdod dge bsnyen spyo kha'i dbang bskur ro yon tan 'phrin las thogs med 'grub gyur cig rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa yo: de ltar drag po chen po'i sku yi dbang bskur bas dregs pa thams cad bran du khol ba dang ཿ dug gsum 'byung po zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig gnyis pa nang gi dbang niḥ bhasnyo bdud rtsi thogs laḥ hū hrīḥ bde skyong yangs pa ka pa la yi nang ཿ bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud kyis gtams deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas chags sogs nyon mongs dri ma ka dag ste gsal stong ye shes rtogs pa mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa a: sngags 'khor gto laX hū hrī sgra mtshan mig gi spros pa ka dag cing ཿ ye shes thugs kyi dgongs 1nga mngon gyur phyir brjod bral don gyi brda dbang khyod la bskur snying po sngags kyi gzer la dbang 'byor shogaX rtsa sngags mthar wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa aX snying po trīḥyig dang hūṃ yig gam la hūṃ trī rdul bral

rdosgo— dbang byin bskur ba'i snying po hrīḥ yi dam rgyud sde'i srog gcig hūṃ mthing nagaḥ 'khor bcas mnga' dbang bsgyur phyir khyod la gtadaḥ dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer la mnga' brnyes de ga: rtsa sngags mthar wakka a snyi ṣiñtsa a: dung dkar gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ bkra shis rgyang grags chos dung skad po che ya mtshan rmad byung brda dbang khyod la bskuraX gzung 'dzin tshig gi spros pa ka dag ste gsung mchog chos kyi 'khor lor longs spyod shog: rtsa sngags mthar wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa a: de ltar drag po'i gsung dbang bskur ba'i byin rlabs kyisaḥ sgra tshig ngag gi mtshan ma rang sar dag ste yi dam he ru ga'i gsung gi 'khor lo la longs spyod cing drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs pas g.yin snang zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig gsum pa gsang dbang ni rig tsag gtad laḥ ( trīḥ 'dzum pa'i zhal bza' ngoms pa'i yid 'ong maḥ lha mo klu mo rigs lnga'i rtags 'dzin moX bde ba mchog gi dpal spod khyod la sprinaX sbor dang dga' bde'i thabs la mkhas pa yiḥ bde stong ye shes rtogs pa mngon byur shog rtsa sngags

mthar0 tsitta pra dzña na.a nu ra ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃX he ru ga'i phyag mab gam laḥ hūṃ nyi gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod ral gri gri gug dang bde chen mchog stsol bhan dmar kha ṭaṃ ga 'byung po zil gnon rdo rje lcags sdig gi brda dbang dam pa rigs ldan khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: phyag marga rigasalnga gto la hū hrī thugs mchog rdo rje mi nub 'khor lo'i dpalaḥ 'dod 'byung rin chen dbang sdud ka ma laḥ las bzhi lhun grub rgya gram 'bar ba ste sku lnga yongs rdzogs rtags kyi dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa a: dpal gyi chas brgyad gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ chags sogs zil gnon byug pa'i rdzas gsum dang : gtum rngams dbyings sbyor mnab pa'i gos gsum dang : rmongs pa tshar gcod btags pa'i rgyan gnyis teḥ dur khrod dpal chas brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro rtsa sngagasamathar tsitta a snyi ḍiñtsas rgyan drug gto laḥ hū hrīḥ rus pa'i sna cha mgul 'phreng phyag zhabs gdubaḥ do shal mchod phyir thogs sde rnam pa drag skal lngan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbin: phyin drag mdzad pas gdul bya 'dul bar thog rtsa sngags mthar tsibyu a ji

༄/ga/ ser po nor bu gri gug 'dzin: rdo dzeegro lod la sogs gu ru ma' brgyad do/ bde skyong 'khor lo garma rtsalaX ljang gsal ral gri phur pa gzir nam snyeng chobargyal sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal ba mchog dbyings mkhar chen mtsho rgyal khye'u chung lo tsā 'aprog mi dpal ye rlang dpal seng bee ro tsa na dgu'o/ kun ku he ru ka pa'i chas: 'od lnga'i klong na sgyu ma'i sku: ye shes phung po dwangs ma bskyedaḥ mdor na rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: thugs srog rdo rje sa bon las: 'od kyi ye shes spyan drangs bstims: dam ye zung 'jug chen por bzhugs: ro mnyam ye shes ngang phyag 'tshal sgo gsum mos gus dad pas bstodaX thugs gar gser gyi rdo rje'i sbubs: thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor nang: rig pa hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas: khams gsum srid gsum zas nor dbang: gnod byed rgyal bsen tshar gcod la snang grags rigs gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang : snyen āX badzra ma hā gu ru kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: bye ba gcig gis dngos grub 'grub phyi na gsang ba'i bar chad sel dbang dang daro sa grub

༄/— grub bzhugasaḥ sa badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ni na moX ma brtsal rdzogs ldan bde stong mthar thug paḥ lhan skyes ye shes gu ru drag po rtsal gzhir bzhengs che ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal loḥn mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod 'bul ni nyu hrīḥrtog pas bdag dang thugs rjes g.yin bsgral nasaḥ khams gsum rnam dag sman rag gtor chen poḥ sha khrag rus pa 'dod lnga'i dga' ston bcasaḥ rig stong bla ma drag po dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma rnam dag nas ༷ gting gsal thugs kyithig ler byang chub shogaḥ ma hā pu dza sa ma ya hoX bstod pa ni hūṃ hrīX dmar nag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs gdug pa 'dulaḥ drag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyugasaX mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa rgyas la phyag 'tshal bstod: re 'ga' dug gsum gdon 'dul sdig nag gzeraḥ nam mkha' thogs med stobs 'bar khyang nag bcibs rmongs tshogs zil gnon phag gi phyag banan canaḥ drag khros gzigs pa ldan la phyag 'tshal loḥ

'tshal ba41da 'di sgrub phan bde'i dpal 'byor 'gyur dngos grub skal bzang dam pa rtedaḥ sam yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhesapa 'di'ang drag khrosa'abar ba'i 'khor lo bde chen gsung gnasanas phab pa dang ཿdrag khro skor gsum gangs te tshe nas pheb pa 'di rnams gtad rgya dang chos skor gcig pa'o dge bsnyen sha mi'i gosacan dang ཿ byisapa gabu yi zur phud can gnyis ga'i sprul gzhi rdo rje mchog rab rtsal lagasapa rten 'brel gyi dbang gi gnas gnyisasu mngon noḥ zhesachosabadag kun bzang sngagasagazhen de dgyes phyir kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes spel ba sarba masgo lo/

bsnyedi: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag khros skor gsum dang 'brel ba'i tshogs chen kun bzang sprin phung bzhugs so:—8(: na mo padma kro dha rā dza ya za cha sgo bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs dum gcig snod du bsags byas te bsangs sbyangs spel bsgyur bya ba ni lha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis hoḥbade stong zung 'jug bhanta'i snod nang du ༷bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs rnams bsags dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa ram̐ḥyeḥkheḥzag med bdud rtsir gyur cig oṃ ā hūṃḥde nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni nyu trīX gsang chen o rgyan rang byung dur khrod 'diraḥ'abyor ldan lha mi'i longs spyod bsam mtha' yas dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo bkod mdzes par padma drag po'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs ༷sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni oṃ āḥsnotshogs rdzas ye shesalnga yi bdud rtsi ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ru rab smos rte bde sngong lnga mo'i gar bskyar dang bcas nas0drag khros bla ma'i lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaX o ma hwa ga rṇa tsakra pu dza la khā nyiḥde nas

bar gags pa niḥ ho mtshan ma'i chosadang rtog pa'i rjes 'brang nasaḥ 'khor 'das dngos mtshan bzung ba'i nyes sgrib dang ཿ sor byang sngags sdom las 'gal dri ma kun ye shes tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags bgyi'oḥ sa ma ya bhi 8khye ā de nasobasgral bstabs niḥ hū hūḥ ma rtog log 'khrul gnyis su snang ba'i bdud gzugs rten tshogs kyi rdzas la khug cig dzaḥ rnam shes skye med chos kyi dbyings su phaṭaḥ phung khams sha khrag mnyam pa nyid du rolaḥ du tra ha la ha la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kha ram̐ khā hi de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni bhyoḥ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi mtha' skyong dam 'dzin maX dbang phyug ma sring ging lang 'bar ma rnams srog gis bskul lo rlabs kyis da tshur byon pham phab bzhes pa rab 'byams phrin las sgrubs ma ma trīng bha lirnyi khā hiX de nas bskul ba niḥ hū hrī rngams brjed rnga yab bde chen pad 'od nasaḥ ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan ldan thod 'phreng rtsal che ba'i stobs bsted drag po'i skur bzhengs laX nyon 'khrul bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma ka dag mdzodaḥ de nas pha brtan niḥ bhyo rdo rje rgyal po he ru ka dpal gyi spran sngar dam mnos las mdzad pho

ga6sdo: nya rnamasaX g.yar dam bzhin du 'dir byon chad tho bzhesaḥ gang bcol 'phrin las sgrub shig dam tshig can0 gangs ldongs skyongs bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yi bstan 'gro'i dpal grogs ma sring bstan ma'i tshogs bshal chu 'di bzhes nye rgyud bstan pa skyongs phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmags bdud dpung rdul du rlog ma ma sring 'gro ma bha lirnyi kha hiḥ de nas bro gnan niḥ hrīX dbang chen rta yi 'dul glu sgrogs pa yis ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can las la sbranaḥ dkar nag dregs pa pho mo dam la bzhag gnyis snang dam sri 'byung po rdul du rlogaḥ byas āX hūṃ swā hā stum bha ya nan nan de nas bzod gsol niḥho a 'thas sems kyi 'dzin stangs 'thas dbang giḥ sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig lasaX 'gal 'das ral sogs nyams pa gang song yangaX mi 'chab mi zed yi dam lha la bshagasaḥ sa ma ya shukhye āḥ de nas bsngo smon na hoḥ rnam dkar dge dngos ma lus gcig bsdus nasaX 'khor gsum yongs dag spros mtha' bral bar bsngoḥ 'gro kun gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur nasaḥ kun tu bzang po'i gsang gsum

mngon gyur re ga lan gsumaḥ de nas bsdu ldang ni yis spros bral ngang las 'gags med sgyu 'phrul lhaḥ rim bsdu 'od gsal ka dag dbyings su rluḥ slar yang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skus rjes thob shes bya bcu ru spyod par byaḥ a ā phaṭa phaṭaḥ de nas shisabarjod ni na moḥ phag khros rngams pas klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'dar yakka me dbal rgyal bsen gdug pa'i gshed khyung zhen drag pos sde brgyad ar la gtad0 zil gnon drag po rtsal gyi bkra shis shog: de ltar smon lam shis pa brjod grub gnyis byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs bar ra bdud dpung g.yul lasargyalaḥ the tshom med do sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda tham snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin sog po lha dpal bya bami yi rdzuru pheb pa kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyasanas bskul ngor rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rjesaspel ba ma le/

gtsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX drag khros skor gsum gyi dgyes bskang 'dod 'byung sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥg rdo: na mo gu ru kro dha rā dza yaḥ zla che/14 bza' bca' gas bgo rgyan gyi rigs dpag yas blos blang dpa la 'byor sprin kun bzang rol pa' dga' ston du dmigs la lhag pa'i lha rnamasabaskangs hūṃ trīX dbang gi 'dzum zhal padma rgyas pa'i mdangasaḥ gdul bya'i dpal 'tshor gzigs pa'i thod phreng rtsalaḥ mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i skyabs gcig puḥ padma gangs can mtsho yi thugs dam bskangasaḥ mkha' lding rlabs bcas thogs med bsgrod pa canaḥ sbyor sgol ston phyir zhi dang khro tshul ngomasaḥ sangs rgyas kun dang dgongs pa mnyam pa'i zhal padma 'od zer mtha' yas thugs dam bskangs bdud bzhi'i snang ba chos kyi dbyings su bsgralaḥ ye shes gzigs pas srid zhi'i sa las skyobs theg mchog snying po'i thig ler kun kyang dril pad phyag rgya zil gnon thug dam bskangasaḥ ma rig a 'thas rang rgyad lnga ba'i gdonaḥ ste 'gro'i sgog 'dren dbugs sngad bla la 'jabaḥ sha khrag drod

mor spyod pa'i gdon tshogs kun ༷ 'thar mdzad drag khros 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangs: chags pa cha mnyam tshar gsum dgongs par gnas sdang rngams sa bon bag chags rang spyi stongaḥ mun pa'i smag tshogs ka dag dwangs klong sgrolaX rab 'jigs dmar nag me 'phreng thug dam bskangasaḥ skrang tring sgra yis sde brgyad 'bog brgyal byedaX a tsig ru lus rgyal bsen snying khrag lhud0 phe lham bam gyis 'og gdon 'thar mdzad pa'iḥrnam 'gyur gsum ngoms he ru'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ ma bzung yul snang dag pa'i dga' ston dang ཿ dmigs med 'dzin pa grol ba'i ro mnyam gteraX gnyis med 'ub chub de nyid dag pa yisaX drag khros zil gnon rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangasaḥdug gsum mtshan 'dzin grol ba'i sman gtor raka dbyings rig gnyis med mnyam pa'i tshogs chen poḥ gang shar rang grol rgyan rdzogs rol ston gyisaX bdud 'joms bzhad pa rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangasaX snang ba lha la lha thim 'ub chub ngang ཿ grags pa sngags la sngags thim zlos gar klongaḥ 'gyu 'phro ye shes thugs la thugs thim tshulaḥ mtha' grol 1nga yangs

—8rdo: 'bras bu'i dgongs par bskangasaXde ltar bskang bas tshogs chen ོgas sgrib dag nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥlhaḥzhes pa 'di'angachosabadag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel marba ma leḥ

btsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag khros skor gsum gyi rtsa dbang dregs pa'i sgog tig zab mo bzhugs soX —8rdo: na mo gu ru kro dha rā dza yaḥ canaske2) bzod dka'i nyams 'bar khros pa'i gzi padma drag po la phyag 'tshal de yi gsang gsum mngon gyur phyir smin byed dbang gi chu bo bstanaḥ sa ma yuḥslob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyangasaḥ tho 'tshams bgegs gsal srung gur phub bden don bshad la maṇḍal phulaḥ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni kyiḥ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma dgongs bdag la smin byed zab mo'i sgo he ru ka dpal che ba'i dbangaḥ gsang gsum ye shes gnang ba stsolaḥ lan gsum bla mas bka' gnang niḥ e maḥ tshur shog rdo rje'i rigs can rnamasaX yang gsang lam la mos pa legasaḥ dbang srog rtsa ba dam bsrung na dngos grub dam pa sbyin bgyi'oḥ ga bsags yan lag bdun 'bul dam chu sbyin pa niḥ hoX 'di ni gsang ba'i mna' chu steḥ rdo rje khro chen 'bar ba'i rdulaḥ slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhagaḥ dam bsrung tshe 'dir dngos grub thob nyams na mnar gcod dmyal bar lhungaḥ sa ma ya na ra gaṇaX ye shes dbab

bstims nan du bya de na bum dbang bskur ba niḥ hū hrī dur khrod thod mkhar rngams pa'i klongaḥ dbang chen drag khros gsang gsum rdzogs skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas dregs pa zil gnon mthu thob shogaḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ drag po khyung zhon gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ ngang nyid bde chen rdo rje'i 1nga: 'bar ba'i sprin 'khrigs gzhal yas nasaḥ khro rgyal stobs kun rdzogs pa'i lha khyung zhen rtsal gyi dbang bskur roḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tsheḥ drag po phag shon gyi sku gtad laḥ hū hrīX sa 'og gnyan gyi sma phab cing: nā ga zil gnon che ba'i sku 'bar ba'i gar mdzad khro zhing gtumaḥ drag po phag zhon dbang bskur roḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa yo drag po sdig sgo gyi sku gto laḥ hū hrī gar dgu'i nyams rdzog dbang chen zhal khros pa'i sdang mig klog ltar 'khyugs che btsan srid na mtshungs dpe bral drag khros sdig zhen dbang bskur roḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas srog yig gto laḥ hū hrīḥ chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas steḥ rang byung snying po srog yig hri: sde brgyad dregs pa zil gnon dbangaX nus mthu phun tshogs dpal thob shog wākka a bri 〉〉 āḥ de nas phyag mtshan rdo rje ra gdengs gtad

badzra: laḥ hū hrī nga bdag a 'thas gdon tshogs 'tharaX dug gsum 'byung po'i sgog dbugs sdud thugs mchog ye shes rdo rje yi de bzhin nyid du dbang bskur roḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ de nas gtor go dbang bskur niḥ ( byeḥ bhanta gru gsum e yi klongaX khrag 'thung gtor chen ri ltar brjedaX sha khrag rus pas rnam par brgyan dpal chen 'dus pa'i gsang gsum rdzogs padma he ru'i dbang dngos grubaḥ skal ldan bu la thob par shogaḥ mdzad pa 'phrin las rab rgyas nasaḥ 'khor ba dongs sprugs nus par 31ga bha lirnya a bhi /gas hūṃ hrīḥ mtha' rten gtad cang shis pa bo da de 'bras bde legs dpal 'byor rgyasaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang sngags skyes kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bskul ngor bdag 'dra rgyal mchog bshad pa' rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

zab gsang rdo rje snyeng po las 'jam dpal nag po nā ga rakka'i gab don sgog tig dmar chungadregs pa'i snying 'dar zhes bya ba bzhugs so —8rdo: na ma ma( 71 ka la yaḥ rtsa zung/ ma 'angasadus kyi snyegs ma la steng 'og bar gsum gdon gyas rgol ma mo' kha rlang nad gzer 'debs bal nad nag po sum sbrel dang rgya nad hal cog 'gyel dang gnyan nad rtsa rlung rgyus 'then 'byung de tshe dug gsum nad gso phyir 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub pa 'di rin chen srog gi gta' ru zungs bar chad bdud rigs g.yul las rgyal bsgom bzlos rtagasamatshan dus su gsalaḥ sa ma mā 'de la sbre ra dngosarjes dang gsumaḥ dang po dben pa'i gnas su phyin phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya sdomaḥ tho 'tshams bgegs bsal srung gur phub de nas las la 'jug par byaḥ sa ma mā skyabasa'agro ni na mo mkhyen brtse'i srid rtsa drung nas 'byin nus mthus dus kyi ru 'dzing gzhom ma rig 'khrul ba rtsad gcod pasaX nā ga rakrur skyabs su mchiḥ sems bskyed niḥhoḥmed la bden zhen 'ching bas 'thas: shin tu 'khyal zhing glan rmongs pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag bsgral bya'i phyiraḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje bsgyub par byaḥ bgegs bskrad ni hā hūṃ

nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gdon: gnyis med gnyis su 'khrul ba'i 'dre: gang shar rang grol glud gtor 'dis ngoms shing tshims la grol gyur cigaḥ hū hūṃ sarba bisto phaṭa srung gcor ni hū hū mtha' bzhi'i dri ma bral ba'i dbyings thabs shes nyi zla'i ga'u sa bdag dang bsrung bya 'gyur med gtams: ye shes lnga yi phyag rgyas btab:spyo dzñā na dhartu rakta rakta byin 'bebs niḥ / hrī sku mchog rdul dang bral ba'i zhing rab mdzes dpal ldan bkod pa nas 'jam dpal gshin rje sras 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon la byin phob cig: sgrub rdzas gnas yul dkyil 'khor la: lha sngags myong grol dbang bskur zhig e tyā hi sam yā dzaXhūṃ baṃ ho mja sabyin mas ni trīḥ skye med mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong: 'gags bral thugs rje'i rtsal g.yos la ma bshams ye rdzogs bkod pa'i sprin: gnyis med mnyam par 'bul gyis bzhes yin badzra byu dza spa ra ṇa kho: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgoms pa la rṣa 'dzin rnam gsum ni hūṃ stong pa chen po de bzhin nyid: cho 'phrul mtha' yas kun tu snang 'gags med rgyu yi sa bon ya: bsted gzhi sgog gi dwangs mar

badzra: shar: sa ma dhi ā: lha bskyed ni sa: dbyings kyiyum lngalimakha' klong du 'byung ba rims brtsegs ri rab steng dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung dbus: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong: thams cad bsnol mar bskyel ba'i khar: mthing nag ya las grub palisku 'jam dpal nā ga rakka ni: char sprin 'khrugs 'dra gtum rngams brjid: dbu dgu spyan ni gsum gsum bsgrad: mche ba rngams gtsig smar smin 'bar: rin chen sgog zhu dar lnga'i 'phan nyi zla'i snyan cha rusargyan spras: glang go zhing g.yang stag shams klubs g.yas rnams gri gug klu gnyan 'gugs: g.yon pa dgu yis sdom shing za: zhabs bsgrad 'byung po zil gyis gnon me rlung thog ser bu yug 'tshubs:dri dbal ngad kyis mdze grum gzhom be ge 'brum rig gnyan rims 'joms khro chung phag khyung sdig nag 'dzabs: dus mtha'i 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed srog gis bskul te 'og min nas ye shes lha tshogs spran drangs bstims spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ dzaḥ sku mchog rdul dang bral ba'i zhing 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid dbyings nas: 'jam dpal nā

ga ra ni: sprul pa glogasaltar 'khyugs bzhin gshegs: mdze drag grum bu lhog pa dang: 'brum bu be ge khrag bshal dang ༷ gnyan rims sum spril la sogs pa zil gnon ar gtad phyag rgyas thob: e hya hi sa ma ya dzaḥ/ baṃ ho bsas gsol ni hū trī rin chen pad nyi kha sbyor steng ༷ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gdon gsum spyi chings bsnyel ba'i khar sku mchog 'jam dpal lha tshogs bzhugs: sa ma yā dza: sa ma yā stum: phyag la'i ni na shā ma rung char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i sku: rngams brjed 'bying bag srin po'i gzugs: dug gsum gdon la gshe ba yi: nā ga raka khyod la 'dud sa ma mā na mo ho mja pa ni hū hrī: marshang nag char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i sku 'jam dpal nā ga ra la ma hā me sa'i mchod pa 'bul: rakta khrag sna'i mchod pa 'bul snying sna stong gi mchod pa 'bul dbang po rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul bdud rtsi dri chu'i mchod pa 'bul: byang sems dkar dmar mchod pa 'bul sbor sgol sman gtor mchod pa 'bul: bzhes la nyon mongs nad gdon rkyen zhi gyur phan bde'i dpal stsol zhig oṃ

badzra: ma hā du pa shabha gharnye rā sa spasne ma hā me sa rakta ko ro tsa na kengani ri ti du tra pra we sha ya phaṭa sarba sta na gha ṇa badzra pu dza sa ma ya khā ram̐ kha hi: bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī rngams brjed srin po khros 'dra'i sku: ma rung char sprin 'khrigs pa'i nyams sgeg dpa' 'jigs su rung ba yi: nā ga rakka'i sku la bstod ha he'i gad mo dgra la rgod: hi hi zhes pa dbang dang ldan: ging rus mche ba rngams gtsig can nā ga rakka'i gsung la bstod: ye shes thugs ni mkha' ltar dag: mkhyen brtse nyi ma'i zer mtha' yas: byams chen thugs rjes gdul dka' 'dul nā ga raka'i thugs la bstod 'di bzung byang chub snying po'i bar: lha khyod srog gi go tung bsnyen: snying po thugs kyi klong nas stsol: he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog: bsnyen 'dzab ni hūṃḥ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: gnas pa'i 'khor lo'i sgo 'byed cing: sprul pa'i 'khor los stong khams khyab: srid pa'i 'khor los gsang srog 'phrog: gcod pa'i 'khor los rgyas btab nas: 'jam dpal ska mchog rol pa yi: gsang gsum mngon du gyar bsam la o ma1 4 ka la na

ga rakru hūṃ phaṭa dgongasapa dbyings la bor bzhin du rang byung rtogs pa'i sgron me sbar lhan skyes 'jam dpal dpa' bo yis gsang gsum mngon gyur rtags mtshan mthong sam mā sgrub 'dzab ni hūḥ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: ye nas dbyer med chen po ru mnyam nyid rang sangs rgyas pa la: ci bzhin mngon gyur dgongs pas sgrubs dug gsum gdon gsum nad gsum grol sku gsum ye shes mngon gyur ngang : ces ma( 31 ka la nā ga raka phe le hūṃ phaṭa: bzlas pa dbugasakyi rta la drangs zer sprosa'akhor 'das dpal yon bskul brtan g.yo dkyil 'khor gsum du sgrubs rang mtshan bdag gnyis spros pa gzhom lhan skyes 'od gsal mchog tu 'bar drod tshad rtags ni bsam mtha' yas sa ma mā las 'dzab ni hū: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku las ni: khro chung mtshon thun bu yug 'tshubs: dug gsum las byung nad gdon rkyen ming gi lhag mar mdzad pa dang tshe bsod nyams rtogs ye shes rgyas lha 'dre mi gsum rang dbang 'dus: bdud srin dam sri ming med brlag rgyal ba'i mdzad pa 'phrin las sgo bsam yas phun sum tshogs grub dmigs oṃ sra sod: chu sod: turta sod dur mi ti sod gnyan mgo la chod kha

—8rdo: la dza: thim tha ra ti sa turnye dzwa ra be ge 'brum bu khrag rims gnyan rigs pra sha ma ni swā hā: drags sngags me yi 'khor lo 'di mtshon cha gdab pa'i tshul du bzla gang la gzas kyang rdul du rlog skyog ga 'byul 'khor dang mtshungs so gdon gsum 'dar byed srog snying phul mthong khol mngon sum 'byung ba ni gsang sngags grub pa'i mtshan nyid do sa ma shā gsum pa zab pamiman ngag ni gab pa dmar chung 'dur du shes dga' ston tshogs mchod 'bul ba la dang po byin gyis brlabs pa ni sa: bgastong sgod mchog ka pā lar: sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchog: 'dod don lha mo dpag med bcas: rabs 'byams rgyal ba'i dgyes bskyed spel: sa unyu badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ spyan 'dren ni hūṃ trī: rdul dang bral ba zhing khams nas: 'jam dpal sku mchog rol pa'i lha:na ga rakru'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: rnal 'byor nyams chags bskangs ba dang : thun mongs mchog gi dngos grub stsol sa ma( 41ka la nā ga rakru sa ma ya dza dza: tshogs mchod ni ho dri mid rdul dang bral ba'i sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams 'dod don tshogs la dgyes par rol: byin rlabs char

rgyun bdag la stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra byu dza khā hi: bar bshags ni ho: sems gnyis 'thas pa'i gol sgrib kyis rang byung ye shes zhal ma mthong : gcong rong du ṣa myong ba'i rgyu thabs chen tshogs kyis bskang zhing gso bla badzra sa ma ya.u tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ hū mtshon chen ral gri non po yis: bdag tu blta ba'i rū tra bsgral: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spar sha khrag phung khams tshogs su spel : sarba du tra mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭa: bstab pa ni hū hūḥ chos nyid mnyam pa'i zhal hom du log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabs bag chags 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stong : bde ba chen por dgongs rgyas gdabaX me sa rakta tsitta la khā ram̐ khā hi: tshogs larol ba ni ho: dngos grub mtshan ma dag pa'i rdzas: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di: mnyam pa nyid du rol bya zhing : tshim pa drug gi zlos gar bsgyur: 6 ma hā gha ṇa tsakra sirnyi pha la a la la ho: lhag ma ni dza maX stong pa chos dbyings srog dang ldan: rnam mang 'phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs: mkha' la 'gro zhing dam la gdung : sha khrag dri dang tshogs la dgyes: me tog mdzes pa'i chun 'phyangs

badzra: can: ratna dril g.yel sku reg bcings: rlung gi shugs ldan thog med rnams bshud pa brda' dang g.yab mos 'bod sman raka gtor ma'i dga' stonadang pham phab tshogs lhag dgyes par rol: sgrub pa'i drod spel nyams rtogs bskyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel: dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod la rig 'dzinabargyud pa'i bshul lam skyol: gnyer bcol ma g.yel myur du bsgrubs ma ma dzong3snonaṭa bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: bskul ba ni hūṃ bye sku mchog rdul dang bral ba nas: 'jamadapal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo dang : dam las log pa'i nyes pacan: zhing bcu tshangs ba'i las ngan rnams: ma rig mun pa'i smag rum nas: bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: dus la bab po sa ma yā chad mdo ni hūṃ bhyo slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: rgyal bal bod yul gnas rnams su sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: zab gter rin chen dga' ston spel: gtsug lags 'dus sde dar
