rgyas mdzad: phan bda' mdzad 'dzan spol ba' tsha: zhal bzhes dam tshag marnas pa yi:dregs pa' sde darban sum cu dang : dpal margan bdun cu rtsa gnyas dang : rje / lha bcu gsum dang srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang : gangs dkar nyer gcig srung ma yis: tha tshig dam blang dran gyis la sgrub pa mchog gi dal 'dir 'dus:gtor ma dgyes par bzhes: dgra bdud dam sri rdul du rlog: sa bcud skye rgu'i phywa g.yang spel nad mug dus kyi ru 'dzing bzlog: mtha' mi'i rdzas sngags byad phu 'jig rten bde skyid ldan par mdzod: gnyer bcol 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig dus la bab po sa ma yu: bstan ma ni bye mgos mchog padma rgyal po'i bka' bkul ba'i ma dang sring: brtan ma bcu gnyis g.yog dang bcas: lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan mangs spras: dril rta ri dwags bcib bzhin du: ming pos 'bod do da tshu dbu 'phang dma' bzhin dad gus gyis: bka' yis bshal chu 'di bzhes la so thar 'dul ba'i bcas khrims dang : gsang ba sngags kyis dam tshig rnams srog

ga sde: ru 'dzin mdzod la: sgrub pa'i drod dang rnal 'byor tshe bshad sgrub 'dus sde gtsug lags bcas: rtag par so srung dge legs spel: nyes tshogs ming gi lhag ma mdzod: gnyer bcol 'phrin las rabs 'byams sgrubs badzra pra mo ha ma ma la la ting ting bā lidha khā hi: rta bro ni hūṃ (ཿ dbang chen khrosapa ma mo'i tshogs glu gar bro la gshegs su gsol: stong pa dbyings kyis bro ra rtsa gnyis snang bdud bzhi bsgol ba'i khar rig pa ye shes bro brdung ngo: chos nyid glu yi 'dren stangs gis: 'khor ba chos skur gar gyis bsgyur: sku dang ye shes mngon gyur shog: slo pha hūṃ ya ma dam sri stam bha ya nan nan: dngos grub ni ho phyogs lhung bral ba thugs kyi dbyings: mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u nas: 'jam dpal sku yi dbang dngos grub skal ldan sgrub pa po la stsol: sirnyi pha la oṃ āXhūṃ hrīḥ bshags pa ni ho gnyis 'dzin mdud rgya dam dbang gis bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin bying rlug 'thib cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'das nongs: mi 'chab ye shes lha la bshags sa ma yā āḥ bsngo smon ni ho bsod nams bsags pa'i

dge tshogs rnams: mi dmigs chos dbyings dgongs pas bsngo: khams gsum spros rtog ka dag nas sku gsum ye shes mngon gyur 31ga: lan gsum bsdu ldang ni hū sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i rten brten pa: ka dag de bzhin nyid la bsdu: slar yang sgyu ma ltabu'i skus: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o a phaṭa: shisabarjod ni na mo ji ltar mkhyen cing ji snyed gzigs: 'jam dpal gzhon nus bkra shis shog skye 'chi'i 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur gshin rje gshed po'i bkra shis shog: rlung sems 'khor ba'i stong srog 'phrog ging ging dmar nag gdon gsum spyor ba tshar gcod pas: nā ga rakka'i bkra shis shog: 'jig rten bde zhing bstan pa dar: don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis shog de ltar sbyor dngo rjesatshang bas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub pa yis: dngos grub nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel dusakyi ru 'dzang rgol ba zhi sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugasakyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos 'brog ban lo tsā mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda' la bstems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongasapra sdom ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gzeng langs

—81: skabs nga sprul lasacan gcig dang 'phrad par ra de bar bka' 'di srung shig spu gri gsum dam nyamasalag tu ma shor tha tshig can sam mā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal nā ga raku'i gab don sgog tig dmar chung rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya gsang rgya gu byeḥmo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha pa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda' thim dzi zhesapa'ang sprul pa'i skuzub bstan dga' ba'i rdo rje dang dhe wa 'gyur rdor ratna sa ra rnamasakyi yang yang bskul ngor/kho bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisaspel ba dge legasa'aphel/sabo maṅga le/

zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:'jam dpal nā ga rakka'i rgyun 'byer shin tu bsdus pa dus kyi nad gdon rkyen 'joms mtshon 'khor 'bar ba bzhugs:badzra na mo gu ru ma( 11ya: na3(3༷/shā /sa dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na ma mo' kha rlang khrag nad dang bal nad rgyugs 'gyel bya ba dang nya gas thod gas snying tshal dang nag po sum spril bya ba 'byung dang po gnyan gyi ri bo bsnyil rnam rgyal rgya skag stag sha ba sle gre gla rtsi gu gul nag ga bur nag po bdun thang gis don dang sgod kyi geng sgo bkag gnyan tshar 'thor ba bsdu zhing 'joms bar du tshad pa'i me dbal bsad snyi gur rgya tig tsasto dkar ming can lcags kyu stag sha pa cu gang shug tsher gu gul dang snya lo hong len ba sha ka bo dkar 'dre 'jig btsan dug dang dkar mo lug dug spyi 'joms grags bcu drug me yi log gnon chu tha ma ro sbyangs lugazungs gso thar nu dur byed chu rtsa dang re lcags 'dzan pa ma rtsa thang phrom bdun sbyar bas phye btang nad ro sbyongs dkar po gcig thub gla nag rtsi 'dre 'dzags a ru shu dag dang rgya tsha me ru byi ting ga yung ba stag sha sman chen ste bcu gcig khyung ga rgong nga 'dis dus kyi nad gzer sna tshogs 'dul gag lhog yam rigs kun la sngags gnyan tshad rlang gsum bsdong ba la nag po sum sbyilazhesasu grags

lugs dkar sha sna'i khu bas gso tsanda dmar po gla gong dang thar nu hong len chu rtsa dang a nu sha chen shu dag dang bong dkar gu gul gla nag rtsi stag sha gyi lce snyi waṃ ste gur gum bdud rtsi bco lnga 'dis sum sbrel yam rigs kun la zab gnyan sod lud pa rang mdog 'gyur 'phur mong nag po a ru nag shu dag sle gre bzhi thang ga gzer gyi zug rngu thang gi bcag lud pa dmar na tsarnya btang ser na gur gum snyi waṃ phul skya sob spang rgyan cu gang sbyor dud khu spug nag spyi 'joms gtong rtse'abru shing tsha sug mel dang pi ling gur gum lnga yis bskyed dus kyi nad 'joms sman bsags nas bdud rtsi spyor la grub par brtsam sbyor dngos rjes tshangs 'di yis sgrub sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya rlung ro lan dgurabasal byas te bum chen rlung ga bas gyi gsol me rlung bdud rtsa 'thab pas bskyed dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo: dkon mchog kun dngos 'jam dpal dbyangs: na ga rakrur skyabs su mchi: gdon gsum rkyen las rnam grol phyir: 'jam dpal gshin rje sgrub par bya: lan gsum gnyis pa dngosabazhi lha bskyed ni a chosakun ye stong yum mkhar brdal snying rje chen po kun tu snang: zug 'jug rtsal las yaḥmathing nag bskyed gzhi rgyu yi sa bon shar badzra sa ma dhi ā: e ya dbyings phyugs yum lnga'i mkha' klong du:

badzra rlung me btsan dug 'khrigs pa'i dbus: thod mkhar sgo gru rta bab ldan las kyi mtshon cha thun ser 'tshubs: de dbus dug gi rgya mtsho'i klong klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong : bsnol mar rgyas btab nyi zla'i khar ya las grub pali'ajam dpal sku: na ga rakru mjing nag khro: zhal gdengs spyan bsgrad mche bzhi gtsigs smrar smin kha sbu me ltar 'bar: dmar ser ral pa srid rtser 'khyil: me yi tsha tshwa skar ltar 'khrigs: rin chen srog zhwa khyung gi tog: mgo 'phreng sbrul do zhing klubs: phyag g.yas gri gug klu gnyan 'gugs g.yon pas sbrul rigs rnams lnga bsdams: sku smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams sdog med 'chings: me rlung thogs ser dug rlang 'dzabs: phag sdig khyung gi 'du 'phro 'gyed: sa 'og gdon gyi sma phab byed: thugs klong 'jam dpal tshon gang ba'i: gsang sgogaya la sngags kyis bskor: rdo rje'i sa bon las spros pas: 'od kyis 'og min gnas mchog nas: 'jam dpal zhi drag bsam mtha' yas: nā ga rakrulirnams pa phu sbyan drangs dbyer med ro

gcig bsre: mi 'gyur bde mchog rdo rjer bzhugs: chos nyid lta ba mjal phyag phul: ting 'dzin rnam mangs dga' ston stabs: gnyis med mnyam pa chen por bzhes: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod nongs pa gang song bzod par gsol: e hya thugs dam chen po gnad nas bskul: gsang ba ye shes sgo phyes nas rang byung 'jam pa'i rdo rje ston rtags dang mtshan ma bzang por bcas: dngos grub dus las mi g.yel bar sgrub pa mchog gi dus 'dir stsol: dug gsum rang mdangs nad gdon rkyen bya sgro me la bsregs pa ltar: ming med stong par mdzad du gsol: snyed ma( 41 pele hūṃ phaṭa: bzlas pa dbug ga rta la drangs spro bsdus 'dzan las 'dzab mchod 'bul phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen gegasasel nad gdon grib rigasaganyan rims 'joms sa lam nyam rtogs 'phel zhing rgyas gdon gsum g.yul las rnam par rgyal sa ma yu snyen phegale hūṃ phaṭa: 'jam dpal nā ga rakru yis yang snying spu gri 'khor lo 'dis dug gsum la byung gdon bgegs 'thar mdze gnyan gag 'brasasrin la bsngags be ge khrag bshal stod sdog thub bye ba lnga bzlas me ltar 'bar nus pa gnam lcags thogs las ngar sam mā snyen pra chend: chu dza da:

ba tshu durta sod: durmi sod: gnyan mgon chod: kha la dza thim tha ra ti sa turnye dzwa la ri pa swā hā: 'bum phrag gsum bzlas nus ngar 'bar sde brgyad gdug pa'i kha chu skems ma mo'i nad sprin dbyings la bsdu sum sgril gnyan gyis ri bo bshag be ge khrag bshal ming med byed bdud rtsi sman la ngar blud na sleb chog thog rgod 'bar bar grags lag blang nyes pa'i phyogs 'jomasayin de yi rjesaganang zhu 'dod na khrus dang bgegs bsal srung 'khor phub maṇḍal phul ba sngon song nas 'o da lam 'jam dpa la nā ga raku'i rjes gnang zab mo sbyin dgos na khyed cag dad pa mos gus dang ldan pas gsan 'tshal lha 'di ni 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs mkhyen brtse gter chen gyi gzigs pa yin pas dus kya snyigs mar nad mtshon rgud pa sna dgus gzir tsa na sman par byed pa' bdud rtsi lta bu gdon gsum 'dul ba'i 'jigasamed tho lum gnyan rim bsregs pa me ya dbal ngar sum spril gso ba ra bo zil gnon 'jags med las kyi pha lam lta bu 'jam dpal nā ga rakra' rjes gnang zab mo zhu phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'dis rjes zlos mdzod (shā: bla ma dpa' bo chen pos dgongs: bdag ni dus kyi nad gdon rkyen: 'jigs pa kun las dbug dbyung phyir: na ga rakru'i rjes gnang stsol: lan gsum bla mas ho gson dang las

can skal ba bzang : 'jam dpal ye mkhyen khros pa'i sku: nā ga rakka 'di bsnyen na: gdon gsum g.yul las rgyal ba thob: 'byung po rnams ni nye mi nus: de phyir dga' dang spro bas 'jug sa ma yā: sdom bzungs ni hoḥ rdo rje 'jin pa bdag la dgongs: thar ba don du gnyer ba yis: dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs: 'gro don byang chub sems mchogs bskyed: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam 'dzin: dbang skur gsang ba mchog gi dpal: nā ga rakka'i rjes gnang stsol: lan gsum dam chu sbyin pa ni he gsang ba las kyi mna' chu 'thung: dam tshig sgog gi gta' ru zungs: bstan 'gro sman phyir 'jam dpal ni: nā ga rakka khyod kyis zungs: sa ma ya na ra gan: slob ma lha gsal ye shes dbab de nyad brtan par bzhugs gsol gdab bum dbang ni hūṃ hrīḥ dri med 'od gsal bum pa dzas mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma 'jam dpal bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid sgrib dag pa dang : na ga rakka'i skya 'grub 31ga rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: nā ga rasgo'i sku gtad laḥ hā tree skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: na ga ragyu'i

badzra dbang mchog bskur steng 'og bar gyi gdon las rgyal: mi 'jigs dpa' ba'i sku thob shog rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maḥ 'o skal ldan rigs kyibu rnams la bum pa lha yis dbang bskur thobs pa yin pas: lus lha ru shes: ngag sngags su khyer: yid ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar gyis dang gdon gsum gyi g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro: gsang dbang ni hūṃ trīḥ 'jigs med snyib po'i gsang ba sngags : rdo rje pha lam lta bu yis skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas rtsa dang rlung khams smin grol nas bde ba mchog gsang ldan thob regag rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ṣiñtsa ā: 'oḥ skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la gsung gsang ba mchog gi dbang bskul thob pa yin pas: rlung rang babs su gnas 'du ba'i nad rkyen byang : sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag: dpal ldan he ru ga'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par 'gyur ro: sher dbang ni hūṃ hriḥ sa 'og gdon rnams 'dal ba dang : 'chi bdag 'jig pa stobs pa'i phyir: gri gag 'bar bas dbang basmar ro: bde stong rdogs pa 'bar ba dang : dga' bzhi'i 'od

gsal mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhi nyiñtsa hūṃ 'oḥ skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la: thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur thob pa yin pas: bde ba mchog tu 'bar stong pa'i 'od gsal mthong zung 'jug mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i thig le 'od gsal gyi sku thob par 'gyur ro tshig dbang ni hū hrī dri med 'od gsal gong bu yis: rlung sems yid kyi dri ma dag rnam par mi rtog chos sku mjal bya rtsol blo 'das don rtogs nas: srid dang zhi las rnam grol shog: rtsa sngagasamathar gu ṇa a bhi khiñtsa tre: 'o skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la: tshig dbang rin po che thob pa yin pas sems 'od gsal du smin: dug gsum gyi nad gdon zhi: phyag rgya chen po'i sa la sbyor skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro gtor dbang ni hū hrīḥ dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag khar: 'jigs byed nā ga rakra dang gnyis med dpal gyi gtor chen 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: kun btags gzhan dbang yongs tshob nas: rnam bzhi bcos dgos brgya rtsa'i nad ma

badzra lus zhi zhing gzhom pa dang : lus ngag yid gsum bde dang ldan: lha dang skal ba mnyam gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar bā lirnya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā:/ trī de ltar dbang thob byin rlabs 'jug bskyed rdzogs sgom bzlas byed la dbang tshe bsod nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas shing don gnyis lhun 'grub gdon mi za sam mā therang 'byung po bkar 'dod nas sa steng re mig bkod pa'i khar gnam ze'u 'byug mgo glog la zhon bar the'u bya mgo sprin la zhon sa the'u sprul mgo mtsho la brten rang 'dra bdun re cha mangs dang bshos bu gtor chung khrag skong da lan chags 'theb skru pho mo'i glud nam mkha' mda' 'phang bal rgyang bkod gzugs 'gros sna tshogs bskor bar bya yas stag cha ma cho dgu bkrams dar ras gzigs ras stag ras dang dung tshe dung 'phreng 'ja' yis spud zas sna yo byad sna tshogs bkrams sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs bden pa'i smrang gis bkrol ba niḥ kye: mtho ba nam mkha'i klong na gnas: legs nyes srid pa'i rkos mkhan po: gnam the'u dkar po bya ba ni: 'brug gi mgo la glog gi lus: thog dang ser ba'i sna 'dren byed skar mda' bu yug ltar du gtong: yangs pa'i khams la dbang za ba'i bar the'u khra bo bya ba ni: gnyan dang rims yam mdze

drag slong bya yi mgo la sprin gyi lus: khrag tshos nad rlang dug rlang g.yo: sa the'u nag po bya ba ni sbrul gyi mgo la sbu ba'i lus: grangs ba chu ser nad kyi gzhi: mdze skya rlung gi'akhor lo dang : mdze dmar me yi 'khor lo dang : mdze nag dug gi 'khor lo bskor: 'brum bu dkar nag dmar gsum dang : be ge skya smug ser gsum slong: klu gnyan gtod dang bsdungs nas su: de yi nad sna gdon sgo 'bebs: rang rang rigs gtogs 'khor tshogs ni: dkar nag khra bo 'bum gyi sde: bya nag stong khyu 'tshogs 'tshogs 'dzabs: sngags pa'i 'bod do da tshur 'dus: gtum mo rlung gi rnal 'byor ba: khro thung rgyal pos bka' nan bzhin: dam tshig dran bzhin gnas mdzod cig: bden brjod ni na mo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum: nā ga rakru'i bden stobs kyis: ngan gtong steng 'og bar gyi gdon: the'u rang tshogs rnams 'dir khug cig: tri a gar sha ya dza:dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: 'dod rdzas spel ba ni kye stong pa'i dbyings ni khyon re che: ting 'dzin dkor nor lhun re 'thug: 'dod lnga'i dga' ston yid re 'phrog: dri za'i bu mo mdangs re

badzra gsal mi'am ci'i bu blta na sdug: thabs kyi snyugs mda' sha ra ra: shes rab 'ja' 'phang bkra la la: pho gdongs stag chas wa la la: mo gdongs mo chas si li liḥ bal brgyang 'od 'bar lhubs se lhub: rgyang bu bkrag gsal 'od de 'od: dkor nor mang po me re re: phyugs rnams mtsher ngur 'u ru dza g.yang mos 'ba' sgra ti ri ri: dar zab mang po ta la la : lha 'dre'i yid 'phrog dga' ston gyur: zad med nam mkha' mdzod du spel: sngags dang phyag rgya drug gis spel: lha 'dre' yid spyod skong ba ni kyi: dgongs la skar chogs bkra ba bzhin: gnam the'u dkar po gnas 'dir byon: lha 'dre'iyid spyod skong ba'i rdzas: yas stag cha ma cho dgu 'bul: gnam lha dkar po ma 'khrugs par 'byung pobaden pa'i tshig la nyon: zhi zhing byam pa'i ngang gnas bzhin: 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel du gsol kyi: bar snang lho sprin 'tshubs pa bzhin: bar the'u khra bo gnas 'dir byon: lha 'dre'i yid spyod skong ba'i rdzas: yas stag cha ma cho dgu 'bul: lha mgon khra bo ma 'khrugs par: 'byung po bden pa'i tshig la nyon: zhi zhing byam pa'i

ngang gnas bzhinaḥ 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel du gsol kye sa gzhi rgya mtsho mer ba bzhin 'og the'u nag po gnas 'dir byon: lha 'dre'i yid spyod skong ba'i rdzas yas stag cha ma cho dgu 'bul: sa yi rten phur ma 'khrugs par 'byung po bden pa'i tshig la nyon zhi zhing byam pa'i ngang gnas bzhin 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel du gsol kye: 'byung ba bzhi la brten bcas pas: sa ze brag the shing the dang chu the me the rlung the rnams sgyu ma'i dga' ston spel la 'dus lha 'dre'i yid spyod skong ba'i rdzas yas stag cha ma cho dgu 'bul 'byung bzhi dgra gshed ma 'thab par 'byung po bden pa'i tshig la nyon: zhi zhing byam pa'i dang gnas bzhin 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel du gsol nā ga rakka'i bka' bzhin du:'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis lug mgo dang dar marna sna lnga phul la kye: stong pa nyid las rten 'byung ba: g.yang dkar mgo bo dar sna'i 'phan: ngang ba pho rog shug rting dkar gnam lha the rang dkar por 'bul 'khu ldog gdug rtsub mi ston par bde ba mchog sbyin dam mnos shig: bha ra'i sngags dang de bzhi gshegasapa bzhi'i marga brjod la bsngo 'o rta mgo

badzra dang shing rtsa sna tshogs phul la kyi: stong pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrul: cang shes mgo bo shing rtsi dang : bal brgyang lcags ri pho mo'i glud: bar lha khra bo khyod la 'bul: gdug rtsub cho 'phrul mi ston par: tshe ring nad med bde ba stsol: saṃ bha ra dang de bzhan gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod ra mgo dang the tshe tho rkam rnams phul la kye 〈snang pa nyid las gzugs snang ba: tsa ra'i mgo dang the tshe dang : tho ba rkam pa 'bur mo rnams: 'og lha nag po khyod la 'bul: nad rims gnyan lhog mi ston par: bde skyid dpal 'bar snang ba stsol: saṃ bha ra dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod 'byu bzhi' the'u rang brngan pa ni kye: sa la gnas pa'i the'u rang la: rin chen lcags kyi 'jor 'di 'bul: ltog pa spun dgu mi gtong zhing : sde brgyad nang 'khrugs ma ston cig: saṃ bha ras bsngo kyi chu la gnas pa'i spyad cha zor ba 'di 'bul lo: chu ser nad rnams mi gtong zhing : phu nu rus 'thab ma ston cig: saṃ bha ras bsngo kyi: brag la gnas lcags kyi sta re ngar ma 'bul: gnyan nad sum sbrel mi gtong zhing : nye ba nang 'thab ma slong shig: sa bha ras bsngo kyi: shing la

gnas lcags kyi sta mo leb chen 'bul: sgrang 'bur lba ba mi 'dobs shing rgyal pos bka' chad ma 'bebs shig: saṃ bha ras bsngo kyi: 'phrang lam bdag bzung the'u rang la:gnya' shing thong so gshol mda' 'bul: gag pa sgran 'bras mi 'debs shing : mi kha bra mchu ma ston zhig: saṃ bha ras bsngo rkye bdag med bdag tu bzung ba'i 'dre: pho mo ma ning rigs gtong kun: 'byung ba'i glud chen 'di khyer la: so sor rang rang gnas su songs: chang glud saṃ bha ras bsngo rdzo 'debs byas la kye gnam sa bar gyi the'u rang la : yas rtags sna tshogs rdzongs su 'debs: gnam gyi dal kha ma 'debs zhig: sa yi dug mda' ma g.yo zhigaX 'byung ba'i dgra gshed ma 'thab cig: dus bzhi'i gshed bzhi ma ldang shig: mi la na tsha ma gtong zhig: phyugs la god kha ma ston zhig zhing la btsa' sad ma 'debs shig phu nu nang 'khrugs ma slong cig: dme gri mkhon 'dzing ma ston par:byer shig dengs shig gzhan du song lam bstan ni kye: stong pa nam mkha'i yas lam la: gnam the gtso 'khor rlung gis gshegs: bar snang yangs pa'i yas lam la: bar

badzra ther 'bangs 'khor 'phur te gshegs: rgya mtshor mer ba'i pha mtha' rtsa 'og the'u nag po bran dang bcas: stobs dang gar gyi 'gros bcas gshegs phyi mig zhen chags med pa dang : phung khrol rgyab ngan mi 'jog par rang rang gnas su da gshegs shig: sarba bisne gastso bka' bsgo mtshams gcod srung 'khor sgom shis pa brjod pas ze'u 'dre bkar bsam pa 'i don la bar chad med tshe rang nad med bde dang ldan don gnyas lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yu gsum pa rjes rims tshogs mchod la bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams bsags sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru shes mtshan ma' rtog pa thad gar gzhoms sa ma yā byin rlabs ni ho: bde ba'i snod mtshog ka pā lar: sha lnga bdud rtsi 'dod yon tshogs: mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med bcas:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes bskyed gyur: ma badzra spa ra ṇa kho: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni hūṃ trīḥ 'og min dag pa'i zhing mchog nas: 'jam dpal zhi drag sras 'khor bcas: 'du ba tshogs la spran 'dren gshegs: chags bral pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: sa ma yu i hya hi dzaXhūṃ baṃ ho: tshogs phud ni hoḥ bde ba'i sgod du 'bar ba'i rdzas: sha lnga bdud

rtsi'i tshogs ston bkod dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: a la la ho bde bar rol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza ho: bskang ba ni hū hrīḥ gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa can:'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thug dam bskangs: a la ha la'i gad rgyang can: gshin rje gshed po'i thug dam bskangs ro lang sha za 'byung po'i bdud gshin rje gshed dmar thug dam bskangs: dgra bgegs dus mtha' stong mdzad pa'i tshe bdag 'bar ba'i thug dam bskangs: khur thum rlung ltar srog la 'dzug: ging ging dmar nag thug dam bskangs: sgog gcod shan pa dmar las mkhan: las gshin 'char ga'i thug dam bskangs: sa 'og gdon gyi sma phab pas: nā ga rakru'i thug dam bskangs 'byung ba khod snyoms bde ba'i dpal: gshin mo rnams kyi thug dam bskangs: ging rus mche gtsig srog dbug len pho nya rnams kyi thug dam bskangs: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga:sman gtor raktas thug dam bskangs rdo rje'i rigs ma bcu drug dang : byang sems dkar dmar thugs dam bskangs: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra dang : sha khrag rus pas thug dam

badzra bskangs: ma dwa na dang snang ba'i 'od: zla rgyas zla phrum thug dam bskangs lta ba mkhar ltar dag pa dang : spyod pa zhib mo'i thug dam bskangs: rnal 'byor nyam bskang rtog sgrib byang : las nyon sgrib dag 'khor ba stong : 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur shog bar gags ni nya blo chung rtog pa rmongs dbang gis: nyan thos bcas khrims sor byang sdom gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig las: 'gal zhing nyams chags tshogs kyis bshags: sa ma yā ā: bsgral ba ni hūṃ shā: thugs ni'ajam dpal zhi ba nyid:log rtog 'dul mdzad khros pa'i rgyal: nā ga raka las la bzhengs: dgra bgegs bsgral zhing 'dren par mdzod: sarbadutra mā ra ya a phaṭa: bstab pa ni hūṃ trī ༷ chos nyid mnyam pachen po'i ltor log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabs: rngams pa'i rkan sgra bcas te rol: 'khrul ba ka nas dag mdzod cig: mo sa rakta rtsatta la khā hi:tshogs la rol ba ni nyoḥ bdi bar gshegs pa'i bzhes lngag 'di: tshol 'bror smal lngan dpal du shar: a la la ho bde bar rol: myong tshad tshom grol sa thob shog: siji pha la hri lhag ma ni dzaḥ

stong pa'i mkha' la gnas bcas shing : rdo rje'i srog ldan ma sring ging : 'bar ma dbang phyug lhag sdud rnams: dam bsgrags 'bod do da tshur byon: pham phab bka' yi lhagagator bzhes: rnam mang 'phrin las gang bcol don: thogs med yid bzhin grub mdzod cig ma ma hrīng ba lirnyikha hi: bzod gsol ni nyo mkhyen dang brtse bani nyi ma can 'jam dpal gzhon nu bdag la dgongs bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin ma gsal nongs: cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul bshags sa ma ya ā: bsngo smon ni nyo dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun: 'khor gsum dmigs med chen por bsngo: 'khrul snang 'khor ba ka dag te 'jam dpal gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: lan gsum bsdu ldang na āḥ lha tshogs spro bsdu mang po yang sems kyi de nyid gnyug mar bsdu: slar yang rten 'byung snang cha yang: stong gzugs rgyu ma lta bur spyod: a phaṭa: shis brjod ni na 31 mkhyen brtse yi shes nyi ma can: 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i bkra shis shog: khams gsum snang ba dbyings sbyor ba'i: gshin rje gshed po'i bkra shis shog: sa gsum gdon 'dul che

pa(: ba'i sku: nā ga rakka'i bkra shis shog thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba: rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: 'brel tshad rnga yab dpal rir 'god bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis 31ga: chos sku dri bral rang zhal 'jal: lta bsgom spyod pa'i bkra shis 31ga de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshangs ba'i sgrub pa mchog la brtson pa'i mi tshe rang nad med ci bsam 'grub mthu stob drag sngagasayon tan 'byor sa ma yu skem rgyal ba'i dbang bopadma saṃ bha wa'i thugs bcud yang zab rdo rje snying po'i skor rin chen brda' bsnyims mdo khams tsā rir sbas gter bdag bzang phyir klu bdud btsan la gnyer da dung ma spel snyigs ma lnga yi dus o rgyan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal nā ga raga'i rgyun khyer shin tu bsdus pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim lhaḥ zhes pa'ang grogs rasno sa ras bskul ba dang slob bu dhe wa 'gyur rdor gnyisanas kyang nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bonu ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba ma le

badzra lha bskyed 'dra man āḥ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i mdangs: rig pa'i 'od zer stong khams lam me ba: khu rdul rlung sems mngon byang lngas sbyangs te: bskyed gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i rang mdangs su: dag pa'i zhing bkod brda' rtags rdzogs pa'i dal: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus: pad zla nyi ma thugs srog 'od gong bu: phyag mtshan yongs gyur gsang bdag 'byung 'dul ni: mthing nag dbu 'bum spyan mig glog ltar 'khyugs: rtsa phyag khri bzhi'i hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya yis: gnyis snang bdud dang dam sri ar la gtad: g.yas phyag khri brgyad phyag mtshan rnam pa bzhi: me rlung mtshon 'khor spu gri rnon po yis: byad ma log 'dren 'byung po bsregs gtub brlag: g.yon phyag khri brgyad lcags zhags sgrog dril dang : tho ba bhan khrag dug zor lcags sdig gis gdon bgegs 'bogs brgyal 'khrul snang dbu mar bshig: zhabs bsgrad 'byung po bdud bzhi gzir zhing gnon: khro chas rabs rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'byud: la la dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams bro la gnas: na dwa dpa'

rmo rnams kyis glu dbyangs len: dhu tir sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dga' bzhis bstod yar rtse rta mgrin gsang bdag 'jam dpal nag: khams gsum dbyings sbyor rtsa rlung gnas srungs: mar rtse phag khyung sdig gis 'du 'phro yis: gshing lci khu ba ye shes bcud du smin: dug gsum gnas sbyangs bde gsal mi rtog bskyed: sgra gcan nyi zla rnam par dag pa las srid dang zhi sel lam gsum gsang gsum sbyor: 'byung ba chu me rlung mkha' nang dbang bsgyur: rtsa lnga yan lag bcu bcu yal ga brgya mdor na brgyad khri bzhi stong smin pa las: byang chub yan lag phyogs chos brgyad khrir sad: 'bras bus rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor 'das dpal: ma brtsal rdzogs ldan skad cig dran rdzogs shar: sgog gis bskul te 'og min gnas mchog nas: zhi ba khro bo zhi ma khro la sogs: 'phags pa gos sngon rnam par spyan drangs bstims: sa ma ya mtshul la gu rgya rgya rgya gter ston ra gi mnyam gzhag gi sgom rgya las bkrol ba'o sarba maṅga le

pa(: brgyud 'debs ni ston pa kun bzang rgyal tshab rigs lnga dang : rig gsum grwa ma lnga dang rgyal po dza: ku ku ra dza ind+ra bhu ti la: gsol ba 'debs so das mnyam mngon gyur shog: seng ha rā dza u pa rā dza dang : sgeg rdor sangs rgyas gsang ba bī ma la: rma ban rin mchog gtsug gyer rnam gnyis la: gsol ba 'debs so dag mnyam mngon gyur shog: zhing ston rgyal yon gling rje ras pa dang : chos rgyal 'phags dang grum gyi mkhar nag pa: he pa chos 'byung rtsa rgyud bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so dag mnyam mngon gyur shog he ru ka dpal lag na rdo rje dang : sgyu 'phrul zhi ba khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha: dag mnyam bde chen dbyer med dkyil 'khor la: gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob: sbas don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mngon du gyur: lha rtog sgyu 'phrul drwa ba lam rtsal rdzogs sku gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mngon gyur nas: khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs dpal thob regag: de ltar gsol btab byan rlabs 'jug nyams rtog yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyas dbyangs snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba'o

// / le spro na bka' bsgo ni hū hrīḥ gnyis med gnyis su bzungs ba'i ma rig pa: log rtog bdud kyi dpung tshogs mgu bya'i phyir: 'dod lnga rang grol glud gtor 'bul gyis bzhes rgyu 'bras chos nyon don dam mtshams srungs shig: hū hū snyisno ta krid ta phaṭa: srung labar ni hūṃ hrīḥ stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i ra gur la log rtog 'byung po'i tshogs rnams nye mi nus mi shig 'gyur med khro bo khro mos gtams: kun bzang 'od kyi zhing bkod ngo mtshar gnas :badzra rakta rakta: byin 'bebs ni hū hrīḥ chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba 'og min gnas: brda' rtags bkod pa phun tshogs gzhal med dbus: gtso brgyad rin chen padma nyi zla'i nas: gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje gos sngon can: sa gsum gdug pa 'dul ba'i gar ngoms bzhin gnas 'dir byin phob byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: e hya nyi sa ma ya dza ཿhūṃ baṃ hoX a be sha ya a ā mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni

badzra hūṃ trī nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten kun phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na0 rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed: a sabo ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga na badzra byu dza spra ra ṇa dzaḥ la bskyed gzhung ltar btang la spro na spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ dzaḥ shā gnas 〉nadamigs chos kyis dbyings nyid las: thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po'i sku: khyung gi spro bsdu yan lag sbrul rgyan bcas sgrub pa mchog gi mos ngor gshegs su gsol: sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol dang : nad mug 'khrugs rtsod rgud pa sna mang po'i: 'jigs pa kun gyi phyogs las dbugs dbyung nas: bde mchog rdo rje'i sku ru mnga' gsol cig: sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ trīX sa bdag klu gnyan gdug pa bsnol ba'i khar: che ba'i sku mchog 'phags pa gos sngon can sprul ba rnam mang 'du 'phro 'gyed bzhin du:dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: phyag 'tshal ni hūṃ trīḥ sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rdo rje srin po'i sku: dgod gshe drag shul ldan pa dpa'

bo'i gsung : snying rje rngams zhi ye shes thugs gyi gar mi sdug rdo rje srin po khyod phyag 'tshal: sa ma ya na mo: mchod pa na hūṃ hrīX 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dgyes bskyed phyir: rnam lnga sman gtor rakta byang chub sems: sbyor sgrol rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug sogs: nam mkha' rab 'byams gang ba'i dga' ston tshogs: gnyis med mnyam pa chen por 'bul gyis bzhes: don dam mi 'gyur rtogs pa'i dbang bskur stsol: ma ma hā badzra phyu dza sa ma ya ho: bstod pa ni hū trīḥbeḍūl gos can gzugs thung gzi brjed 'bar: gnam lcags ral pa rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan thod rgyan sbrul chun dar byi cod paṇa 'phur spyan bsgrad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar la bstod: khro gcar chu yi rlabs bzhin rnam par zhakhrugs shings nas hūṃ glu mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs 'bum phrag dbu phyag gdul dka' 'dul ba'i gnyen: khro rgyal 'byung po 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod: dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su klubs: rdo rje'i mtshon cha byad ma rdul brlag spro gar gyis nyams dgu rdzogs pa'i skur ston

badzra pa: gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod: yan lags thams cad sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan rigs lnga'i klu yi gsang sgog phyag rgya gnas: spro bsdu khyung gi tshogs ni glogs ltar 'khyugs: 'phags pa gos sngon khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: gza' brgyad lha brgyad klu brgyad 'dar zhing dngangs: phra men rigs sngags byad ma rbod gtong 'dul: chos dang chos min lha sgo'i rgol ba 'joms: mthu stobs rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod: gang zhig sgog gigo tur 'bral med bsnyen: la la nā da dhu ṭwāṃ /sdu/ sdi tt+waṃn khams lnga 'dus pa he ru ka sad de: bde mchog bde ba'i rdo rje'i skur 'grub shog: zhes pa'i kha skong 'di gter ston rang gi dgo sa pa 'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra

badzra brgyud 'debs ni ston pa kun bzang mi g.yo mgon po dang : rgyal tshab rigs lnga rigasagasum grwa ma lnga: rgyal po dza dang int+ra bhu ti la: gsol ba 'debs sortogs pa mngon gyur shog: seng ha rā dza u pa rā dza dang : sgeg rdor sangs rgyas gsang ba bi ma la: rma ban rin mchog lang 'gro khye'u chung bar: gsol ba 'debs so rtogs pamangon gyur shog: gling zuras pa 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags grum gyi mkhar nag he pa chos 'byung gnas: bdud 'dul rdo rje dpa' bo rol rtsal la: gsol ba 'debs sortogs pa mngon gyur shog khrag 'thu dpa 'a bo rdo rje khro lod rtsal: nus ldan 'jigs med gtum drag gling pa nas sgyu 'phrul brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la: gsol ba'adebs so rtogs pa mngon gyur shog: teru ka dpal lag na rdo rje dang : ye nas gnyis med rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: bka' nyan pho nya dam can rgya mtsho la: gsol ba'adebs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol: diltar lhag pa'ilha dang gu ru rjer: mos pas gsol btab don gnyis lhun grub nas: phyi nang gnyis med dag rdzogs smin pa dang

las kyi dpal chen go 'phang mchog thob shog: de ltar gsol bawa byin rlabs 'jug don gnyisagegasamed yid bzhin 'grub ma ku rgya rgya rgya chos bdag nam mkha'i rnal 'byor kun bzang ngor kho bonusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis spel sarba ma lam̐

76 zab gsang rdo dzeesnying po las:dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed kyi:phyag rgya gud du sbas pasrung ba'irwa gur zab mo bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: 111514 ma 'ongs slos ma lnga yi dus bar go bdud kyi rgol ba 'chas chos byed yongs la skabs glags tshol mi 'dod phabs ma sna dgu slong nad mug mtshon mas gzeng pa lang btsa' sad ser ba 'bu srin dar dgra bdud bgegs kyi yo lang g.yo rwa dza bse mos rtag tu 'tshe de tshe lha gzhan gyis 'dul dka' sbas thabs 'di nyid brten pa'i mi du min 'chi bzlogarkyen las grol tshe bsrings dpalabaskyed lang tsho dar don rnams gegasamed yid bzhi 'grub the med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu nayang spyor dngo rjes dang gsum dang po sakyi sbyor ba ni gla nag rtsidang spang spos dang 'dre 'jigs pa dang yungs dkar dang mu zi nag po spru nag pa rgya snag ming can nag po dang bong nga nag po dgu sbyar nas ril bu sran ma'i tshad du bya glang dmar 'byu ldan rwa nang bzhugs da la'i dbus bkod nyer sprod bkrams lha yi gsang ba gsum shesabya sam mā gnyisapa gsar lo spyor ba ni mthing shog bzang drug sbyar ba'i ngor rin go gser gyi 'di ltar bri shu pazab methazatha rnathag7)murgan

rtabyu16sorga / gagargami zeyanasga2mi2rnya/lo tha namithamu dbu can tshag med legs par bya mu lud phyogs bzhar rdor phyed re nges la chos sman mtha' gsar rnams dgusbyor byugs pa na bza' mthing mig ni mchong gis byas nas su dal dbusal bkod bskyed bzlas sgrub sa ma yu gsum pa sngagasakyi sbyor ba ni he ra he ra bhi ra bhi ra hab sha ro ga sarba zhi zhi duṣṭan phaṭa:nadabargya 'joms pa'i sngags rgod 'di 'bum phrag bzhi bgrangs nus mthu thob gang la btab kyang thog las myur tsha bar rlan sbyar grangs bar skem 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab a tsa ra yi sngags rgod ste nyams pa can la mashor cig dam tshig can gyi dpal du shog sa ma yu gnyas pa dngos gzhi sgom pa la las rim gsum rkyas legs par bstan dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na 33bde btagags kun 'dus rtsa ba'i dkyila'akhor la byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi:'khrul 'khor snang ba chos skur dag mnyam phyir:rig pa 'od gsal byang chub sems bskyed do:lan gsum gnyisapa lha bskyedabya ba ni āḥchos dbyings mkha' ltar dag pa'i dkyil 'khor klong:rang gsal 'dzin bral ye shes snying rje'i mdangs kun 'byung rig pa rgyu yi sa bon las:sgod bcud dag

badzra chen yum lnga'i mkha' nyid la: gdos bral ye shes sgyu 'phrul zhing dbus su lhun grub bkod mdzes 'od kyi gzhal med khang brda don rtags rdzogs mnyam pa chen po'i nang: chags bral ge sar thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: ma rig bdud tshogs dregs pa bsgol ba'i khar: bdagasnang dpal tshen 'byung po 'dul mdzad sku:mthing nag chen po rngams brjid 'jigs rung ba: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni: 'bum phrag khro gtum mche gtsigs ljags 'dril ba: spyan zlum gsum gsum glog dmar bzhin du 'byugs: g.yas phyag 'bum gyis me rlung mtshon 'khor gdengs dus mtha'i nad gdon byad phur rbod gtong kun bya sgro me dang 'phrad bzhin ming med brlag: g.yon 'bum tho ba gri gug hūṃ mdzad rgyas: 'khrul ba drung 'byin 'byung po rdul ltar 'thags skulasamirlung khyung sdig phag khro spros gnyis snang dri ma mtshan 'dzin rū tra dang : dam chos bsgrub pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba kun: bsad gtub hab rol chos nyid chen por zhi: rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las ma lus pa thogs pa med par yid

bzhin stsol bar byed zhabs rnams bsgrad pas 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dur khrod dpa' chas brgyan: 'jigs rngams bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can: khro bo khams gsum rol ba'i sku dkyil la bdun brgya nyer lnga bde gshegs dkyil 'khor kun: ma lus ro mnyam snang stong 'ub chub bsgom: rtsa rnams re yig g.yo ba haṃ gis drangs thig le st+waṃ gyi brda thabs mthus bskul nas: bde stong kun gyi gsang ba mchog thob dmigs: gnas gsum bee ge thugs srog sa bon las: 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa 'dzin rtsa ba gsum dang dam can nor lha'i tshogs: ma lus kha ba bu yug 'tshubs ci bzhin : phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa ru spyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig bde bar bsre kun khyab rang ngo rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: gzung 'dzin mtshan bsgral srid pa ro mnyam bzhes gnyis med sems kyi dri ma dbu mar bshags gang shar rang grol dgongs pa'i klong la bstod: srid pa gzhir bshags chos nyid 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs: ma rig 'brul ba'i 'khor lo rdul brlag nas

badzra dur khrod me ri 'bar bar dag smin rdzogs thams cad ma brtsal bdud dpung zil gnon ngang : / badzra phaṭa smra bcad ting 'dzin brtan po yis 'bum phrag ༅ gnyis grub pa'i mi 'phral snang bdud kyis g.yul lasargyal gzhan snang 'byung po zil gyisaganon byin rlabs nus stobs thogs las myur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma mā hūṃ badzra rakta phaṭa: sgrub bsnyen 'bum phrag drug bzlas na bar chad rkyen sel srung ba'i mchog tshe dpal bsod nams klung rta 'phel don kun 'grub po rdo rje'i bka' sa ma pā snyen hūṃ badzra du na tsakra hrīḥhūṃ: las sngags 'bum phrag gsum bgrang na 'gal rkyen gang gis kyang mi tshug 'phral snang g.yul ngo kun las rgyal lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal sa ma shā gsum pa mtshad cing bstod pa ni hūṃ trīḥ kun khyab dzadas skuthagarang mdangs las: shar ba'i phyi nang gsang mchod sprin dngos mtshan dri ma rnam dag pas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa bskangs ka ma hā pañtsa byu dza ho: nyu trīḥ nga bdag mtshan ma'i gdon 'dul zhing rngo rje yangs pa'i 'phrin las kyis khams gsum srid pa gzhi ru rol: 'ub chub bde chen kong la bstod dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor sam yu gsum pa

rjes kyi las la gsum dang po dmigs pas bsrung ba ni rang lus bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro dbyer med pa'i thugs ye shes chen po'i ngo bo gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa me rab tu'abar ba'i lte bar: rig pa'i ngo bo /༷ yig dmar nag gi mtshan par gyur de las me dang rlung gi 'du 'phro mtshon cha sna tshogs khro bo dang khro mo: lcags sdig dang dur phag me khyung dang za byed kyi stag mo mgo dgu pa sogs dpag tu med pa steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pas: gnod byed 'byung po thams cad nye mi nus pas rang bzhin can du gyurabar dmigs la: ngag nas hū rākhagagrangathanaldan brjod: slar yang hū badzra rakta brgya rtsa la sogs brjod gyur na rang lusardo rjer mthong grub 'gyur sa ma mā gnyis pa gnod byed brlags pa'i sngags yid treg shag hū phaṭa tsitta rakta: brgya stong la sogs brjod gyur na log 'dren 'byung po thams cad kun bye ma dum bur 'gyur ba ni gsang ba sngags kyi khyad chos so sa ma yā gsum pa byad bzlog srung 'khor ni yin pra dun badzra tsitta shag shag thum ril bye : smra bcad 'bum bablos rgyun khyer du brgya rtsa bar ma chad pa na ban bon phur thogs stong sogs kyis tshug mi 'gyur ro gtan tshag yin sa ma wā ril bu la dmigasasngags

ba tshu 'dis brlabs snyen ma ma tsitta hūṃ hūṃ grub pa'i sngagasani rtag thon bskyar de nasanyin bzhin brgya rtsa bzla phan yon yid mi gas pa dang nad gdon rkyen dang bar chad sogs nyer len gapa thams cad zhi byin rlabs rno nus bsam mi khyab sa ma mā bsrung ba'itsakra la dmigs nas lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa yis tshog tra tra shag:'bum phrag bgrang la me tog dor tsakra nyid dang dbyer med bsre de nas mguladu 'chang ba'i mi stong phrag brgyad cu'i gegs las rgyal nad yam rims kyis mi tshugs so nus mthu phan yon bsam mi khyab sa ma mā brda yisrung ba 'di lta ste khyim bya'i snying gi shun pa la khyung khra'i khrag byug de yi ngor mthing dang rdzas dgu sbyar ba yis ba 44 14shā ཿ gnyen po 'byu bcu 'di nyid kyang zangs kyi sgrom gzhugs rab tu gnas ma ma ram̐ re ye ye le le e e dzi 'u kud keg shangasaswā hā:'dinyid khre bgrang byin gyis rlobs cig dang 'byung lnga'i mi tshugs shing tshe 'phel bar ra zhes gsung ngo mchan mi 'bral drod la brten pa'i mi steng 'og bar gdon gegs las rgyal tshe bsrings dpala'aphel yon tan rgyas nus stobs bsam gyis mi khyab so sa ma shā oṃmaḥrgyal ba'i dbang la ga 'thung nag po ngas yang snying bla med gces pa'i srog lta bu grub dbang 'gog mikhyod la gces nor yin gzhan la ma shor

rin chen gter rgya thob ma 'ong snyigasam sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyod nyid nus ldan rdo rjer 'gyur pha nor 'di rted gdul byar phan bde spel mi 'dod gso dka'i nad rnamasakun laphan yon tan bsam masadam tshigaldan la spel bka' log dred po log lta can la rgya rang 'dod phug bcug gla rngan za la rgya kha 'jam khung rub nag po rnams la rgya dred phyugasahab thob ngomasapa snga la rgya bka' gsang srog labastimasashig thugasakyi sras stodaman gnasasu ma zag a tham rgya sam shā rgya rgya rgya 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyag rgya gud du sbas pa zung ba'i rwa gur rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya mo rgyan 3 sgob dpon padma saṃ bha pa'i bga' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o bdo thim lhaḥ ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po kun bzang bstan 'jin dar rgyasazhes snying nor dam pa de yi bskul ngor bdag 'dra nusaldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legasa'aphel sarbamasgo le

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dpal chen 'byung po 'dul mdzad kyi dgyes bskang shin tu bsdus pa bsod nams mtha' yas bzhugs so:ba rte na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye 11 sa rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las sku padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal skal bzang las ldan pho mo yis bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i phyir ga ṇa tsakra'i thabs la brtson sa ma yu 'dod yon bza' bca' gas ba'i rigs ci 'byor bsags la byin mas na trīḥ snang srid 'dod yon bkod pa rnams: rang byung ye shes rgyan du che gang shar rang grol ting 'dzin gyis: thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo spel: slo aḥ( lan gsum rgas zhing spyan 'dren pa ni trīḥ 'di na don gyi tshogs ston spro rig stong rjen grol 'dod yon lnga rkyen snang cer grol phyag rgya gar: mnyam pa nyid du rol ba'i phyir: rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dpal: gtso dang 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs: yo badzra sa ma ya dza dza: phud khrul ni hūṃ hriḥ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sna 'dod yon tshogs la dgyes par rol: bde chen ye shes dngos tshob stsol oṃ dzā na

sarba tsakra pū dza ho: bar ༅gas ni ho mtshan bcas gnyis snang sems kyis nongs: bag chags drwa ba gzung dang 'dzin: thams cad mi gnas chos kyi skur: tshogs kyi 'khoralos bskangs zhing bshags: sa ma ya shukhye ā: tha ma bsgral bstab ni hū nyi thogs mar bdag nyid rtog pa bsgral: de nas snying rjes 'khrul rgyun gtor thabs chen dpa' bosadam dgra gsod: dbang phyug dkyil 'khor mnyes phyir bstabs rū tra pra she sha ya phaṭa: sarba khā hi ho: lhag mas pho nya brngan pa ni bye rdo rje rgyal po rigs lnga la: phyi nang gnyisamed padmo yis: bde ba mngon gyur pho nya'i gtso: mkha' la gnas shing phyogs bcur rgyu: gos rlon khrag skyog sha chen spyod: dbang mo nyer brgyad ma sring ging : pham 'bab 'dibazhes tha tshig bzhin: rnal 'byor 'phrin las gang bcol sgrubs ma ma hrīng u ci ṭa ba lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi chad tho ni hū bye dpal chen lag na rdo rje yi: bka' nyan pho nya dam tshig can: laṅka'i bdag po yab yum dang : sgrug nag khros ma ral gcig yum: drang sgong lto zhal srid gsum hā: skyes bu gnam sa byed kyi bdag: dregs pa'i gtso bo

badzra: sum bcu dang pho nya g.yog dang 'khor bcas rnams sngon gyis tha tshog gnyer blang bzhin chad gnyer gtor ma 'di bzhes la:gsang sngags bstan pa rin po che:'dzin spel rig 'dzin sbyin bdag bcas srung skyobs dar zhing rgyas par mdzod nag phyogs sma phob bstan bdud thul:bskal ba rdzogs ldan snang ba yis:skye dgu bde spyod phrin las sgrubs dam tshig ma g.yel sa ma yā:bstan gtor ni bye chogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid:khrag 'thung bka' bzhin nam mkhar rgyu:tshur gshegs ya ma skyong ma rnams:'dir byon dam skong 'phrin las sgrub:bdag nyid che sogasabadud mo bzhi:sha med gangs yumagargod sbyin mched:gong btsun la sogasasman mo rnams:bde skyongs bstan ma 'khor bcas kyis:brngan mchod gtor ma 'di longs la:a su ra nas dam blang bzhin:rgyal bstan srung ma 'dus sde skyongs:bod khams chos kyis 'tsho ba dang lta ba log rnams tshar chod cig mtha' mi dbus byung rgol ba bzlog:srid pa'i nyes sel legs yon bskyed:'phrin las sgrub shig ma yam tshogs

gnyer gyi tha tshig dran mdzod cig o ma ma ༷nga hrīng dza ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā nyi: rta bro ni hū rang bzhin mnyam nyid bde klong du: gnyis snang dam sri bdud bgegs grub ldogamed rigs lnga'i dro rgyas gdab: ye shes lnga klong byang chub shog: ma āhwa swā hā: stum bha ya nan nan bzod gsol ni nyo rang byung ye shes gdod ma nas dag mnyam chos skurabyang chub kyang: gnyis snang sems kyi dri ma kun: zang thal chos nyid chen por bshags: sa ma ya ā bsngo smon ni nyo dge tshogs zag dang zag med kun 'khor gsum yongasadag chen por bsngo khams gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo kun rnam grol sku gsum sa thob shog: bsdu ldang ni hū: snang cha thabs kyi bkod pa rnams: spros bral dbu ma chen pora.ā ho gdod nasathabasashegazug 'jug dal: ma bskyed rang byung lha ru gnas: phaṭa phaṭa: shis brjod ni hū hrīḥ dag mnyam lta ba'i bkra shis shog: zang thal sgom pa'i bkrashis thegag: rnam rgyal sprod pa'i bkra shis thegag: lhun grub 'bras bu'i bkra shis 31ga: bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab des ni tshogs chen rab rdzogs cing don gnyis lhun grub dpal la dbang the

ba rte med do sa ma mā tshem rgyal dbang padmamithugasab da skor rin chen sayi gter du sbas dusakyi rgud pa sel ba'i phyir ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i bar skabs su nga sprul bu dang 'phrad par shog sarma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyiḥces pa 'di'ang chos bdagakun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyasakyisabaskur ngor bdag 'dranusaldan rdo rjesadag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le

zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gsang bdag 'byung po 'dul byed kyi: dril sgrub shin tu bsdus pa'i bskang ba dngos grub gter mdzod bzhugs so:'a tshu na mo gu ru kro dha rā dza sh-i ye za da na khams gsum rnam dag yongs sgrol gyis mchod pa go pos bskang bar bya dngosamatha 'dzin pa rnam dag pas ye shes pho pos yongs mnyesabya sa ma shā hū (ཿhrīḥ thugs mchog 'gyur med e yi 1nga dkyil nas: gtum po chos kyi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : pho brang rab rngams thod mkhar 'bar ba nas gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes thugs: gnam lcags ma la ya yi rtse mo nas: sdud po rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs dam bskangs: dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas dpal chen 'byung po 'dul mdzad thugs dam bskangs: bde stong 1nga yangs khams gsum rgyas 'debs ma: gar dbang rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangs: gang 'dul phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i mi pham khro gnyer ro langs thugs dam bskangs tshad med las kyi gdul bya ma lus 'dul: am gtsigs 'dod 'byel rol ma'i thugs dam bskangs

rnal 'byor bde chen ting 'dzin bskyed pa mo: gnas spor dbang phyug ma tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bka' nyan dam tshig mchog la rtag gnas pa'i: pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'ithugs dam bskangs: hū hrīḥ zhe sdang rang grol sha chen ri ltar spungs 'dod chags rnam dag rakta mtsho ltar bskyil: gti mug dbyings sgrol rus pa'i gram khrod brdal 'khrulab gting 'byin tsitta rdza ltar brnyil mtshan 'dzin rang grol dbang lnga skar ltara'akhrigs: zhen med rang grol 'dod don bsam mtha' yas: thams cad ro mnyam sgyu ma'i rolartsed kyis: dngosapo chosanyid stong pa'i dbyings su bskangs snang cha ma 'gags ye shes sang sbyor bskangs: gsal mdangs shes rab ro mnyam rdo rjes bskangs: bde sdug kadag gnas lugs ngang du bskangs: kun rdzob mtshan ma don dam dbyings su bskangs: bskangs bya skong byed dngos 'dzin rnam dag pas: gtum drag 'byung po 'dul mdzad thugs dam bskangs thams cad gnyis med bde ba chen po'i klong : 'khor gsum yongs dag kun bzang dgongs par bzhag: de ltar bskangs bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag don

btsarsha gnyis lhun gyas grub ma shā yim rgyal dbang padma tshu bha was dus kyi 'byor rgud skyobs pa'i mthus las ldan gcag gis dpal du bkod 'phrin las 'gro la 'gyed nus shog sam mā rgya rgyargya bskang ba dngos grub gter mdzod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyislob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim dziḥ zhes pa 'di'angachos bdagakhun bzang bstan 'ardzan dar rgyas kyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir nusaldan rdo rjes dag pa ra phab pa sarba ma le dza yantu/ bkra shis /

༄༅/ ratna'i snying tig gong 'og gi: thugs dam nang gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:ra༅༅/ na 37 gu ru padmā ka ra ye: dum gcig bharnyalisnod nang du bza' bca' da ba'i rigs rnams dang sha khrag dmar gtor la sogs bshams bsang sbyangasabyin gyis rlabs pa ni rme ā29rang mdun rlung mithod pa'i rgyed pu'i khar: āḥlas dum gcig bhanta ka pā la: stong gsum dang mnyam phyi dkar nang dmar ba'i: dbus su bza' bca' btung ba sha khrag rigs: rigs lnga'i sa bon 'bru bcu'i byin rlabs kyis: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan rang bzhin can myong grol ye shes chen por sbyangs spel bsgyur: sa a ka ro sogasaswā hā lan bdun brjod la byin gyisarlabs de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ trīḥ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma spyan 'dren gshegs: rnam dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol dbyings rig 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nas gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol

bar chad bdud dpung 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: ging dang dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol 'phrin las gegs med 'grub pa'i pho brang nas bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol dkar phyogs dbu bstod nag phyogs pham mdzad pa'i: yul lha gter bdag tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel mdzad pa'i: nor bdag dza lha 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: dam tshig gsang ba'i rten la bzhugs su gsol: ngo mtshar dag mnyam chen pos phyag 'tshal lo ma badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzña na tiṣṭha lhan na mo na ma hoḥ lha tshogs rnams rkyi ljags 'od zer 'bar ba'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshims par bsam la: o badzra gu ru bhuddha dharma saṃ ga sabo ratna e dam bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ sa badzra bho nyi sa twa kro ta ra dza sarba sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi tshog badzra bhurnya ratna padma rkarma lo ka sarba ging ka ra dha ka dha ki dzña na ḍaski ni sarba e dam bha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi: 67 badzra dharma pā la kṣe tra pa la lo ka pā la ārla dzwa bha la sarba sa pa ri

༄༅/ wa ra ratna e dam bha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ trī skye 'gags dmigs bsam brjod pa kun bral ba'i: rgyal dgongs brda bsnyan shog ser tshig brgyud sogs: rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams kun: rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul rtogs pa spor: mtshan dpes rab 'byud rdo rje lta bu'i sku: dus gsum gshegs bzhugs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni: rdul gcig grang mnyam rdul snyed rgyal ba la: rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul byin rlabs stsol: byang chub thugs bskyed byang chub sems dpa'i sku: dri bral rdo rje snying po chags thogs bral: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'phags tshogs dge 'dun la: rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul nyams rtogs bskyed: byin rlabs char 'bebs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gzhi: mdo rgyud sems gsum bka' dgongs phur pa dang : kye rdor bde mtshog la sogs rgyud sde'i lhar: rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul dngos grub stsol: ye shes dbyings las rnam rol mtha' yas pa: phag khros seng gsum ku ru kulle dang : 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: rnam dag

gtor ma'i mchod 'bul bde stong bskyed:'da' med dam tshig sgog tu 'chang ba yi:ma ning nag po tshogs bdag leg ldan dang gur zhal phyag bzhi phyag drug ber nag la:rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul rgyal bstan srungs:ming brgya mtshan stong bdag mo e ka dza:dpal ldan lha mo sha za kha mo che:rdo rje g.yu sgron tshe ring mched lnga la rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul theg bcud skyongs:zab gsang dpal kha 'dzin mdzad ngas nus ma:dmag zor rgyal mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad:brtan ma bcu gnyis ya ma 'khor dang bcas rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul tha tshig srungs gzasapo'i srog 'dren drang sgong ra hu la:klu bdud sras gcig dge bsnyen spyo kha ba:mkha' ri ming sring spu gri mched gsum la:rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul zab gter skyongs:dge bsnyen nyer gcig sdong lha snying srung btsan:dam can rdor legs mched 'khor sum brgya drug rja bha la dang nor bdag a tsa ra:rnam dag gtor ma'i mchod 'bul 'phrin las sgrubs:mnga' ri skor gsum dbu gtsang ru bzhi dang :mdo khams sgang drug yul gzhi skyong ba'i

༄7/ rigs dkar phyogs srung ba'i pho nya mched 'khor bcas: rnam dag gtor mas mchod 'bul dgra bgegs sgrol: khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub med 'phel rgyas shing : 'jigs tshogs rgud pa ma lus zhi ba dang mtha' mi dbus sdib 'byung pos sbyor ngan thul: shi 'dre grong 'dre dam sri'i tshogs gzhoms nas: nad mug mtshon cha'i gzengs pa ming lhag gyur: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston cher 'phel nas: bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i snang ba stsol:thugs dam ma g.yel badzra sa ma yā: 'dod pa'i phrin las gsol gdab ni skyed āX (ཿ rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dgyes bskang mthus: nub med byin rlabs nyams rtogs sbar du gsol: yi dam lha la gtor mchod phul ba'i mthus: 'gyur med mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ma rgyud mkha' 'gror dgyes mchod 'bul ba'i mthus bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed du gsol chos skyong srung mar brngan mchod 'bul ba'i mthus: 'jigs tshogs g.yul rgyal 'phrin las grub par mdzod: nor lha gter bdag

tshogs rnams dgyes bskangs mthus: khams gsum chos la 'god pa'i 'phrin las mdzod: rgyal ba'i bka' gsang bla med snying po'i don: bde legs kun 'byung bka' yi srung ma rnams dgyes bskang 'phrin las kun 'grub bdud las rgyal: zab gter bstan pa yun du gnas gyur cig: o su snyi sirnyi ma le: zhes rgyun gtor byed na rab du drug mchod gtor 'bul ba 'bring ra mer bzhin du phul ba tha ma'o rnal 'byor pas gnad 'di brten na lha dang srung ma'i byin rlabasakyi nyi ma 'char de shar na sgrub pa po'i bar chad sel la don gnyis lhun gyisagrub pa yin skal medarnamasal shin tu gsang bar bya ba ni lag len yin no bdag 'dra ratna gling pa'i thugasodam gsang ba'i mthil gcig go brtsal zhugasangol ba'i rdo rje yis sto brag smar mdo' rnal 'byor la gu ru rasgo'i thugasabacud nyid gcesanor tshul du 'brong mdun nas dag par phab pa ma lo

a ཿ rjes dran gsal ba'i me long las: ga na rje ya manta ga'i rgyas 'debs dbang gi skor las las gshin ging ging dmar chung gi srog dbangabasdo/gas dres: rmiḥ na snas gu dzag ya: mjodaldan chupo bzhi 'dus dkyil khyer gcig pu bdag bskyed mdun du chos skyong gsal: gsol mchod brngan rjes dngos grub blang slob ma gral 'khod khrus bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom la maṇḍal 'byul denasagasol ba gdab pa ni rku bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: lung rig man ngag dbang gi mdzod: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter gcig pu mos ldan slob ma bdag la dgongs las gshin ging ging dmar nag gi srog dbang zab mo gnang bar zhu lan gsum zhus rjes gnang ba ni e ma: sngon nas tshogs bsags las 'phro 'dzoms: sgo 'dir 'phrad pa skal ba bzang khe nyen che ba gsang sngags kyi: dam sdom srungs dang dngos grub sbyin: de nas slob mas khas len ni /ji byin rlabs dngos grub thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs 'di bzung snying po byang chub bar dkon mchog la gus 'gro phan bsgrab sbor sgol dgongs pas gshin rje bsgrab phar phyin drag

slob gzhan don spyod: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam sdom ma lus legs par 'dzin de phyir sgog dbang gnang bar zhu lan gsum gsol gdab dam chu ni hoḥ sto chen rdo rje'i rdul 'khrigs pas: dam tshig stong 'dzin mna' yi chu: las gshin ging ging spyi bor reg: 'di bzung snying po byang chub par: slob mar 'go zhing 'phrin las bsgrub: las ldan bu yis lce la bzhag: bdag gnyis rtogs pa thugs rjes bsgral: dang bcud mnyam gnas mnyam sbyor bsre: pho nya 'di nyid rtag tu gsol: bshad sgrub bstan gzhi 'dzin cing bsrung : gnyis ka dam gnas byang chub thob nyams pa gang zhig 'di phyir mnar: de phyir tha tshig gzu bor srungs: sa ma yā: pakru si hūṃ na ra ṇa: kā wā tsi sa ma ya na ra gaṇa slob ma 'jam dpal gshed por bsgom ye shes dbab bstems nan du bya de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol de nas gtor ma gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ 'jigs byed rngamabasapa'i brtul zhugs can:las gshin ging ging dmar nag gi: gsang gsum 'dus pa gtor chen gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis: dgra bgegs rdul

aḥ brlag dbang thob shog: ma tsa tri ging ging dza 89 thum rbad: kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas las phur gtad la hūṃ hrī dgra srog gcod pa gshin rje'i las: rnam shes dbyings sbyor 'jam dpal dbyangs: bsgral 'dren nus pa mngon spyod dbang: rigs ldan slob ma khyod la sbyin: tsa tri ging ging dza: hur thum rbad: ki la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa :: de nas 'byung lnga'i yi ge tad la hūṃ hrīḥ srid la mi 'jigs 'byung lngar dbang : zhi la mi gnas yum lngar spyod: gnyis med gsang ba shes rab kyis: dbang bskur rtogs pa mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas ya yig to la hūṃ hrīḥ khyab chen yi ge rgyu gcig pa: bsre sbyor sa bon yaḥru gnas: gnyis med ma ging dgongs pa e gcig gyur nus pa'i srog thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar skye skye gyiḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa trī: bsgral ྾ ma la hūṃ trī mthar byed khro bo chen po yis sgrol byed nus pa drag po'i dbang :las kyi mtshon cha 'di gtad pas: zhing bcu sgol nus mthu thob shog rtsa sngags mthar garma a byi 〉〉 hwa: de nas me rṣa thad la ྅ triX shes rab ye shes me bo ches: srid pa'i dra

ba ban bun kun zhi ba chos nyid chen po phu sregs byed 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog rtsa sngagasamathar sarba dzwa la ram shirnyi puṣṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ de nasatshogathadzos to la hū hrīḥ dam tshig nyams pa bskangs ba dang : bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: ga ṇa tsakra'i dam rdzas 'dis: rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar ga ṇa tsakra sarba gu ṇa a bhi shiX tre: mtha' rten gtad cing shisapa brjod dga' ston tshogasachen rol ba bya gnad kyi sbyor sgrol mdzad phrin rgyas don gnyasayid bzhin 'byung ba 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya khye'u chung thug bcud sngon gan skor nus ldan dpa' bosarjes su dran dpal de choganyid don byas la padma bde spyod rtsal gyi phab dge bas gang brtsam 'grub gyur cig sarba masko la

rmiḥ rjes dran gsal ba'i me ma nga las 'jam dpal ya manta ga'i sgrub gzhung gi gadre la 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs so aḥ na mo gu ru ya: dad dang mos gus tshad med pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa na e ma hoX ji ltar mkhyen zhing ji snyed gzigs pa yi: smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje rnon po dang dri ma med pa ye shes sems dpa'i skur: gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen gnyis rgyas par mdzod: byin gyis rlobs shig srid rtsa chos skur shig: bdud dpang zil gnon 'jamadapal gshin rje gshed: phyogs bzhi'i g.yul bzlog las mdzad ging chen bzhi pho nya yongs rdzogs bka' nyan bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs so nga bdag du tra sgrol byinagyis rlobs shig khams gsum dbyings su sbyor gshin rje dregs 'joms gshed dmar yab yum dang kaing gang dmar nag tshe bdag nag po dang gshed bzhi phyogs skyongartsis shan bdud bzhi la: gsol ba 'debs so sma mchog mngon gyur nas: byin gyis rlobs shig gzhan snang 'dul nus shog: bde gshegs sku yi gsang mdzod mngon gyur

ba'i: ro langs bde ba sangs rgyas gsang ba dang : 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'deb so rtogs pa mngon gyur zhing byin gyis rlobs shigasbobs pa'i gter grol nas: gzung 'jin bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma rang saradag chags thogs bral ba'i shes rab sgo rnamasasmin: sa lam nyams rtogs gdeng bzhi'i drodatshad rdzogus rmad byung drug ldan bum sku'i rgyal sar grol: gang 'dul sprul pa mtha' yas 'byung ba dang : 'khor ba dongs sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin shog de ltar gsol bawabyin rlabs 'byung nyamasartogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal sa ma pā 'jam dpal bshes gnyen las brgyud pa sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag bcudakhye'u chung lo tsār brgyud pa'i bab sngon gnas ba mo de nyid kyang nu ldan rdo rjesarjes su dran bstan par dogs zon che na'ang chos nyid don gsal rgya mtsho yis bskul ba don dang ldan pa'i phyir padma bde spyad rtsal gyis phab/dge bsabastan 'gro'i gsos gyur nas don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig sarba maṅga le

rjes dran gsal ba'i me long las: 'jam dpal ya marnya ga'i sgrubagazhung bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs so:aḥ na 31 gu na ya: dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bsam ya kyang deng 'dir rig lnga'i zab sgrub bstan sa ma wā dben pa'i gnabasu ma/la dang yo byad spyi ltar gsal bar bkod phyi nang sgyu gzul dam rgya bsdams gzer bzhi rdzong 'phrang srog ldan pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar brtson sam mā dang po la yang spyi don lnga thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo: shes rab ye shes me bo ches srid pa'i mtshan 'dzin drwa ba bsregs: gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i snying khrag 'byin 'jam dpal sku la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sem bskyed ba ོma pa ni ho brgal bka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las: sdang zhen 'khrul ba'i 'gro ba rnams: sbyor sgrol dgongs pas rjes bzung nas he ru ka dpal sa la bkod gsum pa bgegs rgasabasgrad pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: gsang chen he ru'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: mi dbang log 'dren rgyu 'os min: 'on kyang 'byung po gnyis 'dzin

can 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor 'dis tshims par gyis la rang sar dengs: bka' la 'khu na rdul du rlog: hū bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab bzhi pa srung gcor sgom pa ni hū hrīḥsnang srid sku gsumadakyil 'khor la: nga bdag mtshan ma ka nas dag srung dang bsrung bya ye sangs rgyas: don dam byang chub sems sang shar: dzña na dhartu badzra rakta rakta hūṃ lnga pa byin go dbab pa ni hūṃtrīḥ rdul bral sku yidakyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dang las mdzad ging bzhi sprul 'khor bcas: dbyings lasagazugs kyi sku bskyed la: sgod bcud brtan g.yo sgrub pa'i dal dkyil 'khor gsum du byin phob la: rtagasadang mtshan ma bzang po ston: mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho stsol: e a kro te ka ya mānta ka shrī sarba sa ma ya phe phe dza dza bshamasapa'i dngosapo thamasacad dang phyi nang snod bas bkod pa rnams kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du dmigs sngagasadang tingange 'dzin gyi brlabs sam pā dngosagazhirnam grangasabacu yis bstan dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni āḥ ma stes chos ska de bzhin nyid: rang bzhin snying rje kun tu snang so ma rang bab spral pa'i sma zung 'jug bde chen rgya ru spos

rmiX nyibadzra sa ma dhi hūṃ: gnyisapa lha bskyed sgom pa ni trīX snye da bcud brtan g.yo rnam par dag: 'degs byed yum lnga'i mkha' klong cher: gzhom med srung ba'i rā gur nang dur khrod brgyad bkod 'khrigs pa'i klong : thod pa lcags kyi pho brang ni rngams brjid sgo gru rta babs sogs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang : pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i khar: khyu mchog ma he sngo nag steng: rang rig yaḥlas bskyed pa'i sku: 'chi bdag 'jam dpal nag po ni khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan phyag g.yas dgra sta ngar ma phyar g.yon pas sbrul byi zhags pa bsnams: mi lngags stod g.yog stag sham dang : mgo 'phreng sbrul do rgyan du 'chang : ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: rlung me btsan dug ngang rlangs g.yo rdo rje me dang khro chung 'khrigs: dus mtha'i 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed:shar ging dung giral pa can lho ging gser gyi zhags pa 'dzin: nub ging mgyogs pa 1ga la bcibs byang ging mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor kun kyang ging rus ha ha rgod: mgo 'phreng sbrul chun dar 'phan brgyan: ru dar dam rtags 'od dang

bcas: rdo rje'i bro gar khrig khrig bsgyur bka' la 'khu ba'i snying la za dam la 'da' ba'i khrag la gzhibs: 'jigs byed dus mtshan gshin rje gshed: khro rngams 'jigs pa'i dal du sgom gnas gsum 'od dang sgog yig las spros pa'i zer gyis 'og min nas ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstims: gsum pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni hū hrī bde gshegs sku yi dkyil 'khor nas 'jam dpal sems dpa' gshegs su gsol: skye 'gro'i srog la dbang za ba'i: ya mārnya ka 'dir gshegs la: mkhyen gnyis ye shes dngos grub dang bdud dpung zil gnon byin rlabs stsol: o badzra sa ma yā dza dza: bzhi pa bams su gsol ba ni hrīḥ rin chen pad zla nyi ma'i steng chu glang ma he brjid pa'i khrir dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la: ye shes pa rnams gnyis med bstims: o badzra sam ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag la' yan lag ni na mo: sku mchog bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zhal mkhyen gnyis rgya mtsho'i gter gcig pu 'jam dpal ya manta ka la: sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni hā hrīX rab

a ༷ yangs 'jig rten srid pa'i rgyan: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin ni zad med nam mkha'i gter chen po: sku mchog khro bo dgyes phyir 'bul: ro mnyam bde bar bzhes nas kyang : srid pa ru bzlog dngos grub stsol: tshe ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho: bdun pa bstod pa bya ba ni zhuX sgegs dpa' 'jigs su rung ba'i sku: rgod gshe drag shul ldan pa'i gsung : snying rje rngams zhi'i thugs mnga' ba: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la bstod: brgyad pa 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni rang nyid ga na dzeegashed po yi thugs gar zla steng rdo rje'i sbubs: rig pa hūṃ la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi: srog la dbang bsgyur dbang thob cig: che btsan srid pa'i spyi dpal gyur: tshe malja nga1 yaka kā la sarba sa:ṇa hūṃ phaṭa: bsnyen sngags chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla 'bru 'bum bzlas pas rtags mtshan gsal dgu pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs ni (ཿ sku las drag pa 'i 11 chung 'ab/bas:gsung las drag sngags nga ro ldir: thugs las mkhyen gnyis gzi 'od 'bar: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus gsum bsnal dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob snang grags

lha sngags chos skur sad bde chen rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gzhan snang mi srun bsam sbyor ngan: thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam: ma ma( 4 yaka kwa la sarba du ca mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa sgrub sngagasating 'dzin ldan pas bzla 'bum phrag bcu yis dngos grub 'byung bcu pa las sbyor 'dzab dmigs ni hūḥ rang nyid drag po'i sprul pa dang ye shes thun mtshon sna tshogs spros: dus mtha'i nad rims gdon bgegs rnams bya sgro me la bsreg pa bzhin: tshar bcad rdul du brlag par dmigs: 3 mañdzu shrī kā la ru pa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sku pra sod:chu sod: durta sod: durmi sod: gnyan mgo la chod kha la dza: bar ba ta sod: sa spru sod klog pa sbun dgu ram̐ ram̐ḥ yo thim tha ra ti sa turnye dzwa la ram̐ pa ye swā 1 la sngags4ma phrag gsum brjod na 'phrin las gang brtsam thogs med 'grub drag sngags nus mthu me ltar 'bar nad gdon byad phur rims yams sogs thams cad ma lus gzhom par 'gyur sa ma yu de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni rnam grangs ba drug sgo nas bstan dang po tshogasardzas byin mas ni hū: chos dbyings brdal khyab gzhong pa phu sgod bcud brtan g.yo tshogs su shar: thams cad kun bzang rgyan du sprin:

miḥ dgyes stobs lha mos nam mkha' gang o.āḥ gyi gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni hūṃ trī 'gyur mid sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: bde gshegs sras bcas ye shes sku: 'jam dpal gshin rje gtso 'khor bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: o badzra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni hrīḥ mardzas sdug lha mo dpag med pas : gser dngul g.yu yi gzhong pa phu 'dod yon tshogs ston bsam yas bkod dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul: o ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: bzhi pa bar bshags ni hoḥ rtag chad bdag mtshan bzung dbang gis sdom gsum dam nyams 'khrul bas sgrib: thams cad rig pa chos kyi skur: ye shes tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags badzra sa ma ya ā: lnga pa tshogs bsgral bya ba na (ཿ ngabadag 'khrul ba'i rū tra kun: rten 'brel rten la dbab pa de ye shes mtshon chas dum bur gtubs rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su phaṭa: oṃsarbarnga tra a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa drug pa tshogs rdzas bstab pa na hūṃlha mtshan 'ardzan rā tra bskal ba la phung khams mtshan ma med pa'i rdzas ye shes

mnyam nyid shar ba rnams: sku mchog 'jam dpal dgyes phyir bstabs sarba me sa rakta tsitta ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: bdun pa lhag ma khrul ba ni pheḥlhag la dbang ba'i ma sring ging dbang phyug 'bar ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon pham phab bzang po bzhes: 'phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hrīng ༷nga bā lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi:bam pa thugasadam bskul ba ni hrī yaḥ mi mngon chosadabyings spros bral 1nga : mnyam nyid sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal gshin rje gtso 'khor bcas dgongs pa thugs rje'i rtsal byung la sgyu 'phrul gzugs skur nyer bzhengs nas mi mthun bdud sde cham la phob: rgyal bstan rin chen gzhi 'dzug cing 'phrin lasarab 'byams grub pa sogs: las kyi 'bras 'bu mchisapar mdzod: dgu pa pha mdo bstan ma ni spyo:rdo rje rgyal po bde bar gshegs sku mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs kyi: spyan sngar khasablangs dam mnosapa'i srog gcod shan pa rnam bzhi dang shā thogs rtsis pa khram 'dzin bdud: las gshin king gang dmar nag sogs dpal mgon dregs sde pho nya'i tshogs: dmar gyi gtor ma rgyan can dang

rmiX bdud rtsi dam pa 'di bzhes la: chad do dam tshig gnyer bzhin du: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod pod khams skyong ba'i bka' rtags can ma yams bstan ma bcu gnyis po: sman phran sprul pa 'bum dang bcas a su ra nas khas blangs bzhin 'dir byon bran gyi tshul du bzhugs: sman raka sbyar bas bshos bu dang :bshal chu'i gtor skyems brngan bzhes la: tha tshig ji bzhin 'phrin las sgrubs: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin rnal 'byor ba'i: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: o la la tingating kha rasmo sarba pho dza bā lidha kha kha khā hi khā nyi: brgya pa rta gro brdung ba ni hūṃḥ rangabazhin mnyam pa'i e klong du: log 'khrul gnyis snang du tra brub: mnan no sdang med rta bro rgya byang chub bar du st+waṃ bha ya: mā ra ya nan nan rsā gcig dngos grub blang ba na saX bde stong spros pa bral ba'i mdzod gzhon nu bum sku'i dgongs klong nas: dbang dang ye shes dngos grub rgyan: da lta nyid du bdag la stsol: rtsa sngags mthar kāmawākka rtsatta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ bcu gnyis bzod gsol phul ba ni hoḥ sku mtshog 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor du

mchod rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa 'chol: ting 'dzin rmugs shing bzlas pa nor: nyams 'gal dri ma thams cad bshags: badzra sa ma ya ā bce bzhi bsngo smon bya ba ni hoḥ bsod nams rnam dkar dge tshogs kun 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo thams cad mi gnas chos sku'i klong : mngon gyur ye bab byang chub shog: lan gsum bco lnga bsdu ldang bya ba ni ā rab gsal lha snang bkod pa kun: gting gsal chos sku chen por āḥ slar yang bde stong sgyu ma yis: gang shar rang grol spyod lam bya'o: a.āḥ phaṭa phaṭa btu drug shisabarjod bya ba ni lho phan dang bde ba 'byung ba'i gzhi: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i gter: gdul bya'i blo mtshor rab rgyas te: 'khor ba dongs sprugs bkra shis shog dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab des ni 'phrin las mthar rgyas shing bdud 'dul dregs pa zil gyis gnon shes rab klong rdol theg tshogs mkhyen don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya bdag 'dra khye'u chungalo tsāl sgob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba yis 'jam dpal man ngag skor dgu'i chos gces nor tshul son bstan pa'i btsas smon lam bzang po'i 'phro yod pa sngon gnas zab mo ma mtshan can nus ldan sdo rje'i rjesadran no sam shā

aḥ gu rgya brda thim:snyiḥces pa 'di'angachas nyad dan gsal rgya mtshos dar dang rin chen gnyis pa'i skyesabacas yang yang bskul ngorapadmabadaspyod ral ba rtsal gyisarin chen shog skyar bkod pa'o sarba ma le

aḥ rjes dran gsal ba'i me long las: gshin rje ya manta ga'i sgru gzhung las 'jam dpal gshed dmar gyi zab sgrub bzhugs so:aḥ na mo gu ru ya chosacan marga ma rang sar bzhag chos nyad dgongs pa'i nga bskyang nas ā brtan g.yo sems kyi cho rol ste: thams cad mi gnas chos skur dag lhun grub snang cha 'gag med du: snang srid dur khrod rngams brjid 1nga : sha za srin po 'tshogs pa'i dbus: thod mkhar gru bzhi mdzes pa'i nang : rakta'i rba rlabs g.yo ba'i klong mi rta bam chen bsnol ba'i khar 'byung po yi dwags kun gyi gtso: drag gzos 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: dmar nag me yi phung po 'dra: rus rgyan mgo 'phreng sbrul do 'phyang : thod skam dbu rgyan stag sham klubs: phyag g.yas dgra sta mkha' la phyar: g.yon pa me rlung zhags pa bsdams: khro gtum rngams brjid bltar mi bzod ba skru'i bu ga thams cad nas: rlung me btsan dug ngad rlangs 'phro rgyal bsen 'byung po 'bog rgyal byed: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi thabs su bsgrad: rab 'bar me yi tsha tsha 'khrugs: yaḥlas

spros pa'i lasagashin gyi: dmag tshogs bu yug ltar du 'tshubs: ma yis 'phrul ba'i ging ging ni: skar tshogs 'khrigs pa ji bzhin 'gyed: shan bdud rtsis pa glog ltar gyur dgra bo shā rtsis khram la 'bebs de ltar gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyang : 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi: sku gsung thugs kyi da la ste rang byung rang shar chen por sgom gnas gsum 'od dang thugs srog las: spros pa'i dam tshig lcags kyu yis: bde gshegs sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstims: sgrub gzhung ji bzhin las gzhung bsrangs bzlas sngags bsgyur kha 'di ltar ro o padma ya manta ka ging ging sarba trī tri hūṃ sgrub sngags oṃ padma ya mānta ka ging ging dza bhyo pra tun tsitta shag shag thum ril rbad las sngags o padma ya mārnya ging ging : 'ur 'ur: kham shag ro myag: rmug ti rbad ya: tsitta zungs zungs: byad ma'i tshe srog la rbad bhyo ging ging kha rakta kha rakka ra ya kṣe ya: ya kṣe ya tsa dri tri dum bur gtubs dum bur gtubs: sod cig sgol zhig kha kha khā hi khā hi: nus mthu yon ma bsam mtha' yas 'gran gyi do medonargya 'bar

aḥ ba me yisa'akhor lo 'dis byad phur rbod gtong rimasayamasathum drag sngagasaspu gri ngar ma 'dis dgra bgegasatshe sgog dum bur gcod byin rlabs ye shesachar rgyun gyis gdulabya'i blo grosapadro rgyas sam mā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal bshesaganyen la brgyud pa'i sangasargyas gsang ba'i thugasadam mthil 'brog lor bstsal ba'i sngon gnas de nu ldan dpa' la rje su dran chos nyid don gsal rgya mtsho la padma bde spyod rtsal gyis bkrol dge bas lugasaganyisagasogasu shog sa masgo le

rjesi dran gsal b.lime long las gshin rjeya mānta ka41ba gzhung lasasabadag nag po zab sgrub bzhugs so:rmiḥ na ma gu ru ya:marga 4sa chasi kun chos nyad klong ma bcos mnyam pa nyid du bzhag āX 'khag( 'das ka dag dgongs sang brdal: lhun grub rten 'byung snang cha rnga snangasrid dur khrod rab 'jigs dbus: thod pa lcags kyi sku mkhar nang : mi rta baṃ bsnol khri yi khar:ya ༷las grub payi stobs po che:tshebadag nag thamachar sprin mdog: sku ni khrogatum rngams brjid 'bar: sbyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: smar smin me yi tsha tsha 'phro: phyag g.yas dgra sta nam mkhar phyar: gzas pa po rnams thal bar brlagagayon pas dug sbrul zhags pa bsdams: gnod byed 'byung po 'ching bar byed: thod skam rim dgu'i dbu rgyan dang : mi lpags rlon pa gos su bgo: sbrul do stag gi sharmathabs mdzes: zhabs basmad bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: gtam drag dus me 'bar ba'i sma'i: bka' 'khor las mkhan rnam pa brgyad: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: ma

'dres yongs rdzogs gsal bar bskyed: gdug paṃ 'dul ba'i yang sprul dang : pho nya mtshon thun bu yug 'tshubs: rngams brjed zhal gyi hom khung du: 'byung po'i tshe srog grum grum rol: 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: mkhyen brtse nus dpal gzi byin 'byugs: gnas gsum 'od dang sgog yig las: spros pa'i dam tshig lcags kyu yis: ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstims: lasagazhung bgring la bsnyenapa ni skyi( ya ma ra tsa a ka la hūṃ phaṭa: sgrub sngags ma ya ma ra tsa ya me dwo tu ṇa shrī sarba duṣṭa hūṃ phaṭa las sbyor sngags oṃ ya ya mārnya ma ma ma ru lu shrī hūṃ shrī shā ya ma tha duḥrakkaḥpaḥsaḥti phu ṇiḥtriḥkaḥniḥ.aḥsmyodzaḥ.aḥshig shig: phyung phyungs khrol khrol swā hā: than ltas gshed kha byad phur rbod gtong thams cad mā ra ya bzlog bzlog: dregs pa pongs kyi srog tig 'di bzlas pas khams gsum dbang du sdud srid gsum sde brgyad dam la 'dogs gri bo na 'chi'i gshed lam gcod nus mthu yon ༅ bsam mi khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs bcud skor sangs rgyas gsang ba la bstan pa khye'u chung dpa' bor gces nor son sngon gnas nyams len mthil gcig 'ad

aḥ rjesadrananusaldan dpa' por son dge 'bras chos nyid don gsal la bstan no bzhed pa bskang gyur cig sarba ma le 'char ga nag po dung ga spug nag btsun pa dung lto degasum sha za mo lha mtsho chos skal yin pas de bar srog la bab kyang a tham rgya

aḥ rjes dran gsal ba'i me long las: gshin rje ya mānta ga'i sgrub gzhung las las gshin gyi zab sgrub bzhugs so:aX na mo gu ru ya: snang tshogs snang ba rang sar gzhig brdal khyab dgong sa pa mngon gyur bas āḥ snang srid brtan g.yo chos skur sangs: lhun grub thabs shes 'phrul snang ba:bde stong yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: tshogs yul rang grol dur khrod kyi: bkod pa ma 'dres gsal rdzogs dbus: thod pa lcags kyi sku mkhar ni: gru gsum rim pa lnga yi klong:bde chen rakta 'khyil ba'i dbus: bdud bsen spyi chings bsnol ba'i khar: dbang drag dus me 'bar 'khrigs rngams: ging rus bswo sgra sgrogs shing 'phyo: de dbus yaḥlas bskyed pa'i sku: 'jigs byed las gshin nag po ni: sku mdog sngo nag char sprin 'dra: rngams khro gtum pa'i gzi brjid 'khrugs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche bzhi gtsigs: smar smin glog 'byug spran gsum bsgrad: drag po'i gad rgyang ha hi sgogs: gar chen dgu yi nyams kyis 'byud: phyag g.yas smra gri ngar ma phyar: g.yon pas thod

khrag tsittas bkang zhing bcu'i sgog la dbang za zhing : mngon spyod drag po'i las la rgyu: mi lngags go bgo stag sham klubs mgo 'phreng sbrul chun do shal rngams: thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i 'phan spyi gtsug ma he rngams pa'i zhal gdong drug ya mtshan gcig tu mngon: dmar ser ral brjes rdo rje mdzes: zhabs bsgrad bdud bsen zil gyis gnon snang stong zung 'jug chen por sgom: sku la 'jam dpal zhi dang khro: ma 'dres til gong byur bzhin gsal: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon dang : sgog yig ya las 'od 'phrosapas bde gshegs sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: las kyi gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par sbyan drangs gnyis med bstims: de nasagazhung bsringasabasnyenapa ni skyirngo garma ya ma ra tsa shrī ka la hūṃ phaṭa sgrub sngags skyid kurma ya ma ra tsa ta na na hūṃ phaṭa: las sngags spyi dril chen mo ni gye phye phye0 a 11 te ka ya mānta ka ya ma ye: ka la ru pa ka pa ye hriṣṭi a pa ye: a ā ne: a zhe: u spu ne: u ne: du du ne: du ne: a i u: e khyed e: ra ri: la li du ru ye bye tsa ye: seng ha ye: hri ta ye: bhi ta ye:

aḥ tsitta ye: ha la ye mu ka ye: u spu ne: u spu ne: byi tri ta a a na na ya ma ra dza ya ma raka: ya ma raka a ya ma rakta: pe ta li kro ti shā ri ma ma e ka ja ṭi de ma kha la shā ril: ru lu ru lu: shrī badzra kro dha ya ma garma ro ṣa ṇa tri ta tsarnya rakka marto a hūṃ dza: e ring gshin rje yongs kya grog ting 'dzin ldan pa 'di bgrang na gshin rje yongasardzogasa'agrub pa dang nad gdon nyer 'che'i phyogs kun thub:bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal nges shes go myong gdeng thob 'gyur sa ma mā brnganapa'igator ma 'bul ba la bsangs sbyangs 'gugs bstims nan du bya (ཿdrag pa las kyi gshin rje yi rngams brjid zhal hom gdengs pa na gtor ma dgra snying rgyan ldan bstabs: mche ba drug cu'i lcags ngar de: nyams pa'i tshe sgog dpal la phob: zhing bcu'i khrag sbyar chang skyems bstabs: dgra sde ljang dmar thog gis gtor: dgra rus dmar las sla ba bstabs: dmigs bya ming med stong par bsam: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las de: khyad chos rdza 'phral bcas rte stsol: dam tshig dus bab ma g.yel zhig: a darma ya ma ra tsa dṛ ka la hūṃḥ dgra bo'i me sa ra tsitā king ni ri rti la khā nyi kha nyi

lan bdun gyisaphul 'phrin lasamyur dgra sde thal ba rdul brlag ra nusamathu pon tan bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun nyams dang sbyar na gsal sam mā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal bshesaganyen thugs bcud skor sang rgyasagasang bar bka' bab pa khye'u chung 'brog lor gces nor brtsal sngon gan yi dam stsa ba 'di rjesadrananusaldan rdo ra sad dge 'bras chos nyid don gsal la bstan no bzhed don 'grub gyur cig sarba masgo ye

rmiḥ rjes dran gsal ba'i me long las: gshin rje ya mānta ga'i sgrub gzhung las 'jam dpal gshed ser gyi zab sgrub bzhugs so:aḥ na mo gu ru ya: srog bdud rlung gis mi bskyod par so ma rang bzhag ngang bskyangs te āḥ smra bsam brjod bral chos sku'i klong: kun snang lhun grub bkod pa ni thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug pa'i: dag chen dur khrod rngams pa'i zhing: brda don rtags su rdzogs pa yi: thod mkhar gru bzhi rab mdzes nang rin chen khri rkang bdud bzhi'i khar bdag snang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: ser gsal khro gtum rngams pa'i sku: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril mche ba gcigs: ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'khyil rig bdag 'jam dpal tshon gang shar: dur khrod dpal chas rgyan du klubs ha hi zhes sgrogs dbang dang ldan: phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri 'dzin gnyis snang srid pa'i drwa ba gtor g.yon pa brgya stong glegs bam bsnams: shes bya'i gzhungs lugs gsal bar byed: zhabs gnyis rdo rje gyad chen gyis: tshangs pa'i yul gnyis rtse nas gnon: mkhyen pa'i

ye shes 'od stong 'bar: 'jigs tshogs lta ba zil gyis gnon 'bar ba me yi klong nas 'gying: mtshan bcas chos khams chos skur bshigs sku las 'od zer rdo rje'i rdul 'bar 'khrigs g.yo ba'i brtul zhugs kyis: sa gsum gdug pa'i don snying 'byin sde brgyad dregs tshogs dam la 'dogs: g.yas na gshin rje pho tshogs 'gyed: bstan la rgol ba'i gshed du shar: g.yon na gshin rje'i mo tshogs 'tshubs: nyams pa can gyi tshe srog rngubs: ging dang laṅka'i bu yug 'tshubs: sangs rgyas chos kyi bstan pa srung:snang la dngos mtshan ma grub pa dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: ye shes sgyu ma'i dal du sgom: gnas gsum 'od kyi gzi byin dang : thugs ga'i bskul byed lcags kyu yis:bde gshegs sku yi rten brten pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs ji bzhin: sbyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig gyur: las gzhung bgrings la 'dzab bsnyen ni 31 ma( 31 ya mānta ka hūṃ phaṭa: sgrub bsnyen oṃ mañdza shrī yamānta ka pra dzñā dzñā na sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: las sngags: ma māñdza sarba dug phaṭa:trig khrom bhyo: ma ni ma ra ṇa bhyo: ma ra du ṇa bhyo: shrī nag mo bhyo: rasmo raka

rmiḥ bhyo ting ya rakka bhyo ki la ya bhyo gnod byed 'byung po'i tshe sgog la bhyo: dun bhyo dun bhyo: nus mthu yon to bsam mtha' yas ban bon stong gi byad phur thub mo ngan rmi lam ban pa sel mtshan ngan sri ltas ngan kun thub tshe bsrings dpal bskyed rkyen thub 'di drag sngags kun gyi rgyal po yin las gshin nag po'i 'phrin las sgo: 'gran gyi do med gzi byin ldan skal ba can las gu rgya rgya sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs kyi bcud sangs rgyas gsang ba la bstsal ba 'brog lor son pa sngon gyi gnas rjes dran nusaldan rdo rje dang de yi snang ba ri mo ru bskul mkhas chos nyid don gsali la padma bde spyod gling pa zhes ḍakki 'bum sprin rtag 'khrigs pa'i shes rab bde stong 'dzum las rdol skal ldan rnams kyi dpal du shog sarbamasgo le
